news_mentions.headline: Packers RB Josh Jacobs pleads no contest to misdemeanor charges
news_mentions.description: Packers running back Josh Jacobs pleaded no contest Thursday to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property stemming from a May altercation with his girlfriend.
news_mentions.body_text: green bay wis green bay packers running back josh jacobs pleaded no contest thursday to misdemeanor charges of battery and criminal damage to property stemming from a may altercation with his girlfriend during which she said he threw her to the ground jacobs must pay a 1 000 fine plus court costs for the battery charge under an agreement with prosecutors the criminal damage charge can be dismissed in a year if he fulfills terms that include staying out of trouble avoiding the victim in this case submitting to supervision completing counseling and paying restitution to the victim i fully understand the seriousness of the situation and i take full responsibility jacobs said during an appearance in a brown county court jacobs was arrested may 26 three days after hobart lawrence police officers came to his wisconsin home to investigate a disturbance according to police the woman told them that jacobs grabbed her and threw her to the ground causing her to hit her head police said jacobs also took her phone from her while she was on the ground police said they noticed redness on her face and neck and could feel a bump on the back of her head according to a criminal complaint the woman s statement was corroborated by surveillance footage from the camera system in the garage where the incident occurred jacobs was charged in late august and the nfl subsequently placed him on the commissioner s exempt list which prevents the three time pro bowl running back from playing or practicing but allows him to keep receiving a paycheck players on the commissioner s exempt list may be allowed at team facilities for meetings individual workouts therapy and rehabilitation and other non football activities we have been closely monitoring all developments in the matter which remains under review of the personal conduct policy an nfl spokesperson said in a statement there is no change to his status as he remains on the commissioner s exempt list jacobs could face a league suspension david chesnoff one of the lawyers representing jacobs said the running back already has begun counseling this plea reflects josh s acknowledgement of his actions and his acceptance of responsibility for these actions chesnoff said there are significant consequences for josh and he intends to meet all the requirements the court imposes under these negotiations jacobs entered his plea three days before the packers open the season at minnesota he is coming off a 2025 season during which he rushed for 929 yards and 13 touchdowns that followed a 2024 season in which he ran for 1 329 yards and 15 touchdowns while earning his third pro bowl selection he joined the packers in 2024 after spending his first five seasons with the raiders including a 2022 campaign in which he earned all pro honors and had an nfl leading 1 653 yards rushing the only other running backs currently on green bay s 53 man roster are marshawn lloyd chris brooks and kaleb johnson the packers acquired johnson from pittsburgh the day that jacobs was placed on the commissioner s exempt list the associated press contributed to this report

news_mentions.headline: Will Anderson on Texans' season opener vs. Bills: 'This is an AFC Championship matchup'
news_mentions.description: The 2026 Week 1 slate features a heavyweight matchup between Super Bowl hopefuls, Houston and Buffalo, each favored to win its division and make a deep postseason run.
news_mentions.body_text: the 2026 week 1 slate features a heavyweight matchup between super bowl hopefuls houston and buffalo each favored to win its division and make a deep postseason run this is an afc championship matchup texans pass rusher will anderson said this week via the houston chronicle two really good teams we have a ton of respect for them the texans have made the postseason each of the past three years under demeco ryans but bowed out of the tournament in the divisional round each campaign the bills meanwhile have made the playoffs in seven straight seasons but have just two conference championship appearances in that span last year s divisional round loss cost coach sean mcdermott his job sunday marks the third straight season the texans will face the bills in houston ryans club won both previous two meetings a last second field goal victory in 2024 and a four point win last year in a game where houston s defense ravaged josh allen for eight sacks the week 1 bout figures to be a tight matchup the texans finished 12 5 in 2025 and all five losses came by one possession per nfl research four of the bills six losses in 2025 including playoffs were by one score houston s pass rush will key sunday s contest anderson and danielle hunter dominated the last contest bamboozling allen into two interceptions and just 253 passing yards in the contest can they do it in back to back matchups allen has taken more than five sacks versus an opponent four previous times in his career in his next game versus each of those opponents gb bal sea mia he took two or fewer sacks and won the bills will open head coach joe brady s first season in the big chair against one of the best defenses in the league the texans d set franchise records for total 277 2 ypg allowed led nfl and scoring defense 17 4 ppg allowed second in nfl in 2025 and was top five in nfl in yards per play allowed 4 8 opponent passer rating 76 2 and takeaways 29 how brady tweaks his scheme now that he s fully in charge will be a storyline that will stretch beyond this week

news_mentions.headline: Patriots QB Drake Maye on loss to Seahawks: My impatience 'cost us the game'
news_mentions.description: New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye threw three interceptions that led to a 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks in the 2026 season opener.
news_mentions.body_text: new england patriots quarterback drake maye threw away a chance to swipe the season opening game in a super bowl rematch against the seattle seahawks falling 13 10 following a game sealing interception the pats controlled much of the first half after the super bowl champs lost starting qb sam darnold five plays into the contest after new england took a 10 0 lead early in the third quarter things unraveled for maye who threw three ints on the patriots final three possessions the third year qb blamed impatience on the trio of errors yeah we had the game under control maye said thought we had a good plan to start chipping away and be patient and lost patience and it cost us decisions that cost us the game on my part on my end i vow to myself to be better and realize it s a long season but at same time we can t have those we can t have those it s unacceptable and i know we got to get back to work that wasn t how i play football and how i want to represent my game and playing quarterback for the patriots maye completed 23 of his 33 pass attempts for 178 yards one touchdown and a career high three interceptions the bulk of his production came on short tosses and dump offs he went 20 of 23 on attempts of under 10 air yards for 134 yards and a touchdown 8 9 cpoe maye struggled downfield 10 air yards connecting on just three of eight attempts for 44 yards and three ints 12 7 cpoe all three of his picks came on deep attempts 20 air yards two more than he threw all last season 1 the three ints flipped the script as the pats watched a road win slip away you can t throw three interceptions coach mike vrabel said drake knows that we put ourselves in some long yardage situations on the one that was probably forced and i think the guy made a great play on the last one the last one was the most egregious after trailing for the first time in the contest maye helped drive to the seahawks 16 with several solid throws and using his legs to pick up pivotal first downs however his impatience again reared its head in range for the game tying field goal with 26 seconds remaining maye forced a pass to mack hollins in the end zone that came up woefully short it was a bad decision and horrific execution i didn t put enough on it to get it out and it was just unacceptable maye said we had a chance to send it to overtime at the worst the only thing you could do is turn the ball over and that s what i did early maye was content to take what the defense gave him and did a far better job finding outlets versus the seahawk pressure packages than during the super bowl however late he began to hunt big plays that weren t there and got burned i just stopped being patient he said that was the big thing we were really good up to the point where i tried to force one down the sideline to romeo doubs we were patient and dumping it off and trying to move the chains and we avoided a lot of three and outs and that was something we try to earn more plays and the explosives will come so just stopped being patient and made decisions that ended up like i said cost us the game maye had no choice but to wear this l this one can t be blamed on the o line or poor calls the qb simply had a horrible string of decisions that cost his club it burns now and it was truly a brutal performance but there is a lot of season ahead reminder the pats lost week 1 to the raiders last year and still made the super bowl how maye bounces back will say far more than one wednesday game in september it s such a long season vrabel said we re going to hold our head up high and we have nothing but the utmost confidence in him and everybody on this football team and he s going to make a lot of plays for us

news_mentions.headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold will undergo MRI; hip fracture ruled out after win over Patriots
news_mentions.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold suffered a hip injury on Seattle's first drive Wednesday night against the Patriots and was ruled out and replaced by Drew Lock.
news_mentions.body_text: the seahawks are breathing a sigh of relief both after a second half comeback victory to open the season and due to the latest update on quarterback sam darnold s health darnold who was ruled out just prior to halftime of wednesday s 13 10 season opening win over the patriots due to a hip injury is still having tests done but a hip fracture has been ruled out head coach mike macdonald said postgame macdonald described the results of darnold s testing as great news though the team still does not know the extent of the qb s injury darnold underwent a ct scan on his hip at the harborview medical center in seattle and received encouraging but inconclusive results per espn s adam schefter who added darnold is scheduled to undergo an mri on thursday darnold suffered his injury during seattle s first drive a five play 30 yard march when he was sacked on third down by dre 39 mont jones trainers did not initially attend to the qb on the sideline but he went to the blue tent during new england s opening possession drew lock then entered the game in relief while darnold limped to the locker room as seattle s offense took the field for a second time darnold was 1 of 2 for 13 yards before sustaining the injury with the seahawks and pats knotted at 0 seattle s offense went silent without darnold the patriots were able to open up a 7 0 lead over the course of the first half as lock proved unable to lead any of his five drives into enemy territory the seahawks became just the third reigning super bowl champion to get shut out in the first half of their season opener joining the 1984 raiders and 1967 packers per nfl research like those raiders and packers teams who recovered for a win and a tie respectively seattle would not lose the defense played tremendously allowing only a field goal the rest of the way and ending all three of new england s fourth quarter possessions with interceptions including an end zone pick by joshua jobe with 21 seconds remaining to seal the victory seattle s smothering defense allowed lock just enough opportunity as the seahawks overcame a double digit deficit with two field goals and a 45 yard touchdown reception by jaxon smith njigba making lock the first backup qb in nfl history to throw a td in a reigning super bowl champion s season opener he was buoyed by the defense s stellar performance but lock protected the ball and showed why he s one of the league s more trusted reserves going 16 of 22 for 187 yards and the aforementioned td it remains to be seen how many games if any darnold will miss but at least for wednesday night the seahawks found a winning formula in his absence

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Raiders TE Brock Bowers undergoes knee procedure, expected to miss a game or two
news_mentions.description: Las Vegas Raiders tight end Brock Bowers is expected to miss a game or two after undergoing a meniscus trim this week, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the raiders will start the 2026 season without their top weapon tight end brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday in dallas and is expected to miss a game or two nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported wednesday bowers injury occurred during camp but wasn t diagnosed until last week leading to this week s procedure per rapoport and schefter wednesday s news represents the latest health related hurdle encountered by bowers over the last year fresh off a stellar rookie season bowers suffered a knee injury early in the 2025 season forcing him to miss three games in october and hampering the star pass catcher throughout the campaign given an offseason to recover which began early when bowers sat out of the raiders final two games of 2025 the hope was that bowers would be able to return fully healthy and at the form he displayed in his first nfl season his attempt to do so will be interrupted by the surgery which shouldn t keep him out long but does inspire some concern about how he ll perform in 2026 las vegas selected bowers no 13 overall in the 2024 draft and it immediately paid off via a 112 catch 1 194 yard five touchdown rookie season for the georgia product instantly vaulting bowers into elite status among nfl tight ends his health struggles hindered las vegas offense tremendously in 2025 underscoring his importance to the raiders offensive plans they ll begin 2026 in a familiar place without him while maintaining hope this is merely a bump in bowers road las vegas hosts the miami dolphins at 4 25 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Carson Wentz to back up Kyler Murray in Vikings' Week 1 game; J.J. McCarthy is QB3
news_mentions.description: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell announced Wednesday that Carson Wentz will be the team's primary backup QB to Kyler Murray in Week 1's game against the Packers.
news_mentions.body_text: j j mccarthy s tumble down the depth chart is complete coach kevin o connell announced wednesday that carson wentz will serve as the backup quarterback to kyler murray on sunday against the green bay packers mccarthy will serve as qb3 i m looking at that right now as a week to week thing o connell added carson he s got almost 100 career starts what he was able to do last year from a standpoint of very limited repetition but being able to apply a career s worth of experience that s kind of what you need to do as a backup quarterback when so much of the emphasis is gonna be on getting kyler as comfortable as we can possibly get him it s quite a fall for mccarthy the 2024 no 10 overall pick but one that was telegraphed plainly most of the offseason from the moment murray signed a one year deal in minnesota it was presumed he would start despite koc s insistence that mccarthy had a shot it quickly became clear that murray would be in the saddle week 1 the other indicator of mccarthy s short leash was the club re signing wentz who performed admirably in five appearances last season the crowded qb room which includes max brosmer on the practice squad underscored that the club wasn t going to go through the same qb ordeal it dealt with last year when it let sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building to give mccarthy his shot nine s preseason struggles and an ankle injury made koc s decision relatively easy a team that otherwise should be battling for a playoff spot can t take a chance on mccarthy being the backstop if murray who has his own injury history goes down despite the first round pick sitting as qb3 o connell insisted that he s excited to continue to get a chance to work with mccarthy he s still two snaps away so he s also gotta still prepare the coach added even today he had great questions about the game plan he s bouncing around he s still a beacon of energy on this team those traits are always gonna be there for him j j s still a young player with so much football still ahead of him if and when we feel like he is ready and gives us the best chance being one snap away with limited reps we can obviously do that koc isn t giving up on j j just yet but there isn t much further the qb can fall before the club does move on

news_mentions.headline: Niners vs. Rams: Three must-know storylines for NFL's first-ever game in Australia
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Jeremy Bergman breaks down three must-know storylines in Thursday night's game between the San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams in Melbourne, Australia.
news_mentions.body_text: are you ready for some footy a thursday night friday morning party depending on your location the 49ers rams season opener promises to be one for the history books not just because it s the first regular season nfl contest to be played in australia or that it ll take place at a 172 year old cricket ground nearly a belichick older than soldier field or that it could begin on a friday and end on a thursday time zones maaaaan more simply this clash between the california rivals is set to stand out more for what happens on the pitch than off it los angeles the reigning nfc runner up loaded up on star power ahead of sofi stadium s second super bowl hosting gig jaylen watson trent mcduffie myles garrett aaron donald they re all wearing royal and sol these days so too are returning stars matthew stafford puka nacua and davante adams it s as stacked a cast as we ve seen in hollywood since ocean s eleven will sean mcvay s 11 get off on the right foot in week 1 their old nemeses from up north are in the way san francisco returns many of its notable names brock purdy is handing off the ball to christian mccaffrey and throwing it to george kittle while fred warner and nick bosa are set to wreak havoc on defense there were a few big returns and additions especially in the receiver room deebo samuel is back after a year on the hill while san francisco added mr 1 000 mike evans and rookie de 39 zhaun stribling to the corps but for the most part it s a familiar 49ers outfit that s set for a familiar matchup in an unfamiliar setting since 2017 when kyle shanahan and mcvay were hired in their respective locales san francisco has won 11 of 19 games played against the rams but this is the first time the two will face off in week 1 thursday night s tussle is the first week 1 game between division opponents that each had at least 12 wins the previous season in 15 years per nfl research the aussies are in for a treat and i m not talking vegemite three must know storylines 1 will rams revamped defense still dominate as expected sans donald all offseason no debut was more hotly anticipated than myles garrett s in los angeles then came aaron donald out of retirement and into the fearsome fivesome stealing garrett s thunder with just 11 days to prepare from signing to game day donald quickly became the most curious case of week 1 but to the chagrin of all football fans outside of the bay area the defensive tackle will be held out of thursday s opener instead watching from where he watched the last rams two seasons his couch even without a d there s still plenty of intrigue surrounding l a s defense with garrett mcduffie and watson debuting there s no preparing for the threat of the reigning defensive player of the year especially when he s surrounded by kobie turner braden fiske and byron young expect l a to try to throw san francisco s offensive line off its bearings from the jump especially on the interior without donald and garrett the rams boasted a 40 2 pressure percentage in 2025 second in the nfl with at least garrett on the field on thursday night brock purdy will surely be feeling the heat the question is whether los angeles kansas city style secondary will get bbq d by san francisco s spicy new look receiving corps the niners wr rams cb matchups will be brand new at all levels and therefore unpredictable purdy didn t have much success against the rams last he played them in 2024 but he s undefeated in season openers something s gotta give 2 can 49ers put their unusual summer behind them san francisco s offseason was one to forget to summarize for the uninitiated the niner gang s strange summer included electrical substation conspiracy theories kyle shanahan s car crash which resulted in a concussion and missed time during training camp ricky pearsall s latest setback and placement on season ending injured reserve and owner jed york s arrest in ohio adding to the off field anxiety around the team have been the absences of george kittle and nick bosa for most of training camp and preseason though the star tight end and pass rusher are on track to play in week 1 after their season ending injuries in 2025 will the turbulence of the last two months translate to on field agita for the 49ers they ve overcome a number of injuries in the past to remain competitive san francisco s 2025 run to the divisional round is a recent prime example the leadership core remains intact and the offensive additions of mike evans and de zhaun stribling provide exciting unpredictability to shanahan s offense once thursday hits the 49ers can officially turn the page from their odd offseason to a regular season rhythm but will the stink of the summer linger into week 1 and beyond 3 will travel have any effect niners rams in oz will be a study of a contrast in styles not on field though the rams reliance on 13 personnel and the 49ers league high rate of pre snap motion in 2025 do present archetypal differences no san francisco and los angeles offer two vastly different approaches to travel the 49ers chose to depart the west coast over a week ahead of the melbourne game leaving on wednesday sept 2 from san francisco and arriving in australia on the morning of friday sept 4 the niners have since taken in the city imbibed the celebrated coffee attended an aussie rules football match and generally ingratiated themselves to the local fan base l a has taken a different tack sean mcvay s squad left on the evening of tuesday sept 8 and is arriving in melbourne the morning of thursday sept 10 around 24 hours before the big game just another business trip for the title favorites mcvay says the short turnaround is what s best for the team based on how they ve approached intentional trips before last season the rams arrived in london on saturday morning for a sunday afternoon win over the jaguars but no nfl team has attempted this type of trip before going across the pacific and landing with just a day to get settled for 60 minutes of full contact football it s quite the unique gamble for the designated home team

news_mentions.headline: Aaron Rodgers: I came back because Steelers are Super Bowl contenders
news_mentions.description: Aaron Rodgers returned to Pittsburgh this spring for a 22nd NFL season, convinced he can cap off a Hall of Fame career with a second Super Bowl victory.
news_mentions.body_text: aaron rodgers returned to pittsburgh this spring for a 22nd nfl season convinced he can cap off a hall of fame career with a second super bowl victory asked recently by adam schein on mad dog sports radio if the steelers are among eight to 12 teams with a realistic shot to make it to super bowl weekend rodgers responded confidently yeah of course of course that s why i came back because i believe in the guys rodgers said the 42 year old then listed off his reasoning starting with pittsburgh s additions on defense namely jaquan brisker and jamel dean to pair with a stellar front rodgers also noted the upside of the young offensive line and weapons brought in the qb even praised the specialist crew highlighting his belief that top to bottom the steelers can compete with anyone i like the roster as a whole rodgers said we have good veteran leadership it s just about going out there and doing it i feel like the afc is very deep even our own division has a number of teams with super bowl aspirations which is great the steelers veteran roster could put it over the top in a crowded afc however much of that opportunity will come down to how the quadragenarian quarterback plays

news_mentions.headline: Garrett Wilson: Playoffs 'very realistic' for New York Jets in 2026
news_mentions.description: The New York Jets haven't made the playoffs since the 2010 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york jets infamously haven t made a postseason appearance in 15 campaigns garrett wilson believes that streak will end this season very realistic wilson said tuesday of the jets likelihood of making the postseason via espn i mean i think it should happen i ll say that it s our job to go play ball and do it but that s how i feel about it while the outside world might scoff at wilson s optimism it s the mentality every player should enter the season sporting should he have said he sees gang green winning five or six games no for wilson and every other jet ending the decade and a half streak without a playoff berth tied for the fourth longest drought in all american sports since 1970 is priority no 1 the playoffs man no doubt about it the wideout said of his definition of a successful season make the playoffs then restart the season and we ll see what happens nothing else outside of florham park there is little optimism that gang green will turn things around following their 3 14 campaign most peg the jets win total around 5 5 while they might dig themselves out of the afc east cellar competing for a playoff bid would turn heads in aaron glenn s second season importing veterans on defense an adult as a starting qb and weapons around the likes of wilson and breece hall have raised the baseline for improvement something is going to happen this year wilson said i m a faithful guy and i believe that with the work we ve been putting in we have as good an opportunity as anybody in the league i m excited man we have a hell of a group here in a league that sees clubs go worst to first in a division on a near yearly basis why not the jets

news_mentions.headline: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs would 'for sure' take himself No. 1 in fantasy football
news_mentions.description: Detroit Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs is coming off a career high in snaps played and touches, figures that appear to be on the rise in 2026.
news_mentions.body_text: detroit lions running back jahmyr gibbs was a popular no 1 overall pick in fantasy football heading into the 2026 campaign the rb agrees with the choice for sure he said smirking when asked if he d selected himself via the team s official website i m either going to make a lot of people happy or mad after splitting reps with david montgomery for the first three seasons in detroit gibbs is set to star in a solo role in 2026 with veteran isiah pacheco beginning the season on injured reserve the lions top backup options are 2023 undrafted free agent jacob saylors two career carries and 2024 fourth rounder sione vaki seven career carries i guess i m getting most of the carries gibbs said i feel good it s nothing i haven t done before it s going to be cool gibbs saw a snap boost last season hitting the 713 mark in 2025 via next gen stats that figure feels significantly lower than what he s in line for in 2026 the rb finished last year with a career high 320 scrimmage touches for 1 839 yards with 18 total touchdowns in a league with few workhorse running backs gibbs is a unicorn with the skill set to thrive

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Buccaneers, QB Baker Mayfield agree to three-year, $165 million extension
news_mentions.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers and quarterback Baker Mayfield have agreed to terms on a three-year contract extension, NFL Network Insiders Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.
news_mentions.body_text: baker mayfield has cashed in with the buccaneers again tampa bay is signing mayfield to a three year 165 million contract extension nfl network insiders ian rapoport and mike garafolo and espn s adam schefter reported on tuesday tampa bay later announced the extension through the 2029 season the news comes as a surprise after the two sides passed mayfield s self imposed training camp deadline for a deal to get done leading to the veteran qb to say he felt disrespected by the bucs proposals roughly six weeks time however was enough to bridge whatever gap existed in contract talks and mayfield now will make 55 million per year on a new deal struck on the eve of the 2026 season mayfield 31 has provided security for the bucs in the post tom brady era keeping tampa bay competitive in the nfc south during his three seasons quarterbacking the team since joining the club in 2023 mayfield has made two pro bowls and thrown for 12 237 yards 92 touchdowns and 56 interceptions while winning two division titles though last year ended in disaster a 2 7 finish down the stretch to miss the playoffs after a 6 2 start to the season mayfield has proven he s every bit the franchise quarterback the bucs require half of the team s wins during the 2025 campaign came through his late game heroics as he led four fourth quarter comebacks and four game winning drives he was an early mvp candidate having thrown 16 tds to two ints through week 10 but a litany of ailments throughout the season took their toll mayfield never missed a contest but showed up on the injury report with injuries to his foot toe right biceps knee oblique and both shoulders at various points of the season as he wore down the highlights came less frequently replaced by accuracy issues more turnovers and trouble staying on the same page with his receivers nevertheless tampa bay still fields a win now team and mayfield is the surest bet to capitalize under center mayfield initially joined tampa bay on a one year prove it deal in 2023 hoping simply to find a more permanent home after journeying between three teams from 2021 22 he won a qb competition over kyle trask and helped the bucs to the divisional round after which he signed a three year 100 million extension it turned out to be a massive bargain for the buccaneers mayfield returned the team to the playoffs again in 2024 while throwing a career high 41 touchdowns and showed yet again he s one of the league s fiercest leaders throughout an injury plagued 25 campaign he did so as the 16th highest paid quarterback in the league at 33 3 million per year essentially the lowest paid established starter who isn t a stopgap veteran or on a rookie contract excluding special cases like the falcons tua tagovailoa and the vikings kyler murray signing deals for the veteran minimum following costly releases by their previous teams under his new deal mayfield will be counted on to take his game to yet another level still for the first time since 2021 the buccaneers will not enter the season as the reigning nfc south champions and even in that case they were coming off a super bowl victory tampa bay went 12 years without a playoff trip before its recent five year stretch of postseason runs from 2020 24 and has no intention of starting a new prolonged drought after missing out on the tournament last season mayfield still has plenty of playmakers at his disposal namely running back bucky irving and wide receivers chris godwin emeka egbuka jalen mcmillan and third round rookie ted hurst but he ll be without mike evans after the franchise legend left for the 49ers in free agency

news_mentions.headline: Rams rule out Aaron Donald for Week 1 game vs. 49ers in Australia
news_mentions.description: Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters on Tuesday that Aaron Donald will not play in Los Angeles' regular-season opener against the San Francisco 49ers in Melbourne, Australia.
news_mentions.body_text: aaron donald s return to nfl action will wait until at least the second week of the season rams head coach sean mcvay told reporters on tuesday that donald will not play in los angeles regular season opener against the san francisco 49ers in melbourne australia which kicks off at 8 35 p m et on thursday night i think he ll be ready to go sooner rather than later but we re making a decision that we think is best for him and for our team mcvay said it will add value when he s ready to go but being two years off retirement he s attacked this the right way but it would have been a really quick turnaround donald declined to discuss his plans for week 1 when speaking with reporters on monday feeling good feeling really good come up with a game plan and see donald said when asked if he planned to travel to australia donald reiterated the same message when asked if he would play period feeling really good he said come up with a game plan to see but i feel great feel really good well that game plan is now likely geared toward a week 2 return against the new york giants on monday sept 21 donald officially unretired on aug 30 to join the rams super bowl push and to be featured on a defensive line that already added myles garrett earlier this offseason while donald won t suit up at the melbourne cricket ground garrett will be in action after being limited during training camp and the preseason with a knee issue mcvay told reporters on tuesday that garrett will be ready to go the league s first ever regular season game down under per the orange county register

news_mentions.headline: Chiefs HC Andy Reid says Patrick Mahomes 'most likely' to start Week 1 vs. Broncos
news_mentions.description: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid told reporters on Tuesday that star quarterback Patrick Mahomes "most likely" will start Kansas City's Week 1 game against the Denver Broncos.
news_mentions.body_text: barring a stunning setback patrick mahomes will be on the field monday night in the season opener versus the denver broncos as far as our roster goes there s a very good chance that patrick will go ahead and start unless something were to come up here in the next couple days coach andy reid said tuesday most likely he ll be the guy that s out there it s about as strong a statement that reid needed to make given the expectation throughout the process has been that mahomes would be ready week 1 the two time mvp suffered tears to the acl and lcl in his left knee in mid december prematurely ending the only losing season of his nine year career since then mahomes has hit every mark on the timeline including being fully cleared in july for training camp he s shown everything there reid said tuesday he hasn t missed a day you guys have seen him out there so you know what it looks like him running around and doing his stuff other than having a brace on his leg everything looks normal he s running around the same way he s always done and throwing the ball like he s always done i think we ll be fine there frankly since the nfl announced the schedule with the chiefs in prime time for the first two weeks of the season the widespread expectation has been that mahomes would be under center to open the campaign nothing has nudged that assumption off course mahomes will make his return against the reigning afc west champs to open monday night football giddy up

news_mentions.headline: Patriots vs. Seahawks: Five must-know storylines for Wednesday's 2026 NFL Kickoff Game
news_mentions.description: Has New England solved its pass-protection woes? Will free-agent losses and injuries undermine Seattle? In advance of Wednesday's 2026 NFL Kickoff Game between the Patriots and Seahawks, Dan Parr provides five storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: our national nightmare is over after a 212 day break the nfl officially returns on wednesday night with the new england patriots visiting the seattle seahawks to kick off the 2026 season in an instant rematch of super bowl lx this is the 12th regular season game between teams that met in the previous super bowl per nfl research and the reigning champs are 8 3 in the previous 11 such rematches last we saw these two squads on the same field seattle s defense and running game dominated to the tune of a 29 13 victory can the patriots pull off an upset with marquee offseason acquisition a j brown in tow this time around five must know storylines 1 have the patriots solved their pass pro woes oc josh mcdaniels has vowed that wednesday s game will be different than super bowl lx pointing the finger at himself and saying seattle out everythinged new england last time out it s hard to argue that point considering the pats were scoreless through three quarters and fell behind by 19 before they finally put points on the board the offensive line clearly wasn t up to the challenge with mvp runner up drake maye taking 21 sacks in the playoffs the most in a single postseason in the super bowl era six of those sacks came via the seahawks new england is counting on improvement from within given four of the five offensive linemen who started in the super bowl are expected to be in the starting lineup on wednesday will a healthier and more seasoned will campbell provide better protection on the blind side how much of a difference does the signing of og alijah vera tucker make seahawks hc mike macdonald coaches defense in expert mode so we know he ll have leonard williams byron murphy uchenna nwosu demarcus lawrence dante fowler and derick hall ready to attack 2 can the seahawks spoil a j brown s patriots debut there s been plenty of hype around brown s arrival in foxborough this offseason including from yours truly and for good reason while his relationship with jalen hurts unraveled last year in philadelphia brown is now reunited with mike vrabel the head coach who helped the receiver blossom as his career began in tennessee the guy has posted 1 000 plus yards in six of his seven pro seasons and leads the nfl with 18 touchdowns on deep throws 20 plus air yds since 2022 per next gen stats he s the best receiver drake maye has been paired with which is probably a scary thought for most defenses i m guessing not so much for seattle s shutdown crew even though roster turnover and injuries more on those in a bit have the potential to create some vulnerabilities in a unit that seemed impenetrable at times last season the matchup between brown and devon witherspoon who was briefly the league s highest paid cornerback after signing an extension last month will be fun to watch 3 will the freshly minted highest paid cb shut down jsn speaking of wr1 cb1 matchups we ll see another great one when seattle s jaxon smith njigba the reigning offensive player of the year lines up across from new england s christian gonzalez it was gonzalez s new four year 135 million extension reportedly agreed to as of tuesday morning that moved devon witherspoon from first to second among the league s highest paid cornerbacks the deal ended a months long dispute that crescendoed with questions about whether the pro bowl corner would even play in the season opener outside of drake maye gonzalez is the most indispensable player on the roster and now he s being paid like it how will he fare in his first game since his long awaited payday in super bowl lx new england held smith njigba to four catches for 27 yards 6 8 per on 10 targets his fewest receiving yards in an nfl game where he was targeted eight or more times 4 will the seahawks be shorthanded in the secondary suddenly things are looking quite thin in the back end of the defending champions defense they lost s coby bryant and cb riq woolen in free agency but the week 1 status for two starters they are counting on in 2026 is now in question nickelback nick emmanwori a key piece in seattle s super bowl run last season has been limited in practice which isn t a surprise as he works his way back from offseason ankle surgery the unexpected development was the addition of s ty okada bryant s replacement to the injury report with a hamstring ailment editor s update ty okada has been ruled out of wednesday s game also the seahawks lost rookie s bud clark for the season to a broken ankle he suffered in the second preseason game on cutdown day seattle traded a draft pick for an undrafted rookie cb avery smith to shore things up the hawks still have the aforementioned devon witherspoon and trusted vets in julian love and josh jobe plus mike macdonald s defensive front is more than capable of masking deficiencies in the back end but if drake maye gets the protection to do so the pats passer will surely be testing this new version of seattle s secondary down the field 5 is jadarian price ready for prime time last but not least the game s most intriguing thing to watch for fantasy football heads might be the debut of seahawks first round rb jadarian price he was never the rb1 in college playing in the shadow of jeremiyah love at notre dame and folks are anxious to see how big of a workload the hawks are willing to give him right off the bat the athletic s andrew destin recently wrote that he expects seattle to play price on early downs and then pull him for rb george holani in goal line third down and short yardage situations former packers rb emanuel wilson is in the mix for carries too that would take a big bite out of price s fantasy appeal but not all rbs are ready for three down duty from day 1 super bowl lx mvp kenneth walker departed for kansas city in free agency while zach charbonnet is opening the season on the pup list as he works his way back from the acl tear he suffered in january so it s on the trio of price holani and wilson to put qb sam darnold in the manageable situations where he can thrive

news_mentions.headline: NFL Films celebrates 50th anniversary of 'Inside the NFL'
news_mentions.description: NFL Films is celebrating the 50th Anniversary of Inside the NFL and its second season on X as an X Original, premiering Wednesday, Sept. 9.
news_mentions.body_text: nfl films is celebrating the 50th anniversary of inside the nfl and its second season on x as an x original premiering wednesday sept 9 inside the nfl will deliver fans premium football content every day throughout the season with hundreds of short form clips mic d up moments and game edits exclusively on x for 50 seasons inside the nfl has been the definitive source for weekly nfl films highlights showcasing previously unseen angles of pivotal game action and behind the scenes audio inside the nfl has been a defining part of nfl films legacy for 50 years said keith cossrow nfl films vice president and head of content as we celebrate this milestone we re excited to bring the series back to x for a second season and deliver its iconic storytelling unparalleled access and distinctive style to fans around the world after an incredible first season we re thrilled to bring inside the nfl back to x and continue reimagining one of the most iconic franchises in sports television said mitchell smith global head of content partnerships x as the series celebrates 50 years of bringing fans closer to the game x is the place to give that legacy a new life delivering premium access driven storytelling directly to the fans who are already talking about the nfl in real time the second season of inside the nfl will also be featured on the newly launched nfl gametime on x a new fan experience that brings real time scores and stats official team content news creators and the ongoing nfl conversation together in one destination integrated throughout the platform inside the nfl is built around the moments personalities and access that fans can t get anywhere else smith added by bringing that content to x quickly and putting it directly into the center of the nfl conversation we re giving fans a new way to experience a legendary franchise while creating even more opportunities to watch react and engage together

across all major fast platforms nfl the nfl s youtube channel and the nfl app additionally kessler will contribute to coverage of events such as the super bowl nfl scouting combine and nfl draft news_mentions.headline: Patriots-Seahawks in 2026 NFL Kickoff Game: What We Learned from Seattle's 13-10 win
news_mentions.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
news_mentions.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame nfl pro insight for patriots seahawks drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 1 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Can Josh Allen and the Bills flip the script on the Texans' ferocious defense? Do the Buccaneers or Bengals prevail in a potential shootout? Will the Cowboys get off on the right foot against the Giants? Check out the Week 1 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 1 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on wednesday sept 9 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns blazing and never lets williams settle in things could easily swing in the home team s favor unfortunately the panthers will be without the player who was supposed to be phillips top running mate off the edge as carolina s sacks co leader from last season nic scourton is out for the season with an acl tear if the game does turn into a shootout a distinct possibility i m leaning toward i like the bears chances a bit better why bobby picked the bengals cincinnati admittedly seems to have a bit of an early season curse the bengals finally broke a three year week 1 losing streak in 2025 only for joe burrow to suffer a long term toe injury the following game however burrow has been healthy and striking an optimistic tone in the lead up to the new season stating he s trying to manifest a return to the super bowl and can feel this bengals squad is different in my bones i believe him buccaneers versus bengals figures to be one of the most explosive matchups of the nfl s opening week cincinnati has more firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries there are likely still some growing pains to work through in that process which could allow for cincy s rebuilt dexter lawrence led defense to provide burrow with just enough of a buffer why gennaro picked the lions immediately following a disappointing 2025 season that saw detroit quadruple its loss total from 2024 dan campbell gave himself a freaking f and stressed that the lions needed to get that hunger back earlier this week campbell said new orleans is a hungry opponent so whose appetite will be satiated on sunday the lions feast at ford field as the league s highest scoring home team in three of the past four seasons including the 25 campaign in fact detroit dropped a 50 burger on chicago in last year s home opener and while it s reasonable to be concerned about the lions offensive line it s equally reasonable to be underwhelmed by the saints d line now new orleans second year signal caller tyler shough might take advantage of detroit s depleted secondary points could be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with preseason mvp front runner josh allen taking on the baddest defense on the planet granted buffalo also boasts the reigning nfl rushing king james cook a brand new wr1 dj moore and a highly cohesive offensive line but i m still backing the texans loaded d after all demeco ryans crew has gotten the best of allen in each of the past two seasons holding the quarterback to a career low 30 percent completions in 2024 and subjecting him to a career high eight sacks in 2025 both of those texans wins came in houston where this sunday s tilt will take place oh and for buffalo s offensive play caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an offensive groove takes time in week 1 give me the home team with the hellacious defense why dan picked the ravens while the colts had the epic collapse losing seven straight games to close out last season both teams are going to be eager to remove the bitter taste of a disappointing 2025 from their mouths first year ravens head coach jesse minter has an opportunity to prove his worth right away against an offense that scored in bunches when qb daniel jones was healthy last year minter needs no reminder of that fact as the colts went on the road and dropped 38 on his chargers in week 7 the most points allowed by the bolts all season can the defensive guru avenge that loss with his new crew on paper he has the weaponry to make it happen it will certainly help if jones is at all rusty in his first game back since tearing his achilles in december the biggest question for ball knowers around the league though is whether lamar jackson has his swagger back after not performing to his usual standard much in an injury plagued 2025 will new oc declan doyle previously ben johnson s apprentice launch a rejuvenated jackson into orbit against a long struggling colts defense that didn t add much sizzle in the offseason maybe it s wishful thinking but i d like to believe the two time mvp still has enough in the tank to outlast a frisky indy offense why bobby picked the jaguars there aren t a ton of logical paths to a cleveland victory the browns turned back to deshaun watson who was outplayed by shedeur sanders in the preseason but nonetheless won the starting job production from the wide receiver room will depend heavily on rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston mastering the learning curve while running back quinshon judkins is coming off a serious season ending injury oh and cleveland s defense is without myles garrett for the first time in a decade it s a lot for newbie head coach todd monken and his rookie defensive coordinator mike rutenberg to juggle the jaguars conversely are looking to build on a 13 win season trevor lawrence found his stride under coach liam coen and now enters year 2 in the system with a loaded pass catching group jacksonville s defense also boasts playmakers at every level considering where the jaguars see their 2026 season going they shouldn t run into much trouble hosting the browns why jeremy picked the steelers one of these teams is comfortable in its own skin the other has zero identity at the most important position in sports mike mccarthy and kevin stefanski both enter sunday s game with something to prove out of the gate starting their third and second stints as head coaches respectively mccarthy benefits from having a familiar friend at the controls of his offense in greybeard aaron rodgers stefanski on the other hand spent the summer playing coy about who his starting qb would be between tua tagovailoa and michael penix the latter who boasts more upside only returned to practice two weeks ago leaving tagovailoa as stefanki s only true option against pittsburgh specified as only a week 1 starter tua appears to have a short leash in atlanta about as long as penix s recovery or 60 minutes on sunday rodgers did not play at all in the preseason so rust for the tinfoil man is a possibility but once he warms up the four time mvp should have his way with michael pittman dk metcalf and pat freiermuth against a falcons pass rush neutered by the loss of second year standouts jalon walker injury and james pearce suspension why jeremy picked the jets don t call it a revenge game at least that s what robert saleh and aaron glenn are preaching ahead of the former s first game as head coach against his former team both tennessee and new york are keeping the main thing the main thing which is rebounding from an awful 2025 with a week 1 victory something that eluded each side the last two campaigns in fact the only first week win from either organization since 2021 came in aaron rodgers infamous four snap debut which in case you memory holed it ended in an overtime win for saleh s jets in short a week 1 victory for tennessee or new york is rare and should be cherished on the titans defensive front ex jets jermaine johnson and john franklin myers will surely be licking their chops to stick it to their old squad alongside all world dt jeffery simmons but the jets are as well equipped on offense as they ve been in years their offensive line is sturdy and consistent and their weapons finally go two deep and while cam ward s first unit struggled this preseason geno smith and co flourished in their limited action a veteran gang green squad has just enough to outlast this green tennessee team it won t be pretty but it s week 1 when nothing is more stylish than a 1 0 record why jeremy picked the chargers in what figures to be the most lopsided result of week 1 outside of duval county the chargers are in prime position to get off to an electric start our brief glimpses of justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense this summer were straight gas and as long as jake slaughter holds up at center in his first career start against walter nolen josh sweat and arizona s pass rush los angeles should carry that momentum into the regular season with ease first year head coach mike lafleur vs football lifer jim harbaugh is not a fair fight at least not in week 1 i see a big halftime lead dwindling down the stretch as jacoby brissett trey mcbride michael wilson and co play well from behind as they so often did in 2025 but the result will never be in doubt bolts big why brooke picked the raiders the raiders drew the long end of the stick by hosting the dolphins in the opener there are question marks littered throughout miami s 2026 roster specifically on the offensive side of the ball rb de 39 von achane is in position to carry another heavy load this season as qb malik willis navigates his first campaign as a full time starter with a wr corps that s royally inexperienced there s potential there looking at you caleb douglas and chris bell but the success won t happen overnight expect the raiders defense to force willis to beat them through the air which won t be an easy feat with maxx crosby back in tow the raiders have fewer question marks and more talent across the board the offense appears better than the unit that scored a league low 14 2 points per game with geno smith in 2025 kirk cousins has the reins for now and his steady quarterbacking will be a warm welcome for raiders fans near and far plus ashton jeanty ankle should be good to go on sunday and brock bowers is primed to do more brock bowers things in year 3 editor s update after publishing on wednesday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday and is expected to miss a game or two one final note from the nfl research team this is the sixth game in the last 30 seasons in which both head coaches are making their nfl debuts with the home coach winning three of the previous five such games that s another aspect that bodes well for klint kubiak why brooke picked the vikings how will kyler murray look under kevin o connell s tutelage we re about to find out in what will be a rocking u s bank stadium full of vikings fans ready to forget the qb conundrum of 2025 as a vikings fan myself i don t feel as if the qb play can get worse than what i witnessed last season i sure hope that s true these nfc north matchups are always competitive but this particular one feels more about what the packers lost this offseason than what the vikings gained green bay begins the 2026 campaign without superstar pass rusher micah parsons and rb josh jacobs an instrumental part of matt lafleur s offense in recent seasons who s currently on the commissioner s exempt list that backfield will now feature marshawn lloyd kaleb johnson and chris brooks the only one with more than 100 career rush yards meaning brian flores defense should expect a heavy dose of jordan love s arm ultimately missing two big time starters will be too much to overcome for the road team why gennaro picked the eagles this matchup would have garnered a whole lot more attention in week 1 of last season when it could ve served as an instant rematch of the previous campaign s nfc title game but these two division rivals have gone in different directions since they met on championship sunday back in late january of 2025 philadelphia of course went on to win its second super bowl that february and although the eagles dealt with their fair share of drama this past season they still became the nfc east s first repeat winners in 21 years washington meanwhile completely came apart in 2025 injuries spoiled jayden daniels sophomore effort while dan quinn s defense gave up the most yards in the league gm adam peters aggressively rebuilt the commanders d in free agency and the draft but i m not convinced that ll be a quick fix more concerningly i have serious doubts about daniels supporting cast especially the laremy tunsil less offensive line that s a recipe for disaster against vic fangio s defense sure the eagles edge group has question marks but the front is spearheaded by the devastating dt duo of jalen carter and jordan davis even if jayden can avoid those 650 pounds of pain philly has two athletic linebackers zack baun and jihaad campbell to track the fleet footed quarterback and a pair of first team all pro cover men quinyon mitchell and cooper dejean to close his passing lanes nick sirianni improves to 6 0 in week 1 why brooke picked the giants i know the cowboys have dominated this division rivalry recently winning 16 of their last 18 meetings going back to 2017 despite new york prevailing in week 18 last season dallas pulled its starters at halftime but this game feels like a massive opportunity for the giants to course correct after an offseason full of change john harbaugh is captaining the ship cam skattebo is healthy malik nabers could be on the verge of returning after missing a majority of last season odell beckham is back and no 5 overall draft pick arvell reese joined one of the league s scariest pass rushes at least on paper so yeah these aren t last year s giants these aren t last year s cowboys either dallas defense which ranked dead last in scoring d and 30th in yards allowed in 2025 was overhauled in the offseason with a new coordinator christian parker and an influx of talent including a pair of first round rookies in caleb downs and malachi lawrence that unit has plenty to prove so too does an offensive line that was put under some extra pressure this week with the injury to pro bowl lg tyler smith a development that throws fourth year pro tj bass into the fire you can t get all caught up in the statistical weeds for week 1 because we don t truly know what the 2026 iterations of these clubs look like i have to lean into the vibes and my gut we re talking prime time at metlife this just feels like big blue s super bowl monday sept 14 why jeremy picked the broncos there is so much intrigue going into this week 1 finale that i m almost embarrassed by my curiosity with the most overexposed nfl franchise of the past half decade but that s what patrick mahomes does his absence magnifies his presence could he actually be all the way back from last year s devastating knee injury was 2025 the fluke of flukes or a harbinger of something worse to come for andy reid and friends similarly for denver is bo nix all healed and ready to take mahomes mantle as king of the division or was his first year atop the west an illusion of how things could be monday night won t provide definitive answers but it should feature solid if unremarkable play for both sides mahomes will knock off the rust the broncos will play well but keep kansas city around with turnovers and a fourth quarter score perhaps by offseason addition jaylen waddle will fittingly be the deciding factor no shootout in the first wild afc west matchup of the season but last year s trends outsized broncos success chiefs woes in one score games will make their mark on this year s opener wednesday s game why dan picked the seahawks i m expecting a much more competitive contest than what we saw when the patriots and seahawks met in february a 29 13 shellacking by seattle mainly because i have concerns about the condition of the hawks run game and the back end of the defense as you might recall those two facets played leading roles in propelling mike macdonald s team to the top last season the sb lx mvp kenneth walker departed in the offseason and zach charbonnet is on the pup list that means rookie jadarian price and third year pro george holani who has made his bones on special teams so far will be asked to carry the bulk of the rushing load are they up to the challenge against a defense that didn t allow a 100 yard rusher until week 12 last season also the seahawks lost safety coby bryant and corner riq woolen in free agency they will be without starting safety ty okada while nickelback nick emmanwori is questionable to play as he returns from ankle surgery any coverage breakdowns as the new secondary gains its footing could be costly against an offense undoubtedly anxious to feature marquee offseason acquisition a j brown ultimately i don t trust the patriots offensive line last seen being ripped to shreds by seattle s fearsome front enough to pick the upset but i do believe in oc josh mcdaniels promise that the rematch will be different thursday s game why bobby picked the 49ers it s nearly impossible to enter a campaign with as much hype as the rams los angeles was already enjoying a promising offseason having added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson when general manager les snead swung a trade for the single season sack king myles garrett it was such a seismic move that three time defensive player of the year aaron donald came out of retirement can such exultant vibes carry over to the field in week 1 which is often a toss up anyway after a roughly 16 hour flight to australia i m not sold there s a lot of injury or load management situations to consider on both sides george kittle nick bosa garrett donald not traveling to australia etc so that doesn t necessarily move the needle on rosters that are formidable with or without a few of the bigger stars the kyle shanahan sean mcvay rivalry doesn t give too much away either although shanahan is 11 8 against mcvay los angeles has won four of the past five contests where i and many others sporting large under eye bags draw the line is sleep while the 49ers flew to melbourne to acclimate a week ahead of the showdown the rams are jetting in 24 hours before the game hoping to keep their bodies on pacific time for a whirlwind victory before turning right around and traveling home sleep scientists are divided on the vastly different approaches but san francisco s feels safer if rams players experience post travel fatigue there s no time to fix it visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: Christian McCaffrey: Absence from practices was 'part of the plan from the jump'
news_mentions.description: San Francisco 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey returned to practice on Sunday for the first time since Aug. 8.
news_mentions.body_text: george kittle getting activated from the physically unable to perform list wasn t the only positive news from san francisco on sunday star 49ers running back christian mccaffrey also returned to the practice field cmc participated in team drills for the first time since aug 8 as he dealt with tightness for a fortnight the running back said that the time off was part of the plan to ensure he s ready for another long season obviously when you don t practice the way the media works now is a firestorm mccaffrey said via nbc sports bay area this was kind of part of the plan from the jump to ramp up pretty big get nine or 10 practices in kind of come back down and then ramp up again so we re fresh for the duration our staff has done a great job of coming up with specific plans and i feel great i feel fresh and it s great to get back out there with mccaffrey sitting out practices rumors began to fly from questions about his injury status to speculation that his absence was contract related interestingly the 49ers brass could have simply said the rb s absence was a plan of sorts from the beginning but did not mccaffrey dismissed the stories and noted that sometimes he needs to be protected from his own competitive nature sometimes i can probably be my own worst enemy in how much i love being out there mccaffrey said i want to run i want to go i want every play i m a competitor i love it and i think when you have people smarter than you that understand not just what you ve been through but what we plan on doing this season it s about being fresh for the duration and it s about 17 sundays and god willing more weeks after that following an injury plagued 2024 season in which he played just four games cmc touched the pigskin 413 times including 311 carries a career high last season managing the offseason makes sense for a player vital to the niners success in 2026

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former
