news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Sam Darnold expected to miss Seahawks' Week 2 game, but avoids major hip injury
news_mentions.description: The Seahawks will be without Sam Darnold for at least a game, but the quarterback appears to have avoided a long-term issue.
news_mentions.body_text: the seattle seahawks will be without sam darnold for at least a game but the quarterback appears to have avoided a long term issue darnold is expected to miss next week s tilt against the arizona cardinals nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on thursday rapoport added that darnold could miss just a few weeks but has avoided a lengthy absence darnold exited wednesday s 13 10 win over the new england patriots after just five plays due to a hip injury that occurred on a sack the qb limped to the locker room in obvious discomfort coach mike macdonald noted on an appearance on seattle sports 710 radio that the club got really really good news on darnold s hip but declined to put the qb on a timetable we re praying for sam but not like worrying because it s just what it is macdonald said the hip is intact and it s good it s more of a muscle thing macdonald told seahawks reporters during his thursday news conference that he did not have any new information regarding darnold s status but that he hoped by monday to have a really accurate picture of a plan of attack and what we ll do that week the date of the week 1 injury gives the seahawks extra days for darnold to rest there are 18 days between wednesday s tilt and a week 3 matchup against the washington commanders given how quickly darnold was ruled out it would be very good news if the qb only missed a lone game if it is indeed a one or two week injury the seahawks will roll with drew lock as their spot starter starting at arizona in week 2

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Patriots WR A.J. Brown suffered high ankle sprain, expected to miss at least four weeks
news_mentions.description: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown (ankle) was ruled out of Wednesday's Kickoff Game against the Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: a j brown s much ballyhooed debut with the new england patriots came to an abrupt conclusion wednesday night brown injured his ankle early in the third quarter and was ruled out of the nfl kickoff game which the patriots lost to the host seattle seahawks 13 10 the new england receiver suffered a high ankle sprain an mri confirmed on thursday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported brown is expected to miss at least four weeks according to rapoport which is standard with high ankle sprains the three time pro bowl wide receiver went for a low throw from drake maye with seahawks cornerback nehemiah pritchett defending and deflecting the ball pritchett s knee came down on brown s right ankle and the wideout immediately grabbed the ankle brown who was playing in his first game for the pats since he was acquired in an offseason trade from the philadelphia eagles was attended to on the field before limping off to the blue tent he was then accompanied by trainers to the locker room where he underwent x rays prior to his exit brown had three receptions on four targets for 26 yards all of those numbers team highs at the time his biggest contribution was drawing a massive 34 yard pass interference penalty that put the pats on the seahawks 2 yard line to set up the game s opening score brown 29 has played in at least 13 games in each of his seven nfl seasons but he has missed at least two games in each of his last two with philadelphia

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 1: Ranking all 32 starters entering 2026 season
news_mentions.description: With the 2026 NFL season upon us, Nick Shook ranks each team's quarterback, from 1 to 32, heading into Week 1. Who ranks above reigning MVP Matthew Stafford? Is Caleb Williams ready to build on his breakout campaign?
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl is back with another season and so too is the qb index as a reminder this is a season long weekly ranking of quarterbacks that will be grouped into tiers these rankings are fluid and starters will be in and out of this list just as they are in their own lineups let s check in with where i see all 32 starting quarterbacks at the start of the 2026 nfl season tier 1 while used facetiously in the great joe flacco debate of the 2010s the term elite is reserved for the very best here we have three nfl mvps and a finalist in only his second season it s a group that commands instant recognition and immediate respect from every opposing defense they are all elite and each comes with great expectations josh allen welcomed veteran receiver dj moore to buffalo in the offseason and appears to be on track for a honeymoon year with moore which could elevate buffalo s offense and push allen to the front of the mvp pack once again matthew stafford just produced his best season at 37 years old and returns to lead a premier offense as part of a loaded super bowl favorite drake maye nearly won mvp last season and led his patriots to an unlikely super bowl appearance he returned to casually welcome in a j brown and romeo doubs to a corps that is now so strong new england had to trade away a former maye favorite in kayshon boutte and finally we have patrick mahomes one of the faces of the nfl over the last half decade who is in the middle of his greatest challenge of his career returning from an acl injury the chiefs and mahomes are optimistic but we won t truly know where he stands until he takes the field in week 1 for now his reputation earns him this spot tier 2 this is where the money is and will be made in 2026 it s about time people put some respect on dak prescott s name which should happen if he maintains his standard of play and benefits from an improved as of now on paper cowboys defense joe burrow has many goals but one matters more than the others stay healthy justin herbert can remind the world of his talents if his offensive line can stay healthy and the current progress report is positive lamar jackson has to accomplish the same while finding his place in another new offense which is directed by first time coordinator declan doyle sam darnold is coming off a super bowl triumph in which he played an important role but took a backseat to his team s incredible defense we ll all remember how excellent he was on the road to super bowl lx before long jared goff and the lions have plenty to prove after missing the playoffs last season although their offensive line concerns me and could be an issue if it doesn t collectively elevate its play in 2026 caleb williams was one of my favorite quarterbacks to watch in 2025 both because of his exceptional talent and his ability to deliver in the clutch all while fully embracing ben johnson s offense with a better understanding of the nfl game s speed after a rocky rookie season he landed on the madden nfl cover for a reason folks and will be central to chicago s goal of defending its nfc north title jordan love and coach matt lafleur both need to rinse the bad taste from 2025 from their mouths and fortunately love is plenty capable of doing so in entertaining fashion trevor lawrence hopped back on the radars of many and climbed these rankings by marrying perfectly with liam coen s offense using his legs more and producing the best version of himself in his pro career he s perhaps the most fascinating subject of this whole group can he and coen do it again and build upon the successes they enjoyed in the second half of 2025 tier 3 injuries unfortunately hampered a significant portion of this group baker mayfield played through multiple ailments and saw his performance suffer jayden daniels tried his best to do the same and ultimately missed 10 games daniel jones scintillating start was derailed by injury brock purdy was sidelined for nearly half of the season due to injury and bo nix missed his chance to power the broncos to the super bowl due to his ankle injury with all of this considered perhaps this is the redemption tier each of these quarterbacks has points to prove and even those who didn t encounter health challenges have important goals on their season checklists will c j stroud wash his hands of his disastrous playoff exit and prove he s still the face of the texans future can jalen hurts return to excellence under new oc sean mannion after the dreadful experience that was the 2025 season can geno smith show the football world that he wasn t the problem in las vegas and can still sling it with some of the best the performances of this group will undoubtedly alter the qb index landscape in 2026 for better or worse tier 4 we ve arrived at the making the leap tier where tyler shough jaxson dart and cam ward enter year 2 with plenty of promise coupled with pressure to deliver shough enters atop the group because of the fashion in which he produced to finish the 2025 season opening the eyes of many to the quarterback s potential as a partner with coach kellen moore dart electrified new york city last season showing promise and an undying competitive fire that propelled him to a 2 759 scrimmage yard rookie season and also subjected him to frequent visits to the blue medical tent that s where dart will need to improve most while fitting into new oc matt nagy s offense if he can do that giants fans are expecting him to solidify his place as the team s future under center ward s promising first season has titans fans hoping his first campaign under new oc brian daboll produces significant progress but right now it s nothing more than an aspiration bryce young needs to prove he s carolina s future after a tumultuous season that saw the panthers reach the playoffs but with an 8 9 record and finally kyler murray arrives in minnesota as kevin o connell s chosen solution for the franchise s quarterback woes but he too needs to prove he s worthy of the opportunity after fizzling out of arizona if all goes well each quarterback has a chance to climb as of now though the focus is on producing tangible improvement tier 5 this is the grizzled veteran trio aaron rodgers kirk cousins and jacoby brissett have each seen plenty in their nfl careers and the first two are likely entrenched in their places this is rodgers final season and will probably be cousins final starting job unless he thrives in his limited time and attracts interest elsewhere in 2027 the outlier is brissett an experienced and skilled quarterback who also isn t interested in making financial sacrifices in the name of opportunity he found a good spot in arizona negotiated a fully guaranteed one year deal and will begin his 11th nfl season with just enough security and leverage to prove he s worthy of a starting job he ll climb these rankings if he can capitalize on the assortment of talent surrounding him trey mcbride marvin harrison michael wilson and rookie jeremiyah love but he can t waste too much time with intriguing rookie carson beck sitting on the bench tier 6 like the pioneers we are only taking our first steps into our great westward journey exploration awaits and it comes with the admission that we don t know much how will malik willis in his first opportunity to own a starting job in his career fare with a limited supporting cast a first time head coach and an offensive coordinator aiming to repair his play calling reputation can tua tagovailoa find enough consistency to hold onto the job beyond week 1 and how long will deshaun watson last as the browns starter my guess is two weeks for those keeping track generally we re venturing into the unknown which offers the promise of great wonder and surprise or disaster

news_mentions.headline: Patriots QB Drake Maye on loss to Seahawks: My impatience 'cost us the game'
news_mentions.description: New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye threw three interceptions that led to a 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks in the 2026 season opener.
news_mentions.body_text: new england patriots quarterback drake maye threw away a chance to swipe the season opening game in a super bowl rematch against the seattle seahawks falling 13 10 following a game sealing interception the pats controlled much of the first half after the super bowl champs lost starting qb sam darnold five plays into the contest after new england took a 10 0 lead early in the third quarter things unraveled for maye who threw three ints on the patriots final three possessions the third year qb blamed impatience on the trio of errors yeah we had the game under control maye said thought we had a good plan to start chipping away and be patient and lost patience and it cost us decisions that cost us the game on my part on my end i vow to myself to be better and realize it s a long season but at same time we can t have those we can t have those it s unacceptable and i know we got to get back to work that wasn t how i play football and how i want to represent my game and playing quarterback for the patriots maye completed 23 of his 33 pass attempts for 178 yards one touchdown and a career high three interceptions the bulk of his production came on short tosses and dump offs he went 20 of 23 on attempts of under 10 air yards for 134 yards and a touchdown 8 9 cpoe maye struggled downfield 10 air yards connecting on just three of eight attempts for 44 yards and three ints 12 7 cpoe all three of his picks came on deep attempts 20 air yards two more than he threw all last season 1 the three ints flipped the script as the pats watched a road win slip away you can t throw three interceptions coach mike vrabel said drake knows that we put ourselves in some long yardage situations on the one that was probably forced and i think the guy made a great play on the last one the last one was the most egregious after trailing for the first time in the contest maye helped drive to the seahawks 16 with several solid throws and using his legs to pick up pivotal first downs however his impatience again reared its head in range for the game tying field goal with 26 seconds remaining maye forced a pass to mack hollins in the end zone that came up woefully short it was a bad decision and horrific execution i didn t put enough on it to get it out and it was just unacceptable maye said we had a chance to send it to overtime at the worst the only thing you could do is turn the ball over and that s what i did early maye was content to take what the defense gave him and did a far better job finding outlets versus the seahawk pressure packages than during the super bowl however late he began to hunt big plays that weren t there and got burned i just stopped being patient he said that was the big thing we were really good up to the point where i tried to force one down the sideline to romeo doubs we were patient and dumping it off and trying to move the chains and we avoided a lot of three and outs and that was something we try to earn more plays and the explosives will come so just stopped being patient and made decisions that ended up like i said cost us the game maye had no choice but to wear this l this one can t be blamed on the o line or poor calls the qb simply had a horrible string of decisions that cost his club it burns now and it was truly a brutal performance but there is a lot of season ahead reminder the pats lost week 1 to the raiders last year and still made the super bowl how maye bounces back will say far more than one wednesday game in september it s such a long season vrabel said we re going to hold our head up high and we have nothing but the utmost confidence in him and everybody on this football team and he s going to make a lot of plays for us

news_mentions.headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold will undergo MRI; hip fracture ruled out after win over Patriots
news_mentions.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold suffered a hip injury on Seattle's first drive Wednesday night against the Patriots and was ruled out and replaced by Drew Lock.
news_mentions.body_text: the seahawks are breathing a sigh of relief both after a second half comeback victory to open the season and due to the latest update on quarterback sam darnold s health darnold who was ruled out just prior to halftime of wednesday s 13 10 season opening win over the patriots due to a hip injury is still having tests done but a hip fracture has been ruled out head coach mike macdonald said postgame macdonald described the results of darnold s testing as great news though the team still does not know the extent of the qb s injury darnold underwent a ct scan on his hip at the harborview medical center in seattle and received encouraging but inconclusive results per espn s adam schefter who added darnold is scheduled to undergo an mri on thursday darnold suffered his injury during seattle s first drive a five play 30 yard march when he was sacked on third down by dre 39 mont jones trainers did not initially attend to the qb on the sideline but he went to the blue tent during new england s opening possession drew lock then entered the game in relief while darnold limped to the locker room as seattle s offense took the field for a second time darnold was 1 of 2 for 13 yards before sustaining the injury with the seahawks and pats knotted at 0 seattle s offense went silent without darnold the patriots were able to open up a 7 0 lead over the course of the first half as lock proved unable to lead any of his five drives into enemy territory the seahawks became just the third reigning super bowl champion to get shut out in the first half of their season opener joining the 1984 raiders and 1967 packers per nfl research like those raiders and packers teams who recovered for a win and a tie respectively seattle would not lose the defense played tremendously allowing only a field goal the rest of the way and ending all three of new england s fourth quarter possessions with interceptions including an end zone pick by joshua jobe with 21 seconds remaining to seal the victory seattle s smothering defense allowed lock just enough opportunity as the seahawks overcame a double digit deficit with two field goals and a 45 yard touchdown reception by jaxon smith njigba making lock the first backup qb in nfl history to throw a td in a reigning super bowl champion s season opener he was buoyed by the defense s stellar performance but lock protected the ball and showed why he s one of the league s more trusted reserves going 16 of 22 for 187 yards and the aforementioned td it remains to be seen how many games if any darnold will miss but at least for wednesday night the seahawks found a winning formula in his absence

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Raiders TE Brock Bowers undergoes knee procedure, expected to miss a game or two
news_mentions.description: Las Vegas Raiders tight end Brock Bowers is expected to miss a game or two after undergoing a meniscus trim this week, NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported Wednesday.
news_mentions.body_text: the raiders will start the 2026 season without their top weapon tight end brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday in dallas and is expected to miss a game or two nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported wednesday bowers injury occurred during camp but wasn t diagnosed until last week leading to this week s procedure per rapoport and schefter wednesday s news represents the latest health related hurdle encountered by bowers over the last year fresh off a stellar rookie season bowers suffered a knee injury early in the 2025 season forcing him to miss three games in october and hampering the star pass catcher throughout the campaign given an offseason to recover which began early when bowers sat out of the raiders final two games of 2025 the hope was that bowers would be able to return fully healthy and at the form he displayed in his first nfl season his attempt to do so will be interrupted by the surgery which shouldn t keep him out long but does inspire some concern about how he ll perform in 2026 las vegas selected bowers no 13 overall in the 2024 draft and it immediately paid off via a 112 catch 1 194 yard five touchdown rookie season for the georgia product instantly vaulting bowers into elite status among nfl tight ends his health struggles hindered las vegas offense tremendously in 2025 underscoring his importance to the raiders offensive plans they ll begin 2026 in a familiar place without him while maintaining hope this is merely a bump in bowers road las vegas hosts the miami dolphins at 4 25 p m et on sunday

news_mentions.headline: Niners vs. Rams: Three must-know storylines for NFL's first-ever game in Australia
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Jeremy Bergman breaks down three must-know storylines in Thursday night's game between the San Francisco 49ers and Los Angeles Rams in Melbourne, Australia.
news_mentions.body_text: are you ready for some footy a thursday night friday morning party depending on your location the 49ers rams season opener promises to be one for the history books not just because it s the first regular season nfl contest to be played in australia or that it ll take place at a 172 year old cricket ground nearly a belichick older than soldier field or that it could begin on a friday and end on a thursday time zones maaaaan more simply this clash between the california rivals is set to stand out more for what happens on the pitch than off it los angeles the reigning nfc runner up loaded up on star power ahead of sofi stadium s second super bowl hosting gig jaylen watson trent mcduffie myles garrett aaron donald they re all wearing royal and sol these days so too are returning stars matthew stafford puka nacua and davante adams it s as stacked a cast as we ve seen in hollywood since ocean s eleven will sean mcvay s 11 get off on the right foot in week 1 their old nemeses from up north are in the way san francisco returns many of its notable names brock purdy is handing off the ball to christian mccaffrey and throwing it to george kittle while fred warner and nick bosa are set to wreak havoc on defense there were a few big returns and additions especially in the receiver room deebo samuel is back after a year on the hill while san francisco added mr 1 000 mike evans and rookie de 39 zhaun stribling to the corps but for the most part it s a familiar 49ers outfit that s set for a familiar matchup in an unfamiliar setting since 2017 when kyle shanahan and mcvay were hired in their respective locales san francisco has won 11 of 19 games played against the rams but this is the first time the two will face off in week 1 thursday night s tussle is the first week 1 game between division opponents that each had at least 12 wins the previous season in 15 years per nfl research the aussies are in for a treat and i m not talking vegemite three must know storylines 1 will rams revamped defense still dominate as expected sans donald all offseason no debut was more hotly anticipated than myles garrett s in los angeles then came aaron donald out of retirement and into the fearsome fivesome stealing garrett s thunder with just 11 days to prepare from signing to game day donald quickly became the most curious case of week 1 but to the chagrin of all football fans outside of the bay area the defensive tackle will be held out of thursday s opener instead watching from where he watched the last rams two seasons his couch even without a d there s still plenty of intrigue surrounding l a s defense with garrett mcduffie and watson debuting there s no preparing for the threat of the reigning defensive player of the year especially when he s surrounded by kobie turner braden fiske and byron young expect l a to try to throw san francisco s offensive line off its bearings from the jump especially on the interior without donald and garrett the rams boasted a 40 2 pressure percentage in 2025 second in the nfl with at least garrett on the field on thursday night brock purdy will surely be feeling the heat the question is whether los angeles kansas city style secondary will get bbq d by san francisco s spicy new look receiving corps the niners wr rams cb matchups will be brand new at all levels and therefore unpredictable purdy didn t have much success against the rams last he played them in 2024 but he s undefeated in season openers something s gotta give 2 can 49ers put their unusual summer behind them san francisco s offseason was one to forget to summarize for the uninitiated the niner gang s strange summer included electrical substation conspiracy theories kyle shanahan s car crash which resulted in a concussion and missed time during training camp ricky pearsall s latest setback and placement on season ending injured reserve and owner jed york s arrest in ohio adding to the off field anxiety around the team have been the absences of george kittle and nick bosa for most of training camp and preseason though the star tight end and pass rusher are on track to play in week 1 after their season ending injuries in 2025 will the turbulence of the last two months translate to on field agita for the 49ers they ve overcome a number of injuries in the past to remain competitive san francisco s 2025 run to the divisional round is a recent prime example the leadership core remains intact and the offensive additions of mike evans and de zhaun stribling provide exciting unpredictability to shanahan s offense once thursday hits the 49ers can officially turn the page from their odd offseason to a regular season rhythm but will the stink of the summer linger into week 1 and beyond 3 will travel have any effect niners rams in oz will be a study of a contrast in styles not on field though the rams reliance on 13 personnel and the 49ers league high rate of pre snap motion in 2025 do present archetypal differences no san francisco and los angeles offer two vastly different approaches to travel the 49ers chose to depart the west coast over a week ahead of the melbourne game leaving on wednesday sept 2 from san francisco and arriving in australia on the morning of friday sept 4 the niners have since taken in the city imbibed the celebrated coffee attended an aussie rules football match and generally ingratiated themselves to the local fan base l a has taken a different tack sean mcvay s squad left on the evening of tuesday sept 8 and is arriving in melbourne the morning of thursday sept 10 around 24 hours before the big game just another business trip for the title favorites mcvay says the short turnaround is what s best for the team based on how they ve approached intentional trips before last season the rams arrived in london on saturday morning for a sunday afternoon win over the jaguars but no nfl team has attempted this type of trip before going across the pacific and landing with just a day to get settled for 60 minutes of full contact football it s quite the unique gamble for the designated home team

news_mentions.headline: Patriots vs. Seahawks: Five must-know storylines for Wednesday's 2026 NFL Kickoff Game
news_mentions.description: Has New England solved its pass-protection woes? Will free-agent losses and injuries undermine Seattle? In advance of Wednesday's 2026 NFL Kickoff Game between the Patriots and Seahawks, Dan Parr provides five storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: our national nightmare is over after a 212 day break the nfl officially returns on wednesday night with the new england patriots visiting the seattle seahawks to kick off the 2026 season in an instant rematch of super bowl lx this is the 12th regular season game between teams that met in the previous super bowl per nfl research and the reigning champs are 8 3 in the previous 11 such rematches last we saw these two squads on the same field seattle s defense and running game dominated to the tune of a 29 13 victory can the patriots pull off an upset with marquee offseason acquisition a j brown in tow this time around five must know storylines 1 have the patriots solved their pass pro woes oc josh mcdaniels has vowed that wednesday s game will be different than super bowl lx pointing the finger at himself and saying seattle out everythinged new england last time out it s hard to argue that point considering the pats were scoreless through three quarters and fell behind by 19 before they finally put points on the board the offensive line clearly wasn t up to the challenge with mvp runner up drake maye taking 21 sacks in the playoffs the most in a single postseason in the super bowl era six of those sacks came via the seahawks new england is counting on improvement from within given four of the five offensive linemen who started in the super bowl are expected to be in the starting lineup on wednesday will a healthier and more seasoned will campbell provide better protection on the blind side how much of a difference does the signing of og alijah vera tucker make seahawks hc mike macdonald coaches defense in expert mode so we know he ll have leonard williams byron murphy uchenna nwosu demarcus lawrence dante fowler and derick hall ready to attack 2 can the seahawks spoil a j brown s patriots debut there s been plenty of hype around brown s arrival in foxborough this offseason including from yours truly and for good reason while his relationship with jalen hurts unraveled last year in philadelphia brown is now reunited with mike vrabel the head coach who helped the receiver blossom as his career began in tennessee the guy has posted 1 000 plus yards in six of his seven pro seasons and leads the nfl with 18 touchdowns on deep throws 20 plus air yds since 2022 per next gen stats he s the best receiver drake maye has been paired with which is probably a scary thought for most defenses i m guessing not so much for seattle s shutdown crew even though roster turnover and injuries more on those in a bit have the potential to create some vulnerabilities in a unit that seemed impenetrable at times last season the matchup between brown and devon witherspoon who was briefly the league s highest paid cornerback after signing an extension last month will be fun to watch 3 will the freshly minted highest paid cb shut down jsn speaking of wr1 cb1 matchups we ll see another great one when seattle s jaxon smith njigba the reigning offensive player of the year lines up across from new england s christian gonzalez it was gonzalez s new four year 135 million extension reportedly agreed to as of tuesday morning that moved devon witherspoon from first to second among the league s highest paid cornerbacks the deal ended a months long dispute that crescendoed with questions about whether the pro bowl corner would even play in the season opener outside of drake maye gonzalez is the most indispensable player on the roster and now he s being paid like it how will he fare in his first game since his long awaited payday in super bowl lx new england held smith njigba to four catches for 27 yards 6 8 per on 10 targets his fewest receiving yards in an nfl game where he was targeted eight or more times 4 will the seahawks be shorthanded in the secondary suddenly things are looking quite thin in the back end of the defending champions defense they lost s coby bryant and cb riq woolen in free agency but the week 1 status for two starters they are counting on in 2026 is now in question nickelback nick emmanwori a key piece in seattle s super bowl run last season has been limited in practice which isn t a surprise as he works his way back from offseason ankle surgery the unexpected development was the addition of s ty okada bryant s replacement to the injury report with a hamstring ailment editor s update ty okada has been ruled out of wednesday s game also the seahawks lost rookie s bud clark for the season to a broken ankle he suffered in the second preseason game on cutdown day seattle traded a draft pick for an undrafted rookie cb avery smith to shore things up the hawks still have the aforementioned devon witherspoon and trusted vets in julian love and josh jobe plus mike macdonald s defensive front is more than capable of masking deficiencies in the back end but if drake maye gets the protection to do so the pats passer will surely be testing this new version of seattle s secondary down the field 5 is jadarian price ready for prime time last but not least the game s most intriguing thing to watch for fantasy football heads might be the debut of seahawks first round rb jadarian price he was never the rb1 in college playing in the shadow of jeremiyah love at notre dame and folks are anxious to see how big of a workload the hawks are willing to give him right off the bat the athletic s andrew destin recently wrote that he expects seattle to play price on early downs and then pull him for rb george holani in goal line third down and short yardage situations former packers rb emanuel wilson is in the mix for carries too that would take a big bite out of price s fantasy appeal but not all rbs are ready for three down duty from day 1 super bowl lx mvp kenneth walker departed for kansas city in free agency while zach charbonnet is opening the season on the pup list as he works his way back from the acl tear he suffered in january so it s on the trio of price holani and wilson to put qb sam darnold in the manageable situations where he can thrive

news_mentions.headline: Patriots-Seahawks in 2026 NFL Kickoff Game: What We Learned from Seattle's 13-10 win
news_mentions.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
news_mentions.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame nfl pro insight for patriots seahawks drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer rotation at wr i believe the three can each thrive golden is the one to watch after he finished an uneven rookie campaign with a productive effort four catches for 84 yards and a score in the packers wild card weekend loss at chicago there are some depth questions particularly given the crew s injury history so that battle among reserves will be worth tracking tucker kraft s health is another piece to keep an eye on despite tearing his acl last november the pivotal playmaker is aiming to be ready for week 1 could he return with a new contract as well back to top three key storylines 1 kyler vs j j competition or coronation vikings coach kevin o connell continues to insist he s running a legitimate quarterback competition he keeps having to say it because frankly not many believe that j j mccarthy has a shot to keep kyler murray out of the starting lineup perhaps we ll be stunned but every indicator suggests it s murray s job to lose the former no 1 overall pick enters with proven ability while mccarthy has struggled when on the field and had issues staying healthy murray could open up the offense and his propensity to force feed his top targets could be a harbinger of a justin jefferson bounce back this competition in whatever form that takes will be tracked daily come camp within that context i m interested in how murray fits into koc s system and whether his mobility adds an element we haven t seen much of in minnesota over the past few years 2 next men up on the edge the trade of jonathan greenard took a chunk out of the defense not only because greenard was a proven disruptor but also due to the fact that the vikings now aren t very flush at the position dallas turner whom the club is counting on to have a full breakout in year 3 and andrew van ginkel sit atop the edge rusher corps but bo richter chaz chambliss and tyler batty are the next three players up on the depth chart they ve combined for one career sack chambliss defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins has also taken some reps on the edge the vikings could look to add another veteran rusher during camp or early in the season we trust brian flores defense but a coach who generally relies on vets who understand his system will be asking a lot out of youngsters how rookies caleb banks domonique orange jakobe thomas and charles demmings make the transition will have a significant say in the vikings outcome this season 3 one last dance with hitman we expected to have a resolution one way or the other on harrison smith s future surprisingly the situation still lingers will he return for another go or will he officially retire the club has made it clear they d welcome a return and didn t add a veteran to take smith s place jakobe thomas a third round pick was the only significant addition the club made to the safety crew given how much flores relies on the versatility of his safeties a return by smith would have a significant impact if he decides to retire jay ward theo jackson and thomas will battle for reps keep an eye on thomas and charles demmings in camp and preseason each could play key roles in 2026 back to top

news_mentions.headline: Chicago Bears training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Chicago Bears' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon
