news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 1: Ranking all 32 starters entering 2026 season
news_mentions.description: With the 2026 NFL season upon us, Nick Shook ranks each team's quarterback, from 1 to 32, heading into Week 1. Who ranks above reigning MVP Matthew Stafford? Is Caleb Williams ready to build on his breakout campaign?
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl is back with another season and so too is the qb index as a reminder this is a season long weekly ranking of quarterbacks that will be grouped into tiers these rankings are fluid and starters will be in and out of this list just as they are in their own lineups let s check in with where i see all 32 starting quarterbacks at the start of the 2026 nfl season tier 1 while used facetiously in the great joe flacco debate of the 2010s the term elite is reserved for the very best here we have three nfl mvps and a finalist in only his second season it s a group that commands instant recognition and immediate respect from every opposing defense they are all elite and each comes with great expectations josh allen welcomed veteran receiver dj moore to buffalo in the offseason and appears to be on track for a honeymoon year with moore which could elevate buffalo s offense and push allen to the front of the mvp pack once again matthew stafford just produced his best season at 37 years old and returns to lead a premier offense as part of a loaded super bowl favorite drake maye nearly won mvp last season and led his patriots to an unlikely super bowl appearance he returned to casually welcome in a j brown and romeo doubs to a corps that is now so strong new england had to trade away a former maye favorite in kayshon boutte and finally we have patrick mahomes one of the faces of the nfl over the last half decade who is in the middle of his greatest challenge of his career returning from an acl injury the chiefs and mahomes are optimistic but we won t truly know where he stands until he takes the field in week 1 for now his reputation earns him this spot tier 2 this is where the money is and will be made in 2026 it s about time people put some respect on dak prescott s name which should happen if he maintains his standard of play and benefits from an improved as of now on paper cowboys defense joe burrow has many goals but one matters more than the others stay healthy justin herbert can remind the world of his talents if his offensive line can stay healthy and the current progress report is positive lamar jackson has to accomplish the same while finding his place in another new offense which is directed by first time coordinator declan doyle sam darnold is coming off a super bowl triumph in which he played an important role but took a backseat to his team s incredible defense we ll all remember how excellent he was on the road to super bowl lx before long jared goff and the lions have plenty to prove after missing the playoffs last season although their offensive line concerns me and could be an issue if it doesn t collectively elevate its play in 2026 caleb williams was one of my favorite quarterbacks to watch in 2025 both because of his exceptional talent and his ability to deliver in the clutch all while fully embracing ben johnson s offense with a better understanding of the nfl game s speed after a rocky rookie season he landed on the madden nfl cover for a reason folks and will be central to chicago s goal of defending its nfc north title jordan love and coach matt lafleur both need to rinse the bad taste from 2025 from their mouths and fortunately love is plenty capable of doing so in entertaining fashion trevor lawrence hopped back on the radars of many and climbed these rankings by marrying perfectly with liam coen s offense using his legs more and producing the best version of himself in his pro career he s perhaps the most fascinating subject of this whole group can he and coen do it again and build upon the successes they enjoyed in the second half of 2025 tier 3 injuries unfortunately hampered a significant portion of this group baker mayfield played through multiple ailments and saw his performance suffer jayden daniels tried his best to do the same and ultimately missed 10 games daniel jones scintillating start was derailed by injury brock purdy was sidelined for nearly half of the season due to injury and bo nix missed his chance to power the broncos to the super bowl due to his ankle injury with all of this considered perhaps this is the redemption tier each of these quarterbacks has points to prove and even those who didn t encounter health challenges have important goals on their season checklists will c j stroud wash his hands of his disastrous playoff exit and prove he s still the face of the texans future can jalen hurts return to excellence under new oc sean mannion after the dreadful experience that was the 2025 season can geno smith show the football world that he wasn t the problem in las vegas and can still sling it with some of the best the performances of this group will undoubtedly alter the qb index landscape in 2026 for better or worse tier 4 we ve arrived at the making the leap tier where tyler shough jaxson dart and cam ward enter year 2 with plenty of promise coupled with pressure to deliver shough enters atop the group because of the fashion in which he produced to finish the 2025 season opening the eyes of many to the quarterback s potential as a partner with coach kellen moore dart electrified new york city last season showing promise and an undying competitive fire that propelled him to a 2 759 scrimmage yard rookie season and also subjected him to frequent visits to the blue medical tent that s where dart will need to improve most while fitting into new oc matt nagy s offense if he can do that giants fans are expecting him to solidify his place as the team s future under center ward s promising first season has titans fans hoping his first campaign under new oc brian daboll produces significant progress but right now it s nothing more than an aspiration bryce young needs to prove he s carolina s future after a tumultuous season that saw the panthers reach the playoffs but with an 8 9 record and finally kyler murray arrives in minnesota as kevin o connell s chosen solution for the franchise s quarterback woes but he too needs to prove he s worthy of the opportunity after fizzling out of arizona if all goes well each quarterback has a chance to climb as of now though the focus is on producing tangible improvement tier 5 this is the grizzled veteran trio aaron rodgers kirk cousins and jacoby brissett have each seen plenty in their nfl careers and the first two are likely entrenched in their places this is rodgers final season and will probably be cousins final starting job unless he thrives in his limited time and attracts interest elsewhere in 2027 the outlier is brissett an experienced and skilled quarterback who also isn t interested in making financial sacrifices in the name of opportunity he found a good spot in arizona negotiated a fully guaranteed one year deal and will begin his 11th nfl season with just enough security and leverage to prove he s worthy of a starting job he ll climb these rankings if he can capitalize on the assortment of talent surrounding him trey mcbride marvin harrison michael wilson and rookie jeremiyah love but he can t waste too much time with intriguing rookie carson beck sitting on the bench tier 6 like the pioneers we are only taking our first steps into our great westward journey exploration awaits and it comes with the admission that we don t know much how will malik willis in his first opportunity to own a starting job in his career fare with a limited supporting cast a first time head coach and an offensive coordinator aiming to repair his play calling reputation can tua tagovailoa find enough consistency to hold onto the job beyond week 1 and how long will deshaun watson last as the browns starter my guess is two weeks for those keeping track generally we re venturing into the unknown which offers the promise of great wonder and surprise or disaster

news_mentions.headline: The biggest question for each NFL team: Andy Reid's evolution, Caleb Downs' value
news_mentions.body_text: every team enters september with unanswered questions from schematic transitions to new personnel in new places and some are even existential let 39 s look at a question each nfl team is facing heading into a new season afc west denver broncos can the offense be more explosive offenses are about twice as likely to score touchdowns if they can produce an explosive play run or pass of 15 yards or more on a drive the broncos produced an explosive on only 40 96 percent of drives last season which ranked 25th bo nix ranked 34th in yards per attempt 6 4 among quarterbacks who had at least three starts trading for receiver jaylen waddle was one of the offseason 39 s splashiest moves waddle ranked 12th in explosive reception rate last season and he 39 s the perfect complement to courtland sutton he can move all around the formation while sutton can dominate his x role when waddle draws attention away from him the broncos are banking on another year of development from nix and waddle 39 s addition to be more explosive kansas city chiefs can andy reid evolve reid dropped to sixth in my top play caller rankings by defensive coaches the popular sentiment was that reid still deserves to be on the list but he needs to update his offense the chiefs haven 39 t adapted as defenses have trended toward two deep safeties and light boxes last season despite seeing the fourth highest rate of light boxes 53 5 percent they ranked fifth in cook rate 57 8 percent which measures how often teams pass the ball in neutral situations signing running back kenneth walker shows the chiefs recognize they need to be more intentional about running the ball and will commit to getting under center more patrick mahomes hasn 39 t had a lot of help from receivers or the running game giving him a break with handoffs and creating easy opportunities with play action will be essential for getting the chiefs back on track with mahomes returning from an acl injury late last season las vegas raiders how much can coaching make a difference with this offensive line the raiders had one of the league 39 s worst offensive lines last season ashton jeanty was tackled for a loss 45 times the most in the league left tackle kolton miller is back after injuring his ankle last season but the raiders 39 only major addition was signing center tyler linderbaum additionally spencer burford who was a backup with the san francisco 49ers will start at left guard the raiders hope that coaching will raise the floor and ceiling for this offensive line rick dennison a veteran line coach who knows this offense inside and out will coach the line fundamentally they should be better but klint kubiak 39 s scheme will make life easier on the line as well los angeles chargers can mike mcdaniel scheme around this interior offensive line last year 39 s injury issues were bad even by chargers standards they haven 39 t gotten off on the right foot so far this offseason starting center tyler biadasz was lost for the season after injuring his knee in training camp second round pick jake slaughter will replace him but center is pivotal in an outside zone offense the center makes the protection calls and often zone runs cut vertically toward the center left guard kayode awosika is in line to start after branson taylor went on injured reserve and cole strange who played for mcdaniel with the miami dolphins will start at right guard mcdaniel has shown the ability to scheme around offensive line weakness if the line is functional the chargers will be one of the nfl 39 s most explosive offenses afc east buffalo bills can jim leonhard create chaos a struggling bills defense found some success late last season by randomizing and using exotic disguises to confuse opponents sometimes their roll of the die approach would work like in a wild card win in which they forced two takeaways and held the high powered jacksonville jaguars offense to 24 points sometimes it didn 39 t like in the divisional round when they gave up 33 points to the broncos the bills didn 39 t have an injection of talent defensively but they were able to hire leonhard a well regarded defensive mind leonhard may have to take a similar approach to last season and use calculated chaos but knowing you have to do this in the offseason when you can draw up plays and teach the system with this approach in mind could lead to more consistent results miami dolphins do you have enough to evaluate malik willis willis signed a three year 67 million deal in the offseason but the dolphins can get out of it after 2028 willis has to prove he can be a franchise quarterback but he won 39 t have much help around him this year the offensive line could be better than people think and de 39 von achane is elite but his best catcher is rookie chris bell who recently started practicing after returning from an acl injury willis should be able to produce on the ground but the dolphins might get behind often this season and fall into heavy passing scripts willis won 39 t have much help downfield new england patriots can this offense perform against elite defenses the patriots faced only one defense last regular season that ranked in the top 10 in points allowed per drive cleveland browns in the playoffs they played against four such teams and struggled mightily averaging 1 13 points per drive and 0 19 epa per play for context both of those stats would rank 32nd in the league in the regular season they 39 ve overhauled their receiving corps with the additions of a j brown and romeo doubs and should be much more equipped to play against elite defenses new york jets nbsp can geno smith bounce back smith was flat out bad last season after playing good ball and resurrecting his career in seattle however there aren 39 t many quarterbacks who could have functioned in las vegas 39 offense the raiders had the worst run game in the league couldn 39 t pass block and were well below average at receiver with the jets he could have a good offensive line a good running back in breece hall and a fringe elite receiver in garrett wilson offensive coordinator frank reich who has been the play caller for some historically bad offenses is a concern but the help smith will get from his teammates will be night and day better than last season afc north baltimore ravens can jesse minter elevate this defense back to franchise standards minter got the most out of his personnel with the chargers he weaponized his lone superstar derwin james and hid several deficiencies with his scheme the ravens could have a better secondary if nate wiggins takes a step up in his development we could see minter get more aggressive with his play calling with a secondary he could trust to play more man coverage cincinnati bengals is al golden a good defensive coordinator before last season the bengals fired lou anarumo and hired golden who called plays for notre dame from 2022 24 the bengals ranked near the bottom of the league in several major defensive statistical categories in golden 39 s first season this offseason the bengals added talent trading for defensive tackle dexter lawrence and signing safety bryan cook and edge boye mafe golden was expected to implement an aggressive scheme last year but they were one of the more passive defenses blitzing at the league 39 s lowest rate the bengals hoped to improve their defense after firing anarumo but had a worse season statistically than they ever had under him cleveland browns can they create a qb friendly environment deshaun watson and shedeur sanders probably aren 39 t long term answers at quarterback but the browns have the makings of a strong environment for a young qb coach todd monken is an excellent play caller and rookie receivers kc concepcion first round pick and denzel boston second round pick have a chance to be a strong duo second year players running back quinshon judkins and tight end harold fannin showed promise last year no one is expecting much success for the browns this year but if their young playmakers can continue to develop in monken 39 s system they could set themselves up to finally become a quarterback friendly offense pittsburgh steelers can dc patrick graham finally modernize this defense the steelers have been behind the schematic eight ball for years graham has had a penchant for getting defenses to punch above their weight class but has had only one top 10 defense statistically 2023 raiders he 39 ll have the most talent he 39 s ever worked with in pittsburgh graham has been a chameleon schemer how he adapts his system to the steelers and how they acclimate to his scheme can lead to explosive results afc south houston texans can the run game be average c j stroud has never had an even average run game in houston they ranked 30th in rushing success rate last season 32nd in 2024 and 25th in 2023 they were intentional in making their offense more physical this year drafting interior lineman keylan rutledge in the first round and trading for running back david montgomery with how dominant the texans 39 defense is how well they run the ball will decide whether they 39 re true contenders indianapolis colts was committing to daniel jones the right decision jones signed a two year 88 million deal so the colts are tied to the qb long term they really didn 39 t have a choice after how good their offense looked with jones at the helm when he was healthy last season but there were signs of regression before his injury in jones 39 last four games before he was hurt against jacksonville in week 14 he averaged just 0 14 epa per play and turned the ball over 11 times he has looked good in training camp but it 39 s incredibly hard to return to full strength after an achilles tendon injury also jones has never played in every game in a season in his career there are many red flags indicating that jones 39 success at the beginning of last season was fool 39 s gold but he has a chance to prove it wasn 39 t jacksonville jaguars can trevor lawrence build consistency lawrence seemingly had a breakout season in 2022 but followed it with two seasons of inconsistency playing in liam coen 39 s offense lawrence looked like the player the jaguars thought he 39 d be when they drafted him no 1 last season lawrence reduced his off target pass rate 10 4 percent and turnover rate 2 2 percent to the lowest of his career he 39 ll need to continue cutting down on the negative plays to string together two good seasons in a row for the first time in his career tennessee titans can cam ward make the mundane plays over and over again playing for brian daboll josh allen slowly decreased his average time to throw and average air yards from 2018 to 2021 everyone knew allen could make the big throw downfield but it was his ability to improve on short to intermediate throws that made him a complete quarterback in allen 39 s second season the bills added cole beasley a slot receiver allen could trust to be in the right place and win quickly similarly the titans added wan 39 dale robinson this offseason to provide ward with the same type of outlet nfc west arizona cardinals how does carson beck fit into the future the cardinals aren 39 t exactly committed to beck as their quarterback of the future but investing the first pick of the third round to get him isn 39 t nothing beck will start the season as the third string quarterback the cardinals have enough offensive talent for some fireworks maybe it won 39 t result in many wins but it could be entertaining to watch jeremiyah love trey mcbride michael wilson and marvin harrison challenge secondaries next year 39 s quarterback class looks loaded and if the cardinals drafted one early would that mean they just wasted a high third round pick on a backup quarterback even though it would take a lot for beck to convince the cardinals not to draft a quarterback high shouldn 39 t they find out what they have in him sooner rather than later los angeles nbsp rams how quickly can this defense get healthy and on the field together super teams are fun but the kryptonite we 39 ve seen for them is a lack of cohesiveness and health the rams will have four new defensive starters aaron donald myles garrett trent mcduffie and jaylen watson after an overhaul donald just made the decision to officially come back a week before the season and garrett hasn 39 t practiced since aug 5 garrett is expected to play in week 1 but donald isn 39 t a lock to play we expect the duo to wreak havoc together but it may take longer than expected to get going additionally all pro receiver puka nacua has been dealing with a psoas injury that has kept him out for several weeks and he could face a suspension matthew stafford is 38 and the weakest unit on the rams could be their offensive line which isn 39 t a major weakness but it 39 s thin they can 39 t afford to let stafford get hit too many times the rams are immensely talented and while health is a concern for every team several seemingly minor issues in l a hopefully won 39 t compound or get worse going into the season san francisco 49ers can the defensive line get back to being disruptive one of kyle shanahan 39 s core tenets is to always have a disruptive defensive line the 49ers have kris kocurek one of the best defensive line coaches in the league and they invest a lot of resources into the line however they simply haven 39 t been good since 2023 the last time the 49ers made the super bowl in 2023 they ranked fifth in pass rush win rate last season they ranked 20th in the same metric this offseason they traded for defensive tackle osa odighizuwa but nick bosa just started practicing the week before the season and last year 39 s promising first round pick mykel williams is beginning the season on pup if they can get healthy there 39 s a chance the defensive line can be disruptive again but they won 39 t start the season near full strength seattle seahawks can brian fleury pick up where klint kubiak left off the seahawks offense was one of the biggest surprises last season and helped propel them to their second super bowl win the seahawks ranked eighth in explosive play rate last season with kubiak installing a shanahan offense predicated on getting big bodies on the field baiting the defense to match with base and taking shots downfield after kubiak became head coach in las vegas rather than promoting from within coach mike macdonald hired fleury who has an interesting background and has worked under shanahan in various roles since 2019 the idea is that while the seahawks offense was humming using a pure form of the shanahan offense fleury can bring an updated version as shanahan constantly tweaks and updates his system however the hire is still a bit of an experiment as fleury has never called plays nfc east dallas cowboys nbsp was the league wrong about caleb downs obviously the cowboys 39 defense needs to just improve to a baseline level under new coordinator christian parker but parker will lean on his rookie safety as a stabilizing force after being touted as a top five pick for most of the draft process a lack of measurables and flash plays on film dropped downs to no 11 downs got a complicated ohio state defense on the right page made checks and took away passing lanes by consistently being in the right place parker has moved downs all around the defense and will ask him to do things he didn 39 t do in college downs 39 leadership role will be valuable but the cowboys need him to make his share of flash plays as well new york giants can jaxson dart relearn how to play the position after playing almost his entire college career in shotgun dart played in an offense that ranked sixth in shotgun usage 76 5 percent as a rookie new offensive coordinator matt nagy will ask him to play under center a lot more than he has in the preseason the giants offense was only in shotgun on 46 6 percent of snaps indicating they 39 ll be under center more than in the gun dart will have to relearn footwork and timing in nagy 39 s offense also quarterback option plays are being phased out of the league because teams are just too good at defending them and it 39 s not worth putting the quarterback at risk without getting explosive plays in return there might be growing pains for dart but they 39 ll be necessary for career longevity philadelphia eagles how will the offensive line perform without jeff stoutland obviously jalen hurts 39 assimilation into sean mannion 39 s offense will be key but the running game will always be the crux of this offense and if they can be dominant again they 39 ll buy time for hurts to adjust the eagles 39 offensive line was severely affected by injuries last season with a healthy line they have the athleticism and physicality to be one of the best outside zone blocking lines in the league but installing a new system isn 39 t just copying and pasting a playbook constant tweaks and adjustments are needed especially when defenses start throwing curveballs new offensive line coach chris kuper has big shoes to fill as stoutland 39 s successor will his veteran line trust him to have the answers when things get hard washington commanders who will make up the foundation in the next team build the commanders missed their opportunity to build a contender during jayden daniels 39 rookie contract window daniels will be eligible for an extension next season and will likely reset the market if he 39 s healthy he can elevate this team as he did in his rookie season but let 39 s be real this isn 39 t a super bowl worthy roster this isn 39 t a lost season but the commanders should be identifying who they want to keep as building blocks for their next team build out and they will have to be more economical nfc north chicago bears are the bears right about their defensive tackle room the bears didn 39 t invest many resources in one of the worst defensive tackle groups in 2025 they added veteran defensive tackles neville gallimore and kentavius street in free agency and drafted jordan van den berg in the sixth round van den berg has been a pleasant surprise and defensive coordinator dennis allen called street the most productive defensive tackle in camp they felt good enough about their rotation to trade away gervon dexter the bears ranked 27th last season in defensive rushing success and 29th in opponents 39 yards before contact to avoid coin flip shootouts their run defense has to be better but from the outside looking in it doesn 39 t look like they 39 ve done enough detroit lions can penei sewell be an elite left tackle when the lions were offensive juggernauts it was centered on the dominance of their offensive line their offense lost consistency as the quality of the line dropped off a key to their season will be how sewell transitions to the left side after becoming an elite right tackle in the league sewell played left tackle in college so it 39 s not completely foreign for him but it 39 s not a given that he 39 ll be just as good as he was on the right the lions need difference makers on the line and can 39 t afford a drop off from sewell green bay packers can matthew golden be a strong no 2 receiver christian watson looked like a true no 1 receiver last season but golden 39 s production was disappointing 29 receptions 361 yards 0 tds after being the first receiver that the packers drafted in the first round since 2002 golden will get a huge uptick in targets with doubs signing with the patriots josh jacobs 39 future with the team is murky and his ability to break tackles has been integral to the running game coach matt lafleur might have to lean on the passing game a lot more than he has in the past and they 39 ll need golden to flourish minnesota vikings what will this offensive system look like theoretically the vikings 39 potential offense sounds amazing coach kevin o 39 connell 39 s aggressive passing game combined with a mike mcdaniel influenced run game with a sprinkle of kyler murray option offense seems like a fever dream if it all melds together assistant coach frank smith was mcdaniel 39 s offensive coordinator from 2022 25 in miami and his schematic tweaks should help improve a run game that ranks 19th in explosive rush rate since 2022 nfc south atlanta falcons can michael penix execute play action concepts penix ranks 77th in play action rate 17 6 percent among qualifying quarterbacks from 2024 25 the low rate wasn 39 t just an offensive coordinator preference when kirk cousins played former falcons offensive coordinator zac robinson increased his play action usage to 22 6 percent kevin stefanski and tommy rees 39 offense is built on play action and they won 39 t shy away from it penix will have to prove that he can turn his back to the defense whenever he gets his opportunity this season carolina panthers can coordinator ejiro evero finally put together a productive defense evero is respected around the league and has had serious consideration as a head coach candidate despite poor defensive production in carolina people in the league seem to understand that he 39 s had awful rosters to work with last year after adding talent the panthers finished 22nd in defensive dvoa ftn 39 s efficiency metric this year they signed rusher jaelan phillips and linebacker devin lloyd evero has the talent that he needs to build the best defense that the panthers have had in a long time new orleans saints what is tyler shough 39 s ceiling shough has proven to be a functional starter after getting picked in the second round some saints fans may scoff at that assessment but there aren 39 t many functional nfl starting qbs walking the earth can he be more than that as an older rookie 26 with 32 college starts and plenty of arm talent he was expected to have a certain floor but can he be more than a derek carr level quarterback tampa bay buccaneers what kind of play caller is zac robinson robinson was one of the most sought after play callers before getting hired in atlanta but his offense has been disappointing and a bit strange they used more pistol than any other offense and unlike most pistol offenses they weren 39 t in it to run option plays they ran outside zone variations which were effective in robinson 39 s two years with the falcons from 2024 25 they ranked third in rushing success rate but didn 39 t heavily utilize play action last in play action rate 9 8 percent some of this has to do with their quarterbacks cousins wasn 39 t mobile enough to execute play fakes in 2024 and penix wasn 39 t comfortable turning his back to do the defense with a well rounded offensive roster and baker mayfield robinson has a lot of freedom to shape his system differently than he did in atlanta this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.description: Can Josh Allen and the Bills flip the script on the Texans' ferocious defense? Do the Buccaneers or Bengals prevail in a potential shootout? Will the Cowboys get off on the right foot against the Giants? Check out the Week 1 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 1 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on wednesday sept 9 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns blazing and never lets williams settle in things could easily swing in the home team s favor unfortunately the panthers will be without the player who was supposed to be phillips top running mate off the edge as carolina s sacks co leader from last season nic scourton is out for the season with an acl tear if the game does turn into a shootout a distinct possibility i m leaning toward i like the bears chances a bit better why bobby picked the bengals cincinnati admittedly seems to have a bit of an early season curse the bengals finally broke a three year week 1 losing streak in 2025 only for joe burrow to suffer a long term toe injury the following game however burrow has been healthy and striking an optimistic tone in the lead up to the new season stating he s trying to manifest a return to the super bowl and can feel this bengals squad is different in my bones i believe him buccaneers versus bengals figures to be one of the most explosive matchups of the nfl s opening week cincinnati has more firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries there are likely still some growing pains to work through in that process which could allow for cincy s rebuilt dexter lawrence led defense to provide burrow with just enough of a buffer why gennaro picked the lions immediately following a disappointing 2025 season that saw detroit quadruple its loss total from 2024 dan campbell gave himself a freaking f and stressed that the lions needed to get that hunger back earlier this week campbell said new orleans is a hungry opponent so whose appetite will be satiated on sunday the lions feast at ford field as the league s highest scoring home team in three of the past four seasons including the 25 campaign in fact detroit dropped a 50 burger on chicago in last year s home opener and while it s reasonable to be concerned about the lions offensive line it s equally reasonable to be underwhelmed by the saints d line now new orleans second year signal caller tyler shough might take advantage of detroit s depleted secondary points could be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with preseason mvp front runner josh allen taking on the baddest defense on the planet granted buffalo also boasts the reigning nfl rushing king james cook a brand new wr1 dj moore and a highly cohesive offensive line but i m still backing the texans loaded d after all demeco ryans crew has gotten the best of allen in each of the past two seasons holding the quarterback to a career low 30 percent completions in 2024 and subjecting him to a career high eight sacks in 2025 both of those texans wins came in houston where this sunday s tilt will take place oh and for buffalo s offensive play caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an offensive groove takes time in week 1 give me the home team with the hellacious defense why dan picked the ravens while the colts had the epic collapse losing seven straight games to close out last season both teams are going to be eager to remove the bitter taste of a disappointing 2025 from their mouths first year ravens head coach jesse minter has an opportunity to prove his worth right away against an offense that scored in bunches when qb daniel jones was healthy last year minter needs no reminder of that fact as the colts went on the road and dropped 38 on his chargers in week 7 the most points allowed by the bolts all season can the defensive guru avenge that loss with his new crew on paper he has the weaponry to make it happen it will certainly help if jones is at all rusty in his first game back since tearing his achilles in december the biggest question for ball knowers around the league though is whether lamar jackson has his swagger back after not performing to his usual standard much in an injury plagued 2025 will new oc declan doyle previously ben johnson s apprentice launch a rejuvenated jackson into orbit against a long struggling colts defense that didn t add much sizzle in the offseason maybe it s wishful thinking but i d like to believe the two time mvp still has enough in the tank to outlast a frisky indy offense why bobby picked the jaguars there aren t a ton of logical paths to a cleveland victory the browns turned back to deshaun watson who was outplayed by shedeur sanders in the preseason but nonetheless won the starting job production from the wide receiver room will depend heavily on rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston mastering the learning curve while running back quinshon judkins is coming off a serious season ending injury oh and cleveland s defense is without myles garrett for the first time in a decade it s a lot for newbie head coach todd monken and his rookie defensive coordinator mike rutenberg to juggle the jaguars conversely are looking to build on a 13 win season trevor lawrence found his stride under coach liam coen and now enters year 2 in the system with a loaded pass catching group jacksonville s defense also boasts playmakers at every level considering where the jaguars see their 2026 season going they shouldn t run into much trouble hosting the browns why jeremy picked the steelers one of these teams is comfortable in its own skin the other has zero identity at the most important position in sports mike mccarthy and kevin stefanski both enter sunday s game with something to prove out of the gate starting their third and second stints as head coaches respectively mccarthy benefits from having a familiar friend at the controls of his offense in greybeard aaron rodgers stefanski on the other hand spent the summer playing coy about who his starting qb would be between tua tagovailoa and michael penix the latter who boasts more upside only returned to practice two weeks ago leaving tagovailoa as stefanki s only true option against pittsburgh specified as only a week 1 starter tua appears to have a short leash in atlanta about as long as penix s recovery or 60 minutes on sunday rodgers did not play at all in the preseason so rust for the tinfoil man is a possibility but once he warms up the four time mvp should have his way with michael pittman dk metcalf and pat freiermuth against a falcons pass rush neutered by the loss of second year standouts jalon walker injury and james pearce suspension why jeremy picked the jets don t call it a revenge game at least that s what robert saleh and aaron glenn are preaching ahead of the former s first game as head coach against his former team both tennessee and new york are keeping the main thing the main thing which is rebounding from an awful 2025 with a week 1 victory something that eluded each side the last two campaigns in fact the only first week win from either organization since 2021 came in aaron rodgers infamous four snap debut which in case you memory holed it ended in an overtime win for saleh s jets in short a week 1 victory for tennessee or new york is rare and should be cherished on the titans defensive front ex jets jermaine johnson and john franklin myers will surely be licking their chops to stick it to their old squad alongside all world dt jeffery simmons but the jets are as well equipped on offense as they ve been in years their offensive line is sturdy and consistent and their weapons finally go two deep and while cam ward s first unit struggled this preseason geno smith and co flourished in their limited action a veteran gang green squad has just enough to outlast this green tennessee team it won t be pretty but it s week 1 when nothing is more stylish than a 1 0 record why jeremy picked the chargers in what figures to be the most lopsided result of week 1 outside of duval county the chargers are in prime position to get off to an electric start our brief glimpses of justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense this summer were straight gas and as long as jake slaughter holds up at center in his first career start against walter nolen josh sweat and arizona s pass rush los angeles should carry that momentum into the regular season with ease first year head coach mike lafleur vs football lifer jim harbaugh is not a fair fight at least not in week 1 i see a big halftime lead dwindling down the stretch as jacoby brissett trey mcbride michael wilson and co play well from behind as they so often did in 2025 but the result will never be in doubt bolts big why brooke picked the raiders the raiders drew the long end of the stick by hosting the dolphins in the opener there are question marks littered throughout miami s 2026 roster specifically on the offensive side of the ball rb de 39 von achane is in position to carry another heavy load this season as qb malik willis navigates his first campaign as a full time starter with a wr corps that s royally inexperienced there s potential there looking at you caleb douglas and chris bell but the success won t happen overnight expect the raiders defense to force willis to beat them through the air which won t be an easy feat with maxx crosby back in tow the raiders have fewer question marks and more talent across the board the offense appears better than the unit that scored a league low 14 2 points per game with geno smith in 2025 kirk cousins has the reins for now and his steady quarterbacking will be a warm welcome for raiders fans near and far plus ashton jeanty ankle should be good to go on sunday and brock bowers is primed to do more brock bowers things in year 3 editor s update after publishing on wednesday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday and is expected to miss a game or two one final note from the nfl research team this is the sixth game in the last 30 seasons in which both head coaches are making their nfl debuts with the home coach winning three of the previous five such games that s another aspect that bodes well for klint kubiak why brooke picked the vikings how will kyler murray look under kevin o connell s tutelage we re about to find out in what will be a rocking u s bank stadium full of vikings fans ready to forget the qb conundrum of 2025 as a vikings fan myself i don t feel as if the qb play can get worse than what i witnessed last season i sure hope that s true these nfc north matchups are always competitive but this particular one feels more about what the packers lost this offseason than what the vikings gained green bay begins the 2026 campaign without superstar pass rusher micah parsons and rb josh jacobs an instrumental part of matt lafleur s offense in recent seasons who s currently on the commissioner s exempt list that backfield will now feature marshawn lloyd kaleb johnson and chris brooks the only one with more than 100 career rush yards meaning brian flores defense should expect a heavy dose of jordan love s arm ultimately missing two big time starters will be too much to overcome for the road team why gennaro picked the eagles this matchup would have garnered a whole lot more attention in week 1 of last season when it could ve served as an instant rematch of the previous campaign s nfc title game but these two division rivals have gone in different directions since they met on championship sunday back in late january of 2025 philadelphia of course went on to win its second super bowl that february and although the eagles dealt with their fair share of drama this past season they still became the nfc east s first repeat winners in 21 years washington meanwhile completely came apart in 2025 injuries spoiled jayden daniels sophomore effort while dan quinn s defense gave up the most yards in the league gm adam peters aggressively rebuilt the commanders d in free agency and the draft but i m not convinced that ll be a quick fix more concerningly i have serious doubts about daniels supporting cast especially the laremy tunsil less offensive line that s a recipe for disaster against vic fangio s defense sure the eagles edge group has question marks but the front is spearheaded by the devastating dt duo of jalen carter and jordan davis even if jayden can avoid those 650 pounds of pain philly has two athletic linebackers zack baun and jihaad campbell to track the fleet footed quarterback and a pair of first team all pro cover men quinyon mitchell and cooper dejean to close his passing lanes nick sirianni improves to 6 0 in week 1 why brooke picked the giants i know the cowboys have dominated this division rivalry recently winning 16 of their last 18 meetings going back to 2017 despite new york prevailing in week 18 last season dallas pulled its starters at halftime but this game feels like a massive opportunity for the giants to course correct after an offseason full of change john harbaugh is captaining the ship cam skattebo is healthy malik nabers could be on the verge of returning after missing a majority of last season odell beckham is back and no 5 overall draft pick arvell reese joined one of the league s scariest pass rushes at least on paper so yeah these aren t last year s giants these aren t last year s cowboys either dallas defense which ranked dead last in scoring d and 30th in yards allowed in 2025 was overhauled in the offseason with a new coordinator christian parker and an influx of talent including a pair of first round rookies in caleb downs and malachi lawrence that unit has plenty to prove so too does an offensive line that was put under some extra pressure this week with the injury to pro bowl lg tyler smith a development that throws fourth year pro tj bass into the fire you can t get all caught up in the statistical weeds for week 1 because we don t truly know what the 2026 iterations of these clubs look like i have to lean into the vibes and my gut we re talking prime time at metlife this just feels like big blue s super bowl monday sept 14 why jeremy picked the broncos there is so much intrigue going into this week 1 finale that i m almost embarrassed by my curiosity with the most overexposed nfl franchise of the past half decade but that s what patrick mahomes does his absence magnifies his presence could he actually be all the way back from last year s devastating knee injury was 2025 the fluke of flukes or a harbinger of something worse to come for andy reid and friends similarly for denver is bo nix all healed and ready to take mahomes mantle as king of the division or was his first year atop the west an illusion of how things could be monday night won t provide definitive answers but it should feature solid if unremarkable play for both sides mahomes will knock off the rust the broncos will play well but keep kansas city around with turnovers and a fourth quarter score perhaps by offseason addition jaylen waddle will fittingly be the deciding factor no shootout in the first wild afc west matchup of the season but last year s trends outsized broncos success chiefs woes in one score games will make their mark on this year s opener wednesday s game why dan picked the seahawks i m expecting a much more competitive contest than what we saw when the patriots and seahawks met in february a 29 13 shellacking by seattle mainly because i have concerns about the condition of the hawks run game and the back end of the defense as you might recall those two facets played leading roles in propelling mike macdonald s team to the top last season the sb lx mvp kenneth walker departed in the offseason and zach charbonnet is on the pup list that means rookie jadarian price and third year pro george holani who has made his bones on special teams so far will be asked to carry the bulk of the rushing load are they up to the challenge against a defense that didn t allow a 100 yard rusher until week 12 last season also the seahawks lost safety coby bryant and corner riq woolen in free agency they will be without starting safety ty okada while nickelback nick emmanwori is questionable to play as he returns from ankle surgery any coverage breakdowns as the new secondary gains its footing could be costly against an offense undoubtedly anxious to feature marquee offseason acquisition a j brown ultimately i don t trust the patriots offensive line last seen being ripped to shreds by seattle s fearsome front enough to pick the upset but i do believe in oc josh mcdaniels promise that the rematch will be different thursday s game why bobby picked the 49ers it s nearly impossible to enter a campaign with as much hype as the rams los angeles was already enjoying a promising offseason having added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson when general manager les snead swung a trade for the single season sack king myles garrett it was such a seismic move that three time defensive player of the year aaron donald came out of retirement can such exultant vibes carry over to the field in week 1 which is often a toss up anyway after a roughly 16 hour flight to australia i m not sold there s a lot of injury or load management situations to consider on both sides george kittle nick bosa garrett donald not traveling to australia etc so that doesn t necessarily move the needle on rosters that are formidable with or without a few of the bigger stars the kyle shanahan sean mcvay rivalry doesn t give too much away either although shanahan is 11 8 against mcvay los angeles has won four of the past five contests where i and many others sporting large under eye bags draw the line is sleep while the 49ers flew to melbourne to acclimate a week ahead of the showdown the rams are jetting in 24 hours before the game hoping to keep their bodies on pacific time for a whirlwind victory before turning right around and traveling home sleep scientists are divided on the vastly different approaches but san francisco s feels safer if rams players experience post travel
