news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Sam Darnold expected to miss Seahawks' Week 2 game, but avoids major hip injury
news_mentions.description: The Seahawks will be without Sam Darnold for at least a game, but the quarterback appears to have avoided a long-term issue.
news_mentions.body_text: the seattle seahawks will be without sam darnold for at least a game but the quarterback appears to have avoided a long term issue darnold is expected to miss next week s tilt against the arizona cardinals nfl network insider ian rapoport reported on thursday rapoport added that darnold could miss just a few weeks but has avoided a lengthy absence darnold exited wednesday s 13 10 win over the new england patriots after just five plays due to a hip injury that occurred on a sack the qb limped to the locker room in obvious discomfort coach mike macdonald noted on an appearance on seattle sports 710 radio that the club got really really good news on darnold s hip but declined to put the qb on a timetable we re praying for sam but not like worrying because it s just what it is macdonald said the hip is intact and it s good it s more of a muscle thing macdonald told seahawks reporters during his thursday news conference that he did not have any new information regarding darnold s status but that he hoped by monday to have a really accurate picture of a plan of attack and what we ll do that week the date of the week 1 injury gives the seahawks extra days for darnold to rest there are 18 days between wednesday s tilt and a week 3 matchup against the washington commanders given how quickly darnold was ruled out it would be very good news if the qb only missed a lone game if it is indeed a one or two week injury the seahawks will roll with drew lock as their spot starter starting at arizona in week 2

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Patriots WR A.J. Brown suffered high ankle sprain, expected to miss at least four weeks
news_mentions.description: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown (ankle) was ruled out of Wednesday's Kickoff Game against the Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: a j brown s much ballyhooed debut with the new england patriots came to an abrupt conclusion wednesday night brown injured his ankle early in the third quarter and was ruled out of the nfl kickoff game which the patriots lost to the host seattle seahawks 13 10 the new england receiver suffered a high ankle sprain an mri confirmed on thursday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported brown is expected to miss at least four weeks according to rapoport which is standard with high ankle sprains the three time pro bowl wide receiver went for a low throw from drake maye with seahawks cornerback nehemiah pritchett defending and deflecting the ball pritchett s knee came down on brown s right ankle and the wideout immediately grabbed the ankle brown who was playing in his first game for the pats since he was acquired in an offseason trade from the philadelphia eagles was attended to on the field before limping off to the blue tent he was then accompanied by trainers to the locker room where he underwent x rays prior to his exit brown had three receptions on four targets for 26 yards all of those numbers team highs at the time his biggest contribution was drawing a massive 34 yard pass interference penalty that put the pats on the seahawks 2 yard line to set up the game s opening score brown 29 has played in at least 13 games in each of his seven nfl seasons but he has missed at least two games in each of his last two with philadelphia

news_mentions.headline: Tua Tagovailoa limited at Falcons practice with oblique injury; Cooper Rush takes first-team reps
news_mentions.description: Tua Tagovailoa appeared to aggravate his oblique during the Falcons' Thursday practice session, leading to a limited participation status on the team's practice report.
news_mentions.body_text: the quarterback situation in atlanta has become more concerning tua tagovailoa aggravated his oblique during the falcons thursday practice session leading to a limited participation status on the team s practice report nfl network insider ian rapoport reported tagovailoa is day to day with the injury and his status for the week 1 opener against the pittsburgh steelers is to be determined backup cooper rush told reporters after practice that he received every rep with the first string signaling coach kevin stefanski might be preparing to begin his first season in atlanta with the veteran as his starter out of necessity i m not sure what happened rush said it s thursday practice practice has to go on and so you re up next we ll see what happens tagovailoa s late week health hurdle isn t the first challenge he s encountered in his relatively short time with the falcons the former first round pick also began camp on the injury report due to a back ailment forcing atlanta to rely on undrafted free agent jack strand and quickly move to add rush via free agency two weeks ago it appeared as if michael penix was nearing a return from his knee injury just in time for the start of the regular season that optimism faded this week when penix was ruled out for week 1 telling reporters he s very close to being ready but wasn t quite there yet with penix out the plan shifted to tagovailoa thursday s events may force stefanski to adjust once again and turn to rush a 32 year old nfl veteran with 42 games of experience including 16 starts for now it s a worrisome sign that the falcons might have to begin 2026 with a quarterback they hoped would spend 2026 as the third string option tagovailoa still has two days left to recover enough to be able to play in pittsburgh on sunday

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 1: Ranking all 32 starters entering 2026 season
news_mentions.description: With the 2026 NFL season upon us, Nick Shook ranks each team's quarterback, from 1 to 32, heading into Week 1. Who ranks above reigning MVP Matthew Stafford? Is Caleb Williams ready to build on his breakout campaign?
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl is back with another season and so too is the qb index as a reminder this is a season long weekly ranking of quarterbacks that will be grouped into tiers these rankings are fluid and starters will be in and out of this list just as they are in their own lineups let s check in with where i see all 32 starting quarterbacks at the start of the 2026 nfl season tier 1 while used facetiously in the great joe flacco debate of the 2010s the term elite is reserved for the very best here we have three nfl mvps and a finalist in only his second season it s a group that commands instant recognition and immediate respect from every opposing defense they are all elite and each comes with great expectations josh allen welcomed veteran receiver dj moore to buffalo in the offseason and appears to be on track for a honeymoon year with moore which could elevate buffalo s offense and push allen to the front of the mvp pack once again matthew stafford just produced his best season at 37 years old and returns to lead a premier offense as part of a loaded super bowl favorite drake maye nearly won mvp last season and led his patriots to an unlikely super bowl appearance he returned to casually welcome in a j brown and romeo doubs to a corps that is now so strong new england had to trade away a former maye favorite in kayshon boutte and finally we have patrick mahomes one of the faces of the nfl over the last half decade who is in the middle of his greatest challenge of his career returning from an acl injury the chiefs and mahomes are optimistic but we won t truly know where he stands until he takes the field in week 1 for now his reputation earns him this spot tier 2 this is where the money is and will be made in 2026 it s about time people put some respect on dak prescott s name which should happen if he maintains his standard of play and benefits from an improved as of now on paper cowboys defense joe burrow has many goals but one matters more than the others stay healthy justin herbert can remind the world of his talents if his offensive line can stay healthy and the current progress report is positive lamar jackson has to accomplish the same while finding his place in another new offense which is directed by first time coordinator declan doyle sam darnold is coming off a super bowl triumph in which he played an important role but took a backseat to his team s incredible defense we ll all remember how excellent he was on the road to super bowl lx before long jared goff and the lions have plenty to prove after missing the playoffs last season although their offensive line concerns me and could be an issue if it doesn t collectively elevate its play in 2026 caleb williams was one of my favorite quarterbacks to watch in 2025 both because of his exceptional talent and his ability to deliver in the clutch all while fully embracing ben johnson s offense with a better understanding of the nfl game s speed after a rocky rookie season he landed on the madden nfl cover for a reason folks and will be central to chicago s goal of defending its nfc north title jordan love and coach matt lafleur both need to rinse the bad taste from 2025 from their mouths and fortunately love is plenty capable of doing so in entertaining fashion trevor lawrence hopped back on the radars of many and climbed these rankings by marrying perfectly with liam coen s offense using his legs more and producing the best version of himself in his pro career he s perhaps the most fascinating subject of this whole group can he and coen do it again and build upon the successes they enjoyed in the second half of 2025 tier 3 injuries unfortunately hampered a significant portion of this group baker mayfield played through multiple ailments and saw his performance suffer jayden daniels tried his best to do the same and ultimately missed 10 games daniel jones scintillating start was derailed by injury brock purdy was sidelined for nearly half of the season due to injury and bo nix missed his chance to power the broncos to the super bowl due to his ankle injury with all of this considered perhaps this is the redemption tier each of these quarterbacks has points to prove and even those who didn t encounter health challenges have important goals on their season checklists will c j stroud wash his hands of his disastrous playoff exit and prove he s still the face of the texans future can jalen hurts return to excellence under new oc sean mannion after the dreadful experience that was the 2025 season can geno smith show the football world that he wasn t the problem in las vegas and can still sling it with some of the best the performances of this group will undoubtedly alter the qb index landscape in 2026 for better or worse tier 4 we ve arrived at the making the leap tier where tyler shough jaxson dart and cam ward enter year 2 with plenty of promise coupled with pressure to deliver shough enters atop the group because of the fashion in which he produced to finish the 2025 season opening the eyes of many to the quarterback s potential as a partner with coach kellen moore dart electrified new york city last season showing promise and an undying competitive fire that propelled him to a 2 759 scrimmage yard rookie season and also subjected him to frequent visits to the blue medical tent that s where dart will need to improve most while fitting into new oc matt nagy s offense if he can do that giants fans are expecting him to solidify his place as the team s future under center ward s promising first season has titans fans hoping his first campaign under new oc brian daboll produces significant progress but right now it s nothing more than an aspiration bryce young needs to prove he s carolina s future after a tumultuous season that saw the panthers reach the playoffs but with an 8 9 record and finally kyler murray arrives in minnesota as kevin o connell s chosen solution for the franchise s quarterback woes but he too needs to prove he s worthy of the opportunity after fizzling out of arizona if all goes well each quarterback has a chance to climb as of now though the focus is on producing tangible improvement tier 5 this is the grizzled veteran trio aaron rodgers kirk cousins and jacoby brissett have each seen plenty in their nfl careers and the first two are likely entrenched in their places this is rodgers final season and will probably be cousins final starting job unless he thrives in his limited time and attracts interest elsewhere in 2027 the outlier is brissett an experienced and skilled quarterback who also isn t interested in making financial sacrifices in the name of opportunity he found a good spot in arizona negotiated a fully guaranteed one year deal and will begin his 11th nfl season with just enough security and leverage to prove he s worthy of a starting job he ll climb these rankings if he can capitalize on the assortment of talent surrounding him trey mcbride marvin harrison michael wilson and rookie jeremiyah love but he can t waste too much time with intriguing rookie carson beck sitting on the bench tier 6 like the pioneers we are only taking our first steps into our great westward journey exploration awaits and it comes with the admission that we don t know much how will malik willis in his first opportunity to own a starting job in his career fare with a limited supporting cast a first time head coach and an offensive coordinator aiming to repair his play calling reputation can tua tagovailoa find enough consistency to hold onto the job beyond week 1 and how long will deshaun watson last as the browns starter my guess is two weeks for those keeping track generally we re venturing into the unknown which offers the promise of great wonder and surprise or disaster

news_mentions.headline: Patriots QB Drake Maye on loss to Seahawks: My impatience 'cost us the game'
news_mentions.description: New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye threw three interceptions that led to a 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks in the 2026 season opener.
news_mentions.body_text: new england patriots quarterback drake maye threw away a chance to swipe the season opening game in a super bowl rematch against the seattle seahawks falling 13 10 following a game sealing interception the pats controlled much of the first half after the super bowl champs lost starting qb sam darnold five plays into the contest after new england took a 10 0 lead early in the third quarter things unraveled for maye who threw three ints on the patriots final three possessions the third year qb blamed impatience on the trio of errors yeah we had the game under control maye said thought we had a good plan to start chipping away and be patient and lost patience and it cost us decisions that cost us the game on my part on my end i vow to myself to be better and realize it s a long season but at same time we can t have those we can t have those it s unacceptable and i know we got to get back to work that wasn t how i play football and how i want to represent my game and playing quarterback for the patriots maye completed 23 of his 33 pass attempts for 178 yards one touchdown and a career high three interceptions the bulk of his production came on short tosses and dump offs he went 20 of 23 on attempts of under 10 air yards for 134 yards and a touchdown 8 9 cpoe maye struggled downfield 10 air yards connecting on just three of eight attempts for 44 yards and three ints 12 7 cpoe all three of his picks came on deep attempts 20 air yards two more than he threw all last season 1 the three ints flipped the script as the pats watched a road win slip away you can t throw three interceptions coach mike vrabel said drake knows that we put ourselves in some long yardage situations on the one that was probably forced and i think the guy made a great play on the last one the last one was the most egregious after trailing for the first time in the contest maye helped drive to the seahawks 16 with several solid throws and using his legs to pick up pivotal first downs however his impatience again reared its head in range for the game tying field goal with 26 seconds remaining maye forced a pass to mack hollins in the end zone that came up woefully short it was a bad decision and horrific execution i didn t put enough on it to get it out and it was just unacceptable maye said we had a chance to send it to overtime at the worst the only thing you could do is turn the ball over and that s what i did early maye was content to take what the defense gave him and did a far better job finding outlets versus the seahawk pressure packages than during the super bowl however late he began to hunt big plays that weren t there and got burned i just stopped being patient he said that was the big thing we were really good up to the point where i tried to force one down the sideline to romeo doubs we were patient and dumping it off and trying to move the chains and we avoided a lot of three and outs and that was something we try to earn more plays and the explosives will come so just stopped being patient and made decisions that ended up like i said cost us the game maye had no choice but to wear this l this one can t be blamed on the o line or poor calls the qb simply had a horrible string of decisions that cost his club it burns now and it was truly a brutal performance but there is a lot of season ahead reminder the pats lost week 1 to the raiders last year and still made the super bowl how maye bounces back will say far more than one wednesday game in september it s such a long season vrabel said we re going to hold our head up high and we have nothing but the utmost confidence in him and everybody on this football team and he s going to make a lot of plays for us

news_mentions.headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold will undergo MRI; hip fracture ruled out after win over Patriots
news_mentions.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold suffered a hip injury on Seattle's first drive Wednesday night against the Patriots and was ruled out and replaced by Drew Lock.
news_mentions.body_text: the seahawks are breathing a sigh of relief both after a second half comeback victory to open the season and due to the latest update on quarterback sam darnold s health darnold who was ruled out just prior to halftime of wednesday s 13 10 season opening win over the patriots due to a hip injury is still having tests done but a hip fracture has been ruled out head coach mike macdonald said postgame macdonald described the results of darnold s testing as great news though the team still does not know the extent of the qb s injury darnold underwent a ct scan on his hip at the harborview medical center in seattle and received encouraging but inconclusive results per espn s adam schefter who added darnold is scheduled to undergo an mri on thursday darnold suffered his injury during seattle s first drive a five play 30 yard march when he was sacked on third down by dre 39 mont jones trainers did not initially attend to the qb on the sideline but he went to the blue tent during new england s opening possession drew lock then entered the game in relief while darnold limped to the locker room as seattle s offense took the field for a second time darnold was 1 of 2 for 13 yards before sustaining the injury with the seahawks and pats knotted at 0 seattle s offense went silent without darnold the patriots were able to open up a 7 0 lead over the course of the first half as lock proved unable to lead any of his five drives into enemy territory the seahawks became just the third reigning super bowl champion to get shut out in the first half of their season opener joining the 1984 raiders and 1967 packers per nfl research like those raiders and packers teams who recovered for a win and a tie respectively seattle would not lose the defense played tremendously allowing only a field goal the rest of the way and ending all three of new england s fourth quarter possessions with interceptions including an end zone pick by joshua jobe with 21 seconds remaining to seal the victory seattle s smothering defense allowed lock just enough opportunity as the seahawks overcame a double digit deficit with two field goals and a 45 yard touchdown reception by jaxon smith njigba making lock the first backup qb in nfl history to throw a td in a reigning super bowl champion s season opener he was buoyed by the defense s stellar performance but lock protected the ball and showed why he s one of the league s more trusted reserves going 16 of 22 for 187 yards and the aforementioned td it remains to be seen how many games if any darnold will miss but at least for wednesday night the seahawks found a winning formula in his absence

news_mentions.headline: Carson Wentz to back up Kyler Murray in Vikings' Week 1 game; J.J. McCarthy is QB3
news_mentions.description: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell announced Wednesday that Carson Wentz will be the team's primary backup QB to Kyler Murray in Week 1's game against the Packers.
news_mentions.body_text: j j mccarthy s tumble down the depth chart is complete coach kevin o connell announced wednesday that carson wentz will serve as the backup quarterback to kyler murray on sunday against the green bay packers mccarthy will serve as qb3 i m looking at that right now as a week to week thing o connell added carson he s got almost 100 career starts what he was able to do last year from a standpoint of very limited repetition but being able to apply a career s worth of experience that s kind of what you need to do as a backup quarterback when so much of the emphasis is gonna be on getting kyler as comfortable as we can possibly get him it s quite a fall for mccarthy the 2024 no 10 overall pick but one that was telegraphed plainly most of the offseason from the moment murray signed a one year deal in minnesota it was presumed he would start despite koc s insistence that mccarthy had a shot it quickly became clear that murray would be in the saddle week 1 the other indicator of mccarthy s short leash was the club re signing wentz who performed admirably in five appearances last season the crowded qb room which includes max brosmer on the practice squad underscored that the club wasn t going to go through the same qb ordeal it dealt with last year when it let sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building to give mccarthy his shot nine s preseason struggles and an ankle injury made koc s decision relatively easy a team that otherwise should be battling for a playoff spot can t take a chance on mccarthy being the backstop if murray who has his own injury history goes down despite the first round pick sitting as qb3 o connell insisted that he s excited to continue to get a chance to work with mccarthy he s still two snaps away so he s also gotta still prepare the coach added even today he had great questions about the game plan he s bouncing around he s still a beacon of energy on this team those traits are always gonna be there for him j j s still a young player with so much football still ahead of him if and when we feel like he is ready and gives us the best chance being one snap away with limited reps we can obviously do that koc isn t giving up on j j just yet but there isn t much further the qb can fall before the club does move on

news_mentions.headline: Patriots vs. Seahawks: Five must-know storylines for Wednesday's 2026 NFL Kickoff Game
news_mentions.description: Has New England solved its pass-protection woes? Will free-agent losses and injuries undermine Seattle? In advance of Wednesday's 2026 NFL Kickoff Game between the Patriots and Seahawks, Dan Parr provides five storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: our national nightmare is over after a 212 day break the nfl officially returns on wednesday night with the new england patriots visiting the seattle seahawks to kick off the 2026 season in an instant rematch of super bowl lx this is the 12th regular season game between teams that met in the previous super bowl per nfl research and the reigning champs are 8 3 in the previous 11 such rematches last we saw these two squads on the same field seattle s defense and running game dominated to the tune of a 29 13 victory can the patriots pull off an upset with marquee offseason acquisition a j brown in tow this time around five must know storylines 1 have the patriots solved their pass pro woes oc josh mcdaniels has vowed that wednesday s game will be different than super bowl lx pointing the finger at himself and saying seattle out everythinged new england last time out it s hard to argue that point considering the pats were scoreless through three quarters and fell behind by 19 before they finally put points on the board the offensive line clearly wasn t up to the challenge with mvp runner up drake maye taking 21 sacks in the playoffs the most in a single postseason in the super bowl era six of those sacks came via the seahawks new england is counting on improvement from within given four of the five offensive linemen who started in the super bowl are expected to be in the starting lineup on wednesday will a healthier and more seasoned will campbell provide better protection on the blind side how much of a difference does the signing of og alijah vera tucker make seahawks hc mike macdonald coaches defense in expert mode so we know he ll have leonard williams byron murphy uchenna nwosu demarcus lawrence dante fowler and derick hall ready to attack 2 can the seahawks spoil a j brown s patriots debut there s been plenty of hype around brown s arrival in foxborough this offseason including from yours truly and for good reason while his relationship with jalen hurts unraveled last year in philadelphia brown is now reunited with mike vrabel the head coach who helped the receiver blossom as his career began in tennessee the guy has posted 1 000 plus yards in six of his seven pro seasons and leads the nfl with 18 touchdowns on deep throws 20 plus air yds since 2022 per next gen stats he s the best receiver drake maye has been paired with which is probably a scary thought for most defenses i m guessing not so much for seattle s shutdown crew even though roster turnover and injuries more on those in a bit have the potential to create some vulnerabilities in a unit that seemed impenetrable at times last season the matchup between brown and devon witherspoon who was briefly the league s highest paid cornerback after signing an extension last month will be fun to watch 3 will the freshly minted highest paid cb shut down jsn speaking of wr1 cb1 matchups we ll see another great one when seattle s jaxon smith njigba the reigning offensive player of the year lines up across from new england s christian gonzalez it was gonzalez s new four year 135 million extension reportedly agreed to as of tuesday morning that moved devon witherspoon from first to second among the league s highest paid cornerbacks the deal ended a months long dispute that crescendoed with questions about whether the pro bowl corner would even play in the season opener outside of drake maye gonzalez is the most indispensable player on the roster and now he s being paid like it how will he fare in his first game since his long awaited payday in super bowl lx new england held smith njigba to four catches for 27 yards 6 8 per on 10 targets his fewest receiving yards in an nfl game where he was targeted eight or more times 4 will the seahawks be shorthanded in the secondary suddenly things are looking quite thin in the back end of the defending champions defense they lost s coby bryant and cb riq woolen in free agency but the week 1 status for two starters they are counting on in 2026 is now in question nickelback nick emmanwori a key piece in seattle s super bowl run last season has been limited in practice which isn t a surprise as he works his way back from offseason ankle surgery the unexpected development was the addition of s ty okada bryant s replacement to the injury report with a hamstring ailment editor s update ty okada has been ruled out of wednesday s game also the seahawks lost rookie s bud clark for the season to a broken ankle he suffered in the second preseason game on cutdown day seattle traded a draft pick for an undrafted rookie cb avery smith to shore things up the hawks still have the aforementioned devon witherspoon and trusted vets in julian love and josh jobe plus mike macdonald s defensive front is more than capable of masking deficiencies in the back end but if drake maye gets the protection to do so the pats passer will surely be testing this new version of seattle s secondary down the field 5 is jadarian price ready for prime time last but not least the game s most intriguing thing to watch for fantasy football heads might be the debut of seahawks first round rb jadarian price he was never the rb1 in college playing in the shadow of jeremiyah love at notre dame and folks are anxious to see how big of a workload the hawks are willing to give him right off the bat the athletic s andrew destin recently wrote that he expects seattle to play price on early downs and then pull him for rb george holani in goal line third down and short yardage situations former packers rb emanuel wilson is in the mix for carries too that would take a big bite out of price s fantasy appeal but not all rbs are ready for three down duty from day 1 super bowl lx mvp kenneth walker departed for kansas city in free agency while zach charbonnet is opening the season on the pup list as he works his way back from the acl tear he suffered in january so it s on the trio of price holani and wilson to put qb sam darnold in the manageable situations where he can thrive

news_mentions.headline: Patriots-Seahawks in 2026 NFL Kickoff Game: What We Learned from Seattle's 13-10 win
news_mentions.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
news_mentions.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame nfl pro insight for patriots seahawks drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Gordon provides a refresher on the Seattle Seahawks' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the seattle seahawks offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location virginia mason athletic center renton wash fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs las vegas raiders 10 p m et on thursday aug 7 nfl network week 2 vs kansas city chiefs 10 p m et on friday aug 15 nfl network week 3 at green bay packers 4 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note seattle begins its season with three of four games against teams that didn t make the 2024 postseason and ends it with four of five versus non playoff squads nfl research what you need to know 1 under center for a new look seahawks offense sam darnold will command a whole lot of attention throughout training camp after three seasons as the seattle starter with a pair of pro bowl campaigns included geno smith was traded to the las vegas raiders in lieu of the seahawks extending him enter darnold who inked a three year 100 5 million deal however darnold has no guaranteed salary after this season and the team can save 27 5 million with a post june 1 2026 cut so with darnold coming off an excellent overall 2024 with the minnesota vikings and two disastrous games to end his campaign the spotlight of scrutiny will be bright even in cloudy washington skies seattle also brought back veteran no 2 drew lock and drafted jalen milroe who possesses eye popping athleticism and the unknown potential of a rookie qb whom fans always clamor to see even in camp darnold s mistakes will be dissected so every snap is important even the ones that don t count toward a final score 2 much of the seahawks offseason was about the notable names they lost geno smith dk metcalf and tyler lockett however seattle made a couple of splashes with the veteran signings of ex dallas cowboys pro bowler demarcus lawrence and former los angeles rams triple crown winner cooper kupp established veteran talent doesn t usually need to show out in training camp but just how realistic it is to hope for career renaissances from kupp and lawrence will be glimpsed in the summer lawrence missed 13 games last season due to a foot injury while kupp s injury woes resulted in 18 games missed over the past three years combined kupp has two games against his former squad to look forward to and lawrence didn t hesitate to offer some shade to his ex club but just how much they have left is likely to be a major factor in the seahawks 2025 fortunes 3 over the 2024 regular season sam darnold threw for career highs of 4 319 yards and 35 touchdowns with the minnesota vikings he averaged 3 08 seconds to throw third longest time in the nfl as he attempted 73 2 of his passes after 2 5 seconds the highest rate in the league according to nfl pro in the vikings playoff loss to the los angeles rams darnold was sacked nine times resulting in his lowest total epa generated last year 27 4 translation for darnold to work within the seahawks offense he needs to be protected well left tackle charles cross is a stalwart and how 2025 first rounder grey zabel comes along at left guard will be crucial at right tackle the biggest question for abraham lucas is staying healthy he s played in just 13 of a potential 34 games over the past two seasons perhaps the largest quandary and camp battle will come at center and right guard olu oluwatimi and jalen sundell will likely duke it out for the starting center spot while christian haynes anthony bradford and possibly sixth rounder bryce cabeldue will decide the right guard slot giving darnold time to work is paramount working out who will be tasked with doing that will be decided in camp

news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Minnesota Vikings' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the minnesota vikings offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 20 rookies july 22 veterans location tco performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again

material_news_signals.headline: Patriots QB Drake Maye on loss to Seahawks: My impatience 'cost us the game'
material_news_signals.description: New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye threw three interceptions that led to a 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks in the 2026 season opener.
material_news_signals.body_text: new england patriots quarterback drake maye threw away a chance to swipe the season opening game in a super bowl rematch against the seattle seahawks falling 13 10 following a game sealing interception the pats controlled much of the first half after the super bowl champs lost starting qb sam darnold five plays into the contest after new england took a 10 0 lead early in the third quarter things unraveled for maye who threw three ints on the patriots final three possessions the third year qb blamed impatience on the trio of errors yeah we had the game under control maye said thought we had a good plan to start chipping away and be patient and lost patience and it cost us decisions that cost us the game on my part on my end i vow to myself to be better and realize it s a long season but at same time we can t have those we can t have those it s unacceptable and i know we got to get back to work that wasn t how i play football and how i want to represent my game and playing quarterback for the patriots maye completed 23 of his 33 pass attempts for 178 yards one touchdown and a career high three interceptions the bulk of his production came on short tosses and dump offs he went 20 of 23 on attempts of under 10 air yards for 134 yards and a touchdown 8 9 cpoe maye struggled downfield 10 air yards connecting on just three of eight attempts for 44 yards and three ints 12 7 cpoe all three of his picks came on deep attempts 20 air yards two more than he threw all last season 1 the three ints flipped the script as the pats watched a road win slip away you can t throw three interceptions coach mike vrabel said drake knows that we put ourselves in some long yardage situations on the one that was probably forced and i think the guy made a great play on the last one the last one was the most egregious after trailing for the first time in the contest maye helped drive to the seahawks 16 with several solid throws and using his legs to pick up pivotal first downs however his impatience again reared its head in range for the game tying field goal with 26 seconds remaining maye forced a pass to mack hollins in the end zone that came up woefully short it was a bad decision and horrific execution i didn t put enough on it to get it out and it was just unacceptable maye said we had a chance to send it to overtime at the worst the only thing you could do is turn the ball over and that s what i did early maye was content to take what the defense gave him and did a far better job finding outlets versus the seahawk pressure packages than during the super bowl however late he began to hunt big plays that weren t there and got burned i just stopped being patient he said that was the big thing we were really good up to the point where i tried to force one down the sideline to romeo doubs we were patient and dumping it off and trying to move the chains and we avoided a lot of three and outs and that was something we try to earn more plays and the explosives will come so just stopped being patient and made decisions that ended up like i said cost us the game maye had no choice but to wear this l this one can t be blamed on the o line or poor calls the qb simply had a horrible string of decisions that cost his club it burns now and it was truly a brutal performance but there is a lot of season ahead reminder the pats lost week 1 to the raiders last year and still made the super bowl how maye bounces back will say far more than one wednesday game in september it s such a long season vrabel said we re going to hold our head up high and we have nothing but the utmost confidence in him and everybody on this football team and he s going to make a lot of plays for us

material_news_signals.headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold will undergo MRI; hip fracture ruled out after win over Patriots
material_news_signals.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold suffered a hip injury on Seattle's first drive Wednesday night against the Patriots and was ruled out and replaced by Drew Lock.
material_news_signals.body_text: the seahawks are breathing a sigh of relief both after a second half comeback victory to open the season and due to the latest update on quarterback sam darnold s health darnold who was ruled out just prior to halftime of wednesday s 13 10 season opening win over the patriots due to a hip injury is still having tests done but a hip fracture has been ruled out head coach mike macdonald said postgame macdonald described the results of darnold s testing as great news though the team still does not know the extent of the qb s injury darnold underwent a ct scan on his hip at the harborview medical center in seattle and received encouraging but inconclusive results per espn s adam schefter who added darnold is scheduled to undergo an mri on thursday darnold suffered his injury during seattle s first drive a five play 30 yard march when he was sacked on third down by dre 39 mont jones trainers did not initially attend to the qb on the sideline but he went to the blue tent during new england s opening possession drew lock then entered the game in relief while darnold limped to the locker room as seattle s offense took the field for a second time darnold was 1 of 2 for 13 yards before sustaining the injury with the seahawks and pats knotted at 0 seattle s offense went silent without darnold the patriots were able to open up a 7 0 lead over the course of the first half as lock proved unable to lead any of his five drives into enemy territory the seahawks became just the third reigning super bowl champion to get shut out in the first half of their season opener joining the 1984 raiders and 1967 packers per nfl research like those raiders and packers teams who recovered for a win and a tie respectively seattle would not lose the defense played tremendously allowing only a field goal the rest of the way and ending all three of new england s fourth quarter possessions with interceptions including an end zone pick by joshua jobe with 21 seconds remaining to seal the victory seattle s smothering defense allowed lock just enough opportunity as the seahawks overcame a double digit deficit with two field goals and a 45 yard touchdown reception by jaxon smith njigba making lock the first backup qb in nfl history to throw a td in a reigning super bowl champion s season opener he was buoyed by the defense s stellar performance but lock protected the ball and showed why he s one of the league s more trusted reserves going 16 of 22 for 187 yards and the aforementioned td it remains to be seen how many games if any darnold will miss but at least for wednesday night the seahawks found a winning formula in his absence

material_news_signals.headline: Carson Wentz to back up Kyler Murray in Vikings' Week 1 game; J.J. McCarthy is QB3
material_news_signals.description: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell announced Wednesday that Carson Wentz will be the team's primary backup QB to Kyler Murray in Week 1's game against the Packers.
material_news_signals.body_text: j j mccarthy s tumble down the depth chart is complete coach kevin o connell announced wednesday that carson wentz will serve as the backup quarterback to kyler murray on sunday against the green bay packers mccarthy will serve as qb3 i m looking at that right now as a week to week thing o connell added carson he s got almost 100 career starts what he was able to do last year from a standpoint of very limited repetition but being able to apply a career s worth of experience that s kind of what you need to do as a backup quarterback when so much of the emphasis is gonna be on getting kyler as comfortable as we can possibly get him it s quite a fall for mccarthy the 2024 no 10 overall pick but one that was telegraphed plainly most of the offseason from the moment murray signed a one year deal in minnesota it was presumed he would start despite koc s insistence that mccarthy had a shot it quickly became clear that murray would be in the saddle week 1 the other indicator of mccarthy s short leash was the club re signing wentz who performed admirably in five appearances last season the crowded qb room which includes max brosmer on the practice squad underscored that the club wasn t going to go through the same qb ordeal it dealt with last year when it let sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building to give mccarthy his shot nine s preseason struggles and an ankle injury made koc s decision relatively easy a team that otherwise should be battling for a playoff spot can t take a chance on mccarthy being the backstop if murray who has his own injury history goes down despite the first round pick sitting as qb3 o connell insisted that he s excited to continue to get a chance to work with mccarthy he s still two snaps away so he s also gotta still prepare the coach added even today he had great questions about the game plan he s bouncing around he s still a beacon of energy on this team those traits are always gonna be there for him j j s still a young player with so much football still ahead of him if and when we feel like he is ready and gives us the best chance being one snap away with limited reps we can obviously do that koc isn t giving up on j j just yet but there isn t much further the qb can fall before the club does move on

material_news_signals.headline: Patriots-Seahawks in 2026 NFL Kickoff Game: What We Learned from Seattle's 13-10 win
material_news_signals.description: The Seahawks started the 2026 season as they ended the last one -- by beating the Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: maye wilts under pressure with a chance for some personal redemption on the line drake maye new england s mvp finalist looked more like the 24 year old he is than the star he s become new england established early control of a low speed grind it out season opener via a 10 play 77 yard touchdown drive in which maye appeared to be completely comfortable capping it with a play action pass to rookie tight end eli raridon for the game s first touchdown after the break however maye reverted back to the overwhelmed passer he d been in super bowl lx the meltdown began early in the fourth quarter when maye trusted his arm too much and launched a pass down the left sideline toward a window that closed before the ball arrived resulting in an interception and opening the door for seattle to mount a comeback the ensuing drive was even more disastrous with maye forcing a pass down the seam that safety julian loveread perfectly sliding in front for another interception and finally while mounting a desperate final drive that seemed poised to at least send the game to overtime maye sensed pressure from his left bailed out of the pocket toward edge rusher demarcus lawrence spotted mack hollins in single coverage with a step on his defender heaved a floating pass off his back foot and turned it over a third and final time three drives three interceptions and one loss for the patriots who simply cannot give away possession so frequently in such a tight game it will be up to maye to respond in week 2 lock steps up sam darnold s first game as a super bowl champion ended after five plays wednesday night when he was sacked on third down and suffered a hip injury that knocked him out of the game for a considerable stretch it knocked the wind out of lumen field too but when darnold s backup needed to capitalize on an opportunity drew lock did just that leading a five play scoring drive that ended in a short fourth down completion to jaxon smith njigba for a 45 yard touchdown while that score was most valuable and will be seen on the game s highlight reel for the next week lock s play throughout matters almost as much the veteran avoided risky throws took the checkdowns frequently when available used his legs to keep drives moving and finished with a respectable stat line 16 of 22 187 yards one touchdown and a 113 3 passer rating he didn t light up new england s defense but lock gave the seahawks a fighting chance offensively and calmly led them on three second half scoring drives that took advantage of good starting field position it s precisely what a team wants from a backup and lock delivered jsn explodes in clutch in a game that didn t feature many pyrotechnics and saw just 13 combined points scored through three quarters seattle needed a spark in the final period the seahawks wisely turned to their reigning offensive player of the year jaxon smith njigba to light the powder keg facing fourth and 1 the seahawks broke the huddle in 22 personnel loading up on beef and signaling they were going to try to convert the crucial down on the ground new england took the bait sensing a run newly paid cornerback christian gonzalez stepped up on the edge then carried running back emanuel wilson into the flat leaving smith njigba open beyond the line to gain lock quickly fired a bullet to smith njigba who did the rest of the work sprinting around and through traffic and turning a short completion into a 45 yard game tying touchdown that sent lumen field into a frenzy smith njigba caught two more passes in the fourth piling up 69 of his 122 receiving yards in the final period while reasserting himself as an elite game changing playmaker on the national stage without him it s fair to wonder if seattle might have emerged victorious at all fortunately for the seahawks smith njigba was there to once again save the day macdonald s secondary delivers once again after suffocating new england s explosive offense and winning the game s grandest prize seattle s secondary saw some departures in the offseason coby bryant left for chicago and tariq woolen traded his seahawks uniform for an eagles kit and in the first week of the season seattle had to accept it wouldn t have defensive x factor nick emmanwori available for its opener in the end it wasn t much of a problem at all the seahawks exotic pressures didn t have the same impact in the first half as they did in super bowl lx with patriots offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels deftly dialing up well timed counters that neutralized many of the edge blitzes that had worked well in february but as the game entered its late stages the aggression began to pay off unsettling maye and opening up opportunities for takeaways julian love produced an excellent game not only snagging the crucial aforementioned interception but also adding six tackles to his final line nehemiah pritchett played a key role recording six tackles leading the seahawks with two passes defensed and hauling in the first of seattle s three fourth quarter interceptions joshua jobe recovered in coverage to record the final game ending interception to go along with six tackles collectively the back end of the defense banded together in the biggest moments and delivered just as they had in their run to the super bowl last year it produced yet another win for macdonald and an encouraging start to their title defense injuries dampen mood of kickoff celebration a j brown arrived as the patriots prized offseason acquisition destined to help new england form one of the most feared passing attacks in football but after just four targets three catches for 26 yards and one important pass interference drawn brown exited due to an ankle injury suffered during an awkward fall on a third down incompletion he didn t return eliminating new england s greatest aerial threat and undercutting an offense that seemed poised to lead the patriots to victory darnold s injury related exit didn t help matters either dampening the mood and silencing seattle s offense for more than two quarters it was only two injuries but both affected star players forcing both teams to adjust quickly in what became a slog offensively each team will hope for encouraging news but we were all reminded of how much a squad s hopes can rely on just a few players nfl research with wednesday night s win mike macdonald became the seventh head coach in nfl history to win more than 10 straight games prior to turning 40 years old including playoffs five of the previous six head coaches to do so george halas paul brown don shula curly lambeau and guy chamberlin are enshrined in the pro football hall of fame nfl pro insight for patriots seahawks drake maye finished 0 for 4 with three interceptions on deep attempts 20 plus yards
