news_mentions.headline: Green Bay Packers training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Green Bay Packers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the green bay packers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 18 rookies july 22 veterans location lambeau field green bay wisconsin fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs new york jets saturday aug 9 at 8 p m et nfl network week 2 at indianapolis colts saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs seattle seahawks saturday aug 23 at 4 p m et nfl network 2025 schedule note the packers will play back to back road games three times in 2025 the most they ve played in one season since matt lafleur s first year as head coach in 2019 excluding international games they went 4 2 in those six games nfl research what you need to know 1 the packers made it clear that jordan morgan will battle incumbent rasheed walker for the left tackle spot during camp the 2024 first round pick didn t play a single snap at tackle during his rookie season he played 185 snaps at guard right and left while missing the final nine games of the regular season due to injury walker has been solid at left tackle particularly in pass protection but has struggled at times in the run game if walker wins the gig morgan could remain a backup unless he shifts inside and beats out sean rhyan for the right guard job whom he couldn t unseat a year ago with elgton jenkins sliding over to center stalwart right tackle zach tom and free agent addition aaron banks at left guard three of the five spots in front of jordan love are spoken for how the other two shake out will largely depend on how morgan performs during camp it could sting if the former first rounder can t find a spot in the starting rotation heading into year 2 2 the packers spoke confidently about their secondary pieces following the release of jaire alexander who swiftly signed in baltimore following an elongated contract standoff keisean nixon sits as the no 1 corner veteran addition nate hobbs could play inside or outside where he slots is one thing to watch during camp carrington valentine took a stride forward in year 2 at a position known for unpredictability from year to year how jeff hafley utilizes his safeties could determine the pecking order at corner opposite xavier mckinney we could see a battle between evan williams and javon bullard bullard could be a movable chess piece who can drop down to play nickel hafley will get his best five dbs on the field each week and who plays more could depend on matchups how the backup crew sorts itself out will be determined during camp 3 what would a packers training camp discussion be without talking about the receiver room the addition of first round pick matthew golden injects playmaking into a group that had a trove of b players but couldn t find consistency or stay healthy in 2024 jayden reed has proven he can win consistently from the slot but is coming off a drop filled season romeo doubs also had a rocky campaign playing just 13 games christian watson hasn t been able to stay healthy but is ahead of schedule in his return from an acl tear if he s able to avoid starting the season on the pup list it would make the packers receiver decision extremely interesting savion williams a third round pick is a wild card to carve out a role green bay also brought in gadget speedster mecole hardman reed and golden should be assured of their spots the rest feels up in the air competition across the board is needed for a crew that disappointed last season and injected two rookies into the fray

news_mentions.headline: AFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Broncos, Chargers, Chiefs, Raiders
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Bobby Kownack breaks down the top AFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Denver Broncos, Kansas City Chiefs, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Chargers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams bobby kownack has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders and los angeles chargers catch up on each afc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below denver broncos kansas city chiefs las vegas raiders los angeles chargers three key storylines 1 nix s health receiving corps bo nix should be full go for training camp after suffering a broken ankle in last season s divisional round win but every step in the process bears watching when someone this important to a franchise is returning from injury once nix is out there eyes will also be glued to his pass catching group denver gifted its qb with a second no 1 wideout by trading for jaylen waddle to pair with courtland sutton and camp should provide the first hints as to whether the broncos will employ them as a 1a 1b combo or settle into a more defined pecking order plus can anyone from a proven supporting cast of troy franklin marvin mims and pat bryant emerge as the clear third option 2 denver has a new play caller reaching the doorstep of the super bowl didn t prevent sean payton from enacting sizable changes to the offensive staff he fired offensive coordinator joe lombardi two days after denver s afc title game loss and bumped davis webb up to replace him a month later payton publicly transferred play calling duties to the 31 year old former quarterback it s been a meteoric rise for webb who entered the coaching ranks as payton s qbs coach in 2023 webb has been learning under payton since then so nothing will be unrecognizable but nix still will need to get used to a new voice in his helmet any improvement for a 14th ranked scoring offense on a team that already won 14 games last season would be massive in the afc race 3 broncos are largely running it back roster wise the 2026 broncos are the personification of if it ain t broke don t fix it they took the big swing for waddle but barely signed any outside free agents denver instead focused on retaining talent losing defensive lineman john franklin myers and releasing linebacker dre greenlaw but basically keeping the band together even in the draft the club didn t make a pick until the third round apart from working waddle into the mix with webb now calling the shots the broncos can hit the ground running while many other contenders must start off with finding chemistry that s huge considering how unfriendly the first month and a half of denver s schedule appears at chiefs vs jaguars vs rams at 49ers at chargers and vs seahawks back to top three key storylines 1 when will mahomes be fully healthy patrick mahomes said during the offseason program that he s in a good spot in his acl lcl recovery and hopes to play in week 1 while andy reid told reporters the quarterback should be able to do some things at the start of training camp so how much will mahomes take on when the chiefs report and how quickly will he ramp up activity those questions don t have answers at the moment the chiefs hopes of returning to contention in 2026 and beyond rely heavily on the two time most valuable player so they ll be smart with him justin fields now on his fourth team in as many years could be one of the league s most intensely scrutinized backups as mahomes return timeline takes shape 2 kansas city s cb room begins anew again the chiefs have a habit of maximizing young cornerbacks talent and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL Power Rankings, Week 1: Cowboys rising after defensive makeover; Bears drop out of top 10
news_mentions.description: Are the Cowboys poised to make serious noise with a remade defense under a hot new coordinator? Is the injury bug already devouring some would-be contenders? Before the 2026 season kicks off, Nick Shook provides the full league hierarchy, 1-32, in his Week 1 NFL Power Rankings.
news_mentions.body_text: we finally made it the 2026 nfl season is here plenty will transpire between now and january favorites will falter sleepers will rise and we ll all enjoy the tumultuous ride of an 18 week campaign i ll be here all season to capture where each of the 32 teams stand on a weekly basis here s where we begin we ll forge our path together starting with the first power rankings of the 26 regular season note up down arrows below reflect movement from the preseason edition of the power rankings

news_mentions.description: NFL.com keeps you up to date with all of the latest league news from around the NFL.
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com keeps you up to date with all of the latest league news from around the nfl visit nfl com s transaction hub for a daily breakdown read 2026 roster cuts tracker other news rb bam knight changed his name recognized by the league to zonovan knight per the transaction wire roster cuts the browns began their process of reducing their roster to 53 by waiving 12 players and terminating the contract of four others on friday waivers db mekhi blackmon was officially awarded to cleveland off waivers from the colts injuries olb marist liufau suffered a broken left forearm in friday s game coach brian schottenheimer said injuries wr marvin mims suffered a bruised foot in friday s preseason game against the vikings head coach sean payton said mims went to the locker room to be evaluated in the first quarter and did not return injuries cb melvin smith ribs was ruled out of friday s preseason game against the seahawks injuries rb ashton jeanty is still on the mend from the ankle injury he sustained during practice on aug 23 head coach klint kubiak said we ve got another week to assess how he s going to look going into week 1 kubiak added but we re counting on him the raiders open the regular season against the dolphins on sept 13 injuries qb j j mccarthy didn t play in friday s preseason game against the broncos due to an ankle injury but there is no long term concern espn reported s jacob thomas is believed to have suffered an ankle sprain in friday s game and will undergo an mri head coach kevin o connell said other news ol jack conley changed his jersey number from 74 to 67 injuries rb tyrone tracy was evaluated for a head injury during friday s preseason game against the jets and cleared coach john harbaugh said after the game that tracy has a stinger cb korie black pulled his groin in friday s game per harbaugh depth chart news harbaugh said that dominic zvada won the starting kicker job over ben sauls roster cuts wr caullin lacy was waived with an injury settlement injuries rb chip trayanum neck was taken to the hospital for evaluation after leaving friday s game against the giants the jets announced the team added trayanum is awake alert and has movement in his extremities ol anez cooper shoulder was ruled out de joseph ossai exited friday s game with a foot injury injuries s andre sam was carted off the field with a leg injury during friday s game sam left the stadium in a walking boot on his left leg per local reporters roster cuts the steelers began the process of reducing their roster to 53 by releasing 11 players on friday roster cuts rb patrick taylor was waived from injured reserve with an injury settlement other news te khalil dinkins changed his jersey number from 82 to 43 injuries s xavier williams hip was ruled out of friday s preseason game against the jaguars injuries wr wan 39 dale robinson is not believed to have suffered a concussion after sustaining a big hit during thursday s joint practice with the bears nfl network insider ian rapoport reported robinson was evaluated for a head injury on thursday and the titans will continue to monitor him to make sure that concussion symptons do not arise rapoport added visits db will harris

and moving on before the bill comes due most recently they traded two time all pro trent mcduffie and let jaylen watson walk in free agency with both cover men going to the rams kansas city will call on 2025 third rounder nohl williams and mansoor delane this year s no 6 overall pick to fill the void fourth round rookie jadon canady should also be in competition for playing time with free agent signees kader kohou and l 39 jarius sneed the latter of whom returns to kansas city a couple of years after the team traded him to tennessee defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo s track record which includes three straight top six defenses in points allowed suggests things will work out just fine 3 bieniemy s back kansas city s offensive coordinator position has been devalued for years overshadowed by the prowess of patrick mahomes and andy reid perhaps it shouldn t have been during eric bieniemy s five years as the team s oc from 2018 through 2022 the chiefs never finished worse than sixth in the league in points or yards twice tallied the most points and three times amassed the most yards in the last three years without bieniemy the chiefs have ranked at average 17th in scoring and 15th in yardage there were obviously other factors in the decline such as tyreek hill exiting in a trade and travis kelce aging out of his prime but bieniemy returning still bodes well back to top three key storylines 1 mendoza s first camp the future of the raiders now rests on no 1 pick fernando mendoza s shoulders even if he isn t destined to start right away new head coach klint kubiak has communicated that his ideal scenario is to avoid putting a rookie under center in week 1 and by signing veteran kirk cousins las vegas essentially ensured mendoza s starting debut will come via choice rather than need still mendoza is coming off a perfect 16 0 season in which he took home the heisman trophy and led indiana to a national championship he s going to show up for the competition and all the buzz at raiders camp will revolve around him when he does 2 who steps up at wr las vegas has some starry names on offense quarterback fernando mendoza running back ashton jeanty and tight end brock bowers at wide receiver though there s work to do tre tucker was easily the team s most trustworthy wideout last year but he doesn t really profile as a wr1 jack bech and dont 39 e thornton 2025 second and fourth round picks respectively are looking to rebound from underwhelming rookie seasons free agent addition jalen nailor has a chance to show staying power in a larger role after flashing promise with 858 yards and 10 tds on 57 catches over the past two years with the vikings those are likely las vegas top four in some order but there s still a lot to shake out during the preseason 3 crosby s defense 2 0 in the four days between the raiders agreeing to send maxx crosby to the ravens and baltimore backing out of the trade las vegas spent a whole lot of dough rebuilding its defense for what was supposed to be the post crosby era now thanks to the blockbuster deal falling apart crosby is very much a part of the present the five time pro bowler returned to possibly the most talented unit the raiders have had during his career the linebacking corps has been rebuilt with nakobe dean and quay walker taron johnson brings more legitimacy to the cornerback room and kwity paye is set to line up on the edge opposite crosby reason for excitement in sin city extends far beyond the team s top picked qb back to top three key storylines 1 mcdaniel effect it was time for a change after the chargers scored 15 combined points in their last two wild card exits jim harbaugh fired offensive coordinator greg roman a longtime collaborator and replaced him with mike mcdaniel to hopefully supercharge the offense as the former dolphins coach did in his first couple years with miami mcdaniel s arrival as a quarterback whisperer is good news for justin herbert who already plays at a pro bowl level but the impact of his high octane system should be felt everywhere from the promising tight end trio of oronde gadsden david njoku and charlie kolar to omarion hampton in the backfield 2 fingers crossed for l a s o line los angeles offensive line should be a strength of the team in 2026 after disaster struck last season left tackle rashawn slater suffered a season ending patellar tendon tear in august while right tackle joe alt played just six games before requiring season ending ankle surgery herbert took a career high 54 sacks behind a patchwork offensive line leading the league with 268 pressures taken and a 43 3 pressure rate slater and alt are back but they ll also be joined on the line by free agent signings tyler biadasz and cole strange as well as second round rookie jake slaughter assuming the group stays healthy herbert should be well protected first though the bolts blockers have to jell together as a unit in august 3 chargers hope they have an edge rushing duo to build around the offseason didn t bring any sweeping changes for the chargers defense dalvin tomlinson 32 was their most notable signing to bulk up the interior and they lost a few pass rushers odafe oweh and da 39 shawn hand but largely maintained the status quo los angeles did however spend a first round pick on akheem mesidor the acc sack leader in 2025 with 12 5 there s enough pass rushing depth that mesidor won t have to take on too much too soon more importantly he has some stellar mentors in tuli tuipulotu who was sixth in the nfl last season with 13 sacks and nine time pro bowler khalil mack the hope is for a seamless transition from mack to mesidor alongside tuipulotu as the leaders of the l a edge rush back to top

news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Detroit Lions' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the detroit lions offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 16 rookies july 19 veterans location detroit lions training facility allen park michigan fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule pro football hall of fame game vs los angeles chargers thursday july 31 at 8 p m et nbc week 1 at atlanta falcons friday aug 8 at 7 p m et week 2 vs miami dolphins saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs houston texans saturday aug 23 at 1 p m et 2025 schedule note the lions have 11 games against 2024 playoff teams tied with the eagles for most in the nfl nfl research what you need to know 1 who will replace frank ragnow the abrupt retirement of the star center tossed a massive question mark into the lions den presumably the club hoped to get one more year out of the stalwart pivot who played through an assortment of injuries throughout his career that would have allowed rookie tate ratledge to get his feet wet at guard before transitioning to center in 2026 much the same way ragnow started his career now things are turned topsy turvy is the second round rookie ready to start under center like 30 other second round picks he remains unsigned as camp approaches which could toss another kink into the lions plans can veteran graham glasgow return to center for the start of the season the 32 year old struggled last season at guard and hasn t consistently played center since the end of the 2022 campaign fifth round rookie miles frazier could also play a key role this season particularly if injuries strike with second year guard christian mahogany already slated to take over for guard kevin zeitler who left in free agency the lions could be uber young in the middle of the offensive line in front of jared goff a strength of the 2024 squad the offensive line has big questions heading into training camp 2 coming off a 15 2 season and back to back nfc north championships the lions are replacing both coordinators who left for head coaching jobs dan campbell knew he could trust ben johnson and aaron glenn to pull the right plays and build a reliable game plan week in and week out now he ll have to construct that same trust with new offensive coordinator john morton and defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard working under glenn since he became an nfl coach in 2021 sheppard was a natural choice to step into the dc role however he s green as a play caller and there will be questions about how he handles in game adjustments glenn kept a defense decimated by injuries afloat last season until the playoffs how would sheppard fare if similar devastation occurs likewise morton enters with big shoes to fill the lions offense was a dual threat nightmare for defenses and johnson was a master at setting up defenses to fail will morton who doesn t have a ton of play calling experience continue that with a trove of offensive weapons or could we see a step back from detroit s offense morton s familiarity with goff is a benefit but questions remain as to how he ll tweak the scheme like potentially splitting out wide jahmyr gibbs more often it s difficult to imagine the lions getting better management from their coordinators than they had a year ago any step back could be a detriment in a tough division training camp will give us our first real taste of how the new coordinators plan to change things or not in 2025 3 aidan hutchinson has been cleared from last year s devastating injury given the timeline it s not a surprise that the pass rusher is raring to go but it will be good to see him live during camp how he attacks those first few days of practice and recovers from them will give a good indication as to whether he can get back to the defensive player of the year trajectory he was on pre injury or whether we should curtail our expectations hutchinson s health isn t the only one to track in detroit alim mcneill is expected to miss the early part of the season but how much remains to be seen how does marcus davenport look after yet another injury shortened season there are questions at edge rusher in detroit so the health of the front four is particularly notable at this early stage

news_mentions.headline: 2025 NFL position battles: Picks to win 10 notable training camp competitions across the league
news_mentions.description: With training camps opening across the NFL, which position battles demand your attention? Kevin Patra spotlights 10 intriguing competitions, including four quarterback derbies.
news_mentions.body_text: summer is over for pigskin professionals the nfl is back with training camps opening across the league it s time for the competitions for jobs to commence competition is the name of the game for every squad it s what breeds improvement and ultimately leads to winning certain positions with limited rep sharing lend themselves to more notable battles you won t see many defensive competitions highlighted mainly because the hefty rotations and matchup centric usage tend to make camp fights less impactful as the season approaches below are the top 10 camp battles i ll be monitoring throughout training camp and into the preseason

news_mentions.headline: Green Bay Packers training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Green Bay Packers' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the green bay packers offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 18 rookies july 22 veterans location lambeau field green bay wisconsin fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs new york jets saturday aug 9 at 8 p m et nfl network week 2 at indianapolis colts saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 vs seattle seahawks saturday aug 23 at 4 p m et nfl network 2025 schedule note the packers will play back to back road games three times in 2025 the most they ve played in one season since matt lafleur s first year as head coach in 2019 excluding international games they went 4 2 in those six games nfl research what you need to know 1 the packers made it clear that jordan morgan will battle incumbent rasheed walker for the left tackle spot during camp the 2024 first round pick didn t play a single snap at tackle during his rookie season he played 185 snaps at guard right and left while missing the final nine games of the regular season due to injury walker has been solid at left tackle particularly in pass protection but has struggled at times in the run game if walker wins the gig morgan could remain a backup unless he shifts inside and beats out sean rhyan for the right guard job whom he couldn t unseat a year ago with elgton jenkins sliding over to center stalwart right tackle zach tom and free agent addition aaron banks at left guard three of the five spots in front of jordan love are spoken for how the other two shake out will largely depend on how morgan performs during camp it could sting if the former first rounder can t find a spot in the starting rotation heading into year 2 2 the packers spoke confidently about their secondary pieces following the release of jaire alexander who swiftly signed in baltimore following an elongated contract standoff keisean nixon sits as the no 1 corner veteran addition nate hobbs could play inside or outside where he slots is one thing to watch during camp carrington valentine took a stride forward in year 2 at a position known for unpredictability from year to year how jeff hafley utilizes his safeties could determine the pecking order at corner opposite xavier mckinney we could see a battle between evan williams and javon bullard bullard could be a movable chess piece who can drop down to play nickel hafley will get his best five dbs on the field each week and who plays more could depend on matchups how the backup crew sorts itself out will be determined during camp 3 what would a packers training camp discussion be without talking about the receiver room the addition of first round pick matthew golden injects playmaking into a group that had a trove of b players but couldn t find consistency or stay healthy in 2024 jayden reed has proven he can win consistently from the slot but is coming off a drop filled season romeo doubs also had a rocky campaign playing just 13 games christian watson hasn t been able to stay healthy but is ahead of schedule in his return from an acl tear if he s able to avoid starting the season on the pup list it would make the packers receiver decision extremely interesting savion williams a third round pick is a wild card to carve out a role green bay also brought in gadget speedster mecole hardman reed and golden should be assured of their spots the rest feels up in the air competition across the board is needed for a crew that disappointed last season and injected two rookies into the fray

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 1: Ranking all 32 starters entering 2026 season
news_mentions.description: With the 2026 NFL season upon us, Nick Shook ranks each team's quarterback, from 1 to 32, heading into Week 1. Who ranks above reigning MVP Matthew Stafford? Is Caleb Williams ready to build on his breakout campaign?
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl is back with another season and so too is the qb index as a reminder this is a season long weekly ranking of quarterbacks that will be grouped into tiers these rankings are fluid and starters will be in and out of this list just as they are in their own lineups let s check in with where i see all 32 starting quarterbacks at the start of the 2026 nfl season tier 1 while used facetiously in the great joe flacco debate of the 2010s the term elite is reserved for the very best here we have three nfl mvps and a finalist in only his second season it s a group that commands instant recognition and immediate respect from every opposing defense they are all elite and each comes with great expectations josh allen welcomed veteran receiver dj moore to buffalo in the offseason and appears to be on track for a honeymoon year with moore which could elevate buffalo s offense and push allen to the front of the mvp pack once again matthew stafford just produced his best season at 37 years old and returns to lead a premier offense as part of a loaded super bowl favorite drake maye nearly won mvp last season and led his patriots to an unlikely super bowl appearance he returned to casually welcome in a j brown and romeo doubs to a corps that is now so strong new england had to trade away a former maye favorite in kayshon boutte and finally we have patrick mahomes one of the faces of the nfl over the last half decade who is in the middle of his greatest challenge of his career returning from an acl injury the chiefs and mahomes are optimistic but we won t truly know where he stands until he takes the field in week 1 for now his reputation earns him this spot tier 2 this is where the money is and will be made in 2026 it s about time people put some respect on dak prescott s name which should happen if he maintains his standard of play and benefits from an improved as of now on paper cowboys defense joe burrow has many goals but one matters more than the others stay healthy justin herbert can remind the world of his talents if his offensive line can stay healthy and the current progress report is positive lamar jackson has to accomplish the same while finding his place in another new offense which is directed by first time coordinator declan doyle sam darnold is coming off a super bowl triumph in which he played an important role but took a backseat to his team s incredible defense we ll all remember how excellent he was on the road to super bowl lx before long jared goff and the lions have plenty to prove after missing the playoffs last season although their offensive line concerns me and could be an issue if it doesn t collectively elevate its play in 2026 caleb williams was one of my favorite quarterbacks to watch in 2025 both because of his exceptional talent and his ability to deliver in the clutch all while fully embracing ben johnson s offense with a better understanding of the nfl game s speed after a rocky rookie season he landed on the madden nfl cover for a reason folks and will be central to chicago s goal of defending its nfc north title jordan love and coach matt lafleur both need to rinse the bad taste from 2025 from their mouths and fortunately love is plenty capable of doing so in entertaining fashion trevor lawrence hopped back on the radars of many and climbed these rankings by marrying perfectly with liam coen s offense using his legs more and producing the best version of himself in his pro career he s perhaps the most fascinating subject of this whole group can he and coen do it again and build upon the successes they enjoyed in the second half of 2025 tier 3 injuries unfortunately hampered a significant portion of this group baker mayfield played through multiple ailments and saw his performance suffer jayden daniels tried his best to do the same and ultimately missed 10 games daniel jones scintillating start was derailed by injury brock purdy was sidelined for nearly half of the season due to injury and bo nix missed his chance to power the broncos to the super bowl due to his ankle injury with all of this considered perhaps this is the redemption tier each of these quarterbacks has points to prove and even those who didn t encounter health challenges have important goals on their season checklists will c j stroud wash his hands of his disastrous playoff exit and prove he s still the face of the texans future can jalen hurts return to excellence under new oc sean mannion after the dreadful experience that was the 2025 season can geno smith show the football world that he wasn t the problem in las vegas and can still sling it with some of the best the performances of this group will undoubtedly alter the qb index landscape in 2026 for better or worse tier 4 we ve arrived at the making the leap tier where tyler shough jaxson dart and cam ward enter year 2 with plenty of promise coupled with pressure to deliver shough enters atop the group because of the fashion in which he produced to finish the 2025 season opening the eyes of many to the quarterback s potential as a partner with coach kellen moore dart electrified new york city last season showing promise and an undying competitive fire that propelled him to a 2 759 scrimmage yard rookie season and also subjected him to frequent visits to the blue medical tent that s where dart will need to improve most while fitting into new oc matt nagy s offense if he can do that giants fans are expecting him to solidify his place as the team s future under center ward s promising first season has titans fans hoping his first campaign under new oc brian daboll produces significant progress but right now it s nothing more than an aspiration bryce young needs to prove he s carolina s future after a tumultuous season that saw the panthers reach the playoffs but with an 8 9 record and finally kyler murray arrives in minnesota as kevin o connell s chosen solution for the franchise s quarterback woes but he too needs to prove he s worthy of the opportunity after fizzling out of arizona if all goes well each quarterback has a chance to climb as of now though the focus is on producing tangible improvement tier 5 this is the grizzled veteran trio aaron rodgers kirk cousins and jacoby brissett have each seen plenty in their nfl careers and the first two are likely entrenched in their places this is rodgers final season and will probably be cousins final starting job unless he thrives in his limited time and attracts interest elsewhere in 2027 the outlier is brissett an experienced and skilled quarterback who also isn t interested in making financial sacrifices in the name of opportunity he found a good spot in arizona negotiated a fully guaranteed one year deal and will begin his 11th nfl season with just enough security and leverage to prove he s worthy of a starting job he ll climb these rankings if he can capitalize on the assortment of talent surrounding him trey mcbride marvin harrison michael wilson and rookie jeremiyah love but he can t waste too much time with intriguing rookie carson beck sitting on the bench tier 6 like the pioneers we are only taking our first steps into our great westward journey exploration awaits and it comes with the admission that we don t know much how will malik willis in his first opportunity to own a starting job in his career fare with a limited supporting cast a first time head coach and an offensive coordinator aiming to repair his play calling reputation can tua tagovailoa find enough consistency to hold onto the job beyond week 1 and how long will deshaun watson last as the browns starter my guess is two weeks for those keeping track generally we re venturing into the unknown which offers the promise of great wonder and surprise or disaster

combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 1 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on wednesday sept 9 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns blazing and never lets williams settle in things could easily swing in the home team s favor unfortunately the panthers will be without the player who was supposed to be phillips top running mate off the edge as carolina s sacks co leader from last season nic scourton is out for the season with an acl tear if the game does turn into a shootout a distinct possibility i m leaning toward i like the bears chances a bit better why bobby picked the bengals cincinnati admittedly seems to have a bit of an early season curse the bengals finally broke a three year week 1 losing streak in 2025 only for joe burrow to suffer a long term toe injury the following game however burrow has been healthy and striking an optimistic tone in the lead up to the new season stating he s trying to manifest a return to the super bowl and can feel this bengals squad is different in my bones i believe him buccaneers versus bengals figures to be one of the most explosive matchups of the nfl s opening week cincinnati has more firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries there are likely still some growing pains to work through in that process which could allow for cincy s rebuilt dexter lawrence led defense to provide burrow with just enough of a buffer why gennaro picked the lions immediately following a disappointing 2025 season that saw detroit quadruple its loss total from 2024 dan campbell gave himself a freaking f and stressed that the lions needed to get that hunger back earlier this week campbell said new orleans is a hungry opponent so whose appetite will be satiated on sunday the lions feast at ford field as the league s highest scoring home team in three of the past four seasons including the 25 campaign in fact detroit dropped a 50 burger on chicago in last year s home opener and while it s reasonable to be concerned about the lions offensive line it s equally reasonable to be underwhelmed by the saints d line now new orleans second year signal caller tyler shough might take advantage of detroit s depleted secondary points could be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with preseason mvp front runner josh allen taking on the baddest defense on the planet granted buffalo also boasts the reigning nfl rushing king james cook a brand new wr1 dj moore and a highly cohesive offensive line but i m still backing the texans loaded d after all demeco ryans crew has gotten the best of allen in each of the past two seasons holding the quarterback to a career low 30 percent completions in 2024 and subjecting him to a career high eight sacks in 2025 both of those texans wins came in houston where this sunday s tilt will take place oh and for buffalo s offensive play caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an offensive groove takes time in week 1 give me the home team with the hellacious defense why dan picked the ravens while the colts had the epic collapse losing seven straight games to close out last season both teams are going to be eager to remove the bitter taste of a disappointing 2025 from their mouths first year ravens head coach jesse minter has an opportunity to prove his worth right away against an offense that scored in bunches when qb daniel jones was healthy last year minter needs no reminder of that fact as the colts went on the road and dropped 38 on his chargers in week 7 the most points allowed by the bolts all season can the defensive guru avenge that loss with his new crew on paper he has the weaponry to make it happen it will certainly help if jones is at all rusty in his first game back since tearing his achilles in december the biggest question for ball knowers around the league though is whether lamar jackson has his swagger back after not performing to his usual standard much in an injury plagued 2025 will new oc declan doyle previously ben johnson s apprentice launch a rejuvenated jackson into orbit against a long struggling colts defense that didn t add much sizzle in the offseason maybe it s wishful thinking but i d like to believe the two time mvp still has enough in the tank to outlast a frisky indy offense why bobby picked the jaguars there aren t a ton of logical paths to a cleveland victory the browns turned back to deshaun watson who was outplayed by shedeur sanders in the preseason but nonetheless won the starting job production from the wide receiver room will depend heavily on rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston mastering the learning curve while running back quinshon judkins is coming off a serious season ending injury oh and cleveland s defense is without myles garrett for the first time in a decade it s a lot for newbie head coach todd monken and his rookie defensive coordinator mike rutenberg to juggle the jaguars conversely are looking to build on a 13 win season trevor lawrence found his stride under coach liam coen and now enters year 2 in the system with a loaded pass catching group jacksonville s defense also boasts playmakers at every level considering where the jaguars see their 2026 season going they shouldn t run into much trouble hosting the browns why jeremy picked the steelers one of these teams is comfortable in its own skin the other has zero identity at the most important position in sports mike mccarthy and kevin stefanski both enter sunday s game with something to prove out of the gate starting their third and second stints as head coaches respectively mccarthy benefits from having a familiar friend at the controls of his offense in greybeard aaron rodgers stefanski on the other hand spent the summer playing coy about who his starting qb would be between tua tagovailoa and michael penix the latter who boasts more upside only returned to practice two weeks ago leaving tagovailoa as stefanki s only true option against pittsburgh specified as only a week 1 starter tua appears to have a short leash in atlanta about as long as penix s recovery or 60 minutes on sunday rodgers did not play at all in the preseason so rust for the tinfoil man is a possibility but once he warms up the four time mvp should have his way with michael pittman dk metcalf and pat freiermuth against a falcons pass rush neutered by the loss of second year standouts jalon walker injury and james pearce suspension why jeremy picked the jets don t call it a revenge game at least that s what robert saleh and aaron glenn are preaching ahead of the former s first game as head coach against his former team both tennessee and new york are keeping the main thing the main thing which is rebounding from an awful 2025 with a week 1 victory something that eluded each side the last two campaigns in fact the only first week win from either organization since 2021 came in aaron rodgers infamous four snap debut which in case you memory holed it ended in an overtime win for saleh s jets in short a week 1 victory for tennessee or new york is rare and should be cherished on the titans defensive front ex jets jermaine johnson and john franklin myers will surely be licking their chops to stick it to their old squad alongside all world dt jeffery simmons but the jets are as well equipped on offense as they ve been in years their offensive line is sturdy and consistent and their weapons finally go two deep and while cam ward s first unit struggled this preseason geno smith and co flourished in their limited action a veteran gang green squad has just enough to outlast this green tennessee team it won t be pretty but it s week 1 when nothing is more stylish than a 1 0 record why jeremy picked the chargers in what figures to be the most lopsided result of week 1 outside of duval county the chargers are in prime position to get off to an electric start our brief glimpses of justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense this summer were straight gas and as long as jake slaughter holds up at center in his first career start against walter nolen josh sweat and arizona s pass rush los angeles should carry that momentum into the regular season with ease first year head coach mike lafleur vs football lifer jim harbaugh is not a fair fight at least not in week 1 i see a big halftime lead dwindling down the stretch as jacoby brissett trey mcbride michael wilson and co play well from behind as they so often did in 2025 but the result will never be in doubt bolts big why brooke picked the raiders the raiders drew the long end of the stick by hosting the dolphins in the opener there are question marks littered throughout miami s 2026 roster specifically on the offensive side of the ball rb de 39 von achane is in position to carry another heavy load this season as qb malik willis navigates his first campaign as a full time starter with a wr corps that s royally inexperienced there s potential there looking at you caleb douglas and chris bell but the success won t happen overnight expect the raiders defense to force willis to beat them through the air which won t be an easy feat with maxx crosby back in tow the raiders have fewer question marks and more talent across the board the offense appears better than the unit that scored a league low 14 2 points per game with geno smith in 2025 kirk cousins has the reins for now and his steady quarterbacking will be a warm welcome for raiders fans near and far plus ashton jeanty ankle should be good to go on sunday and brock bowers is primed to do more brock bowers things in year 3 editor s update after publishing on wednesday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday and is expected to miss a game or two one final note from the nfl research team this is the sixth game in the last 30 seasons in which both head coaches are making their nfl debuts with the home coach winning three of the previous five such games that s another aspect that bodes well for klint kubiak why brooke picked the vikings how will kyler murray look under kevin o connell s tutelage we re about to find out in what will be a rocking u s bank stadium full of vikings fans ready to forget the qb conundrum of 2025 as a vikings fan myself i don t feel as if the qb play can get worse than what i witnessed last season i sure hope that s true these nfc north matchups are always competitive but this particular one feels more about what the packers lost this offseason than what the vikings gained green bay begins the 2026 campaign without superstar pass rusher micah parsons and rb josh jacobs an instrumental part of matt lafleur s offense in recent seasons who s currently on the commissioner s exempt list that backfield will now feature marshawn lloyd kaleb johnson and chris brooks the only one with more than 100 career rush yards meaning brian flores defense should expect a heavy dose of jordan love s arm ultimately missing two big time starters will be too much to overcome for the road team why gennaro picked the eagles this matchup would have garnered a whole lot more attention in week 1 of last season when it could ve served as an instant rematch of the previous campaign s nfc title game but these two division rivals have gone in different directions since they met on championship sunday back in late january of 2025 philadelphia of course went on to win its second super bowl that february and although the eagles dealt with their fair share of drama this past season they still became the nfc east s first repeat winners in 21 years washington meanwhile completely came apart in 2025 injuries spoiled jayden daniels sophomore effort while dan quinn s defense gave up the most yards in the league gm adam peters aggressively rebuilt the commanders d in free agency and the draft but i m not convinced that ll be a quick fix more concerningly i have serious doubts about daniels supporting cast especially the laremy tunsil less offensive line that s a recipe for disaster against vic fangio s defense sure the eagles edge group has question marks but the front is spearheaded by the devastating dt duo of jalen carter and jordan davis even if jayden can avoid those 650 pounds of pain philly has two athletic linebackers zack baun and jihaad campbell to track the fleet footed quarterback and a pair of first team all pro cover men quinyon mitchell and cooper dejean to close his passing lanes nick sirianni improves to 6 0 in week 1 why brooke picked the giants i know the cowboys have dominated this division rivalry recently winning 16 of their last 18 meetings going back to 2017 despite new york prevailing in week 18 last season dallas pulled its starters at halftime but this game feels like a massive opportunity for the giants to course correct after an offseason full of change john harbaugh is captaining the ship cam skattebo is healthy malik nabers could be on the verge of returning after missing a majority of last season odell beckham is back and no 5 overall draft pick arvell reese joined one of the league s scariest pass rushes at least on paper so yeah these aren t last year s giants these aren t last year s cowboys either dallas defense which ranked dead last in scoring d and 30th in yards allowed in 2025 was overhauled in the offseason with a new coordinator christian parker and an influx of talent including a pair of first round rookies in caleb downs and malachi lawrence that unit has plenty to prove so too does an offensive line that was put under some extra pressure this week with the injury to pro bowl lg tyler smith a development that throws fourth year pro tj bass into the fire you can t get all caught up in the statistical weeds for week 1 because we don t truly know what the 2026 iterations of these clubs look like i have to lean into the vibes and my gut we re talking prime time at metlife this just feels like big blue s super bowl monday sept 14 why jeremy picked the broncos there is so much intrigue going into this week 1 finale that i m almost embarrassed by my curiosity with the most overexposed nfl franchise of the past half decade but that s what patrick mahomes does his absence magnifies his presence could he actually be all the way back from last year s devastating knee injury was 2025 the fluke of flukes or a harbinger of something worse to come for andy reid and friends similarly for denver is bo nix all healed and ready to take mahomes mantle as king of the division or was his first year atop the west an illusion of how things could be monday night won t provide definitive answers but it should feature solid if unremarkable play for both sides mahomes will knock off the rust the broncos will play well but keep kansas city around with turnovers and a fourth quarter score perhaps by offseason addition jaylen waddle will fittingly be the deciding factor no shootout in the first wild afc west matchup of the season but last year s trends outsized broncos success chiefs woes in one score games will make their mark on this year s opener wednesday s game why dan picked the seahawks i m expecting a much more competitive contest than what we saw when the patriots and seahawks met in february a 29 13 shellacking by seattle mainly because i have concerns about the condition of the hawks run game and the back end of the defense as you might recall those two facets played leading roles in propelling mike macdonald s team to the top last season the sb lx mvp kenneth walker departed in the offseason and zach charbonnet is on the pup list that means rookie jadarian price and third year pro george holani who has made his bones on special teams so far will be asked to carry the bulk of the rushing load are they up to the challenge against a defense that didn t allow a 100 yard rusher until week 12 last season also the seahawks lost safety coby bryant and corner riq woolen in free agency they will be without starting safety ty okada while nickelback nick emmanwori is questionable to play as he returns from ankle surgery any coverage breakdowns as the new secondary gains its footing could be costly against an offense undoubtedly anxious to feature marquee offseason acquisition a j brown ultimately i don t trust the patriots offensive line last seen being ripped to shreds by seattle s fearsome front enough to pick the upset but i do believe in oc josh mcdaniels promise that the rematch will be different thursday s game why bobby picked the 49ers it s nearly impossible to enter a campaign with as much hype as the rams los angeles was already enjoying a promising offseason having added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson when general manager les snead swung a trade for the single season sack king myles garrett it was such a seismic move that three time defensive player of the year aaron donald came out of retirement can such exultant vibes carry over to the field in week 1 which is often a toss up anyway after a roughly 16 hour flight to australia i m not sold there s a lot of injury or load management situations to consider on both sides george kittle nick bosa garrett donald not traveling to australia etc so that doesn t necessarily move the needle on rosters that are formidable with or without a few of the bigger stars the kyle shanahan sean mcvay rivalry doesn t give too much away either although shanahan is 11 8 against mcvay los angeles has won four of the past five contests where i and many others sporting large under eye bags draw the line is sleep while the 49ers flew to melbourne to acclimate a week ahead of the showdown the rams are jetting in 24 hours before the game hoping to keep their bodies on pacific time for a whirlwind victory before turning right around and traveling home sleep scientists are divided on the vastly different approaches but san francisco s feels safer if rams players experience post travel fatigue there s no time to fix it visit responsibleplay org to learn more about responsible betting

news_mentions.headline: NFL Power Rankings, Week 1: Cowboys rising after defensive makeover; Bears drop out of top 10
news_mentions.description: Are the Cowboys poised to make serious noise with a remade defense under a hot new coordinator? Is the injury bug already devouring some would-be contenders? Before the 2026 season kicks off, Nick Shook provides the full league hierarchy, 1-32, in his Week 1 NFL Power Rankings.
news_mentions.body_text: we finally made it the 2026 nfl season is here plenty will transpire between now and january favorites will falter sleepers will rise and we ll all enjoy the tumultuous ride of an 18 week campaign i ll be here all season to capture where each of the 32 teams stand on a weekly basis here s where we begin we ll forge our path together starting with the first power rankings of the 26 regular season note up down arrows below reflect movement from the preseason edition of the power rankings
