news_mentions.headline: The biggest question for each NFL team: Andy Reid's evolution, Caleb Downs' value
news_mentions.body_text: every team enters september with unanswered questions from schematic transitions to new personnel in new places and some are even existential let 39 s look at a question each nfl team is facing heading into a new season afc west denver broncos can the offense be more explosive offenses are about twice as likely to score touchdowns if they can produce an explosive play run or pass of 15 yards or more on a drive the broncos produced an explosive on only 40 96 percent of drives last season which ranked 25th bo nix ranked 34th in yards per attempt 6 4 among quarterbacks who had at least three starts trading for receiver jaylen waddle was one of the offseason 39 s splashiest moves waddle ranked 12th in explosive reception rate last season and he 39 s the perfect complement to courtland sutton he can move all around the formation while sutton can dominate his x role when waddle draws attention away from him the broncos are banking on another year of development from nix and waddle 39 s addition to be more explosive kansas city chiefs can andy reid evolve reid dropped to sixth in my top play caller rankings by defensive coaches the popular sentiment was that reid still deserves to be on the list but he needs to update his offense the chiefs haven 39 t adapted as defenses have trended toward two deep safeties and light boxes last season despite seeing the fourth highest rate of light boxes 53 5 percent they ranked fifth in cook rate 57 8 percent which measures how often teams pass the ball in neutral situations signing running back kenneth walker shows the chiefs recognize they need to be more intentional about running the ball and will commit to getting under center more patrick mahomes hasn 39 t had a lot of help from receivers or the running game giving him a break with handoffs and creating easy opportunities with play action will be essential for getting the chiefs back on track with mahomes returning from an acl injury late last season las vegas raiders how much can coaching make a difference with this offensive line the raiders had one of the league 39 s worst offensive lines last season ashton jeanty was tackled for a loss 45 times the most in the league left tackle kolton miller is back after injuring his ankle last season but the raiders 39 only major addition was signing center tyler linderbaum additionally spencer burford who was a backup with the san francisco 49ers will start at left guard the raiders hope that coaching will raise the floor and ceiling for this offensive line rick dennison a veteran line coach who knows this offense inside and out will coach the line fundamentally they should be better but klint kubiak 39 s scheme will make life easier on the line as well los angeles chargers can mike mcdaniel scheme around this interior offensive line last year 39 s injury issues were bad even by chargers standards they haven 39 t gotten off on the right foot so far this offseason starting center tyler biadasz was lost for the season after injuring his knee in training camp second round pick jake slaughter will replace him but center is pivotal in an outside zone offense the center makes the protection calls and often zone runs cut vertically toward the center left guard kayode awosika is in line to start after branson taylor went on injured reserve and cole strange who played for mcdaniel with the miami dolphins will start at right guard mcdaniel has shown the ability to scheme around offensive line weakness if the line is functional the chargers will be one of the nfl 39 s most explosive offenses afc east buffalo bills can jim leonhard create chaos a struggling bills defense found some success late last season by randomizing and using exotic disguises to confuse opponents sometimes their roll of the die approach would work like in a wild card win in which they forced two takeaways and held the high powered jacksonville jaguars offense to 24 points sometimes it didn 39 t like in the divisional round when they gave up 33 points to the broncos the bills didn 39 t have an injection of talent defensively but they were able to hire leonhard a well regarded defensive mind leonhard may have to take a similar approach to last season and use calculated chaos but knowing you have to do this in the offseason when you can draw up plays and teach the system with this approach in mind could lead to more consistent results miami dolphins do you have enough to evaluate malik willis willis signed a three year 67 million deal in the offseason but the dolphins can get out of it after 2028 willis has to prove he can be a franchise quarterback but he won 39 t have much help around him this year the offensive line could be better than people think and de 39 von achane is elite but his best catcher is rookie chris bell who recently started practicing after returning from an acl injury willis should be able to produce on the ground but the dolphins might get behind often this season and fall into heavy passing scripts willis won 39 t have much help downfield new england patriots can this offense perform against elite defenses the patriots faced only one defense last regular season that ranked in the top 10 in points allowed per drive cleveland browns in the playoffs they played against four such teams and struggled mightily averaging 1 13 points per drive and 0 19 epa per play for context both of those stats would rank 32nd in the league in the regular season they 39 ve overhauled their receiving corps with the additions of a j brown and romeo doubs and should be much more equipped to play against elite defenses new york jets nbsp can geno smith bounce back smith was flat out bad last season after playing good ball and resurrecting his career in seattle however there aren 39 t many quarterbacks who could have functioned in las vegas 39 offense the raiders had the worst run game in the league couldn 39 t pass block and were well below average at receiver with the jets he could have a good offensive line a good running back in breece hall and a fringe elite receiver in garrett wilson offensive coordinator frank reich who has been the play caller for some historically bad offenses is a concern but the help smith will get from his teammates will be night and day better than last season afc north baltimore ravens can jesse minter elevate this defense back to franchise standards minter got the most out of his personnel with the chargers he weaponized his lone superstar derwin james and hid several deficiencies with his scheme the ravens could have a better secondary if nate wiggins takes a step up in his development we could see minter get more aggressive with his play calling with a secondary he could trust to play more man coverage cincinnati bengals is al golden a good defensive coordinator before last season the bengals fired lou anarumo and hired golden who called plays for notre dame from 2022 24 the bengals ranked near the bottom of the league in several major defensive statistical categories in golden 39 s first season this offseason the bengals added talent trading for defensive tackle dexter lawrence and signing safety bryan cook and edge boye mafe golden was expected to implement an aggressive scheme last year but they were one of the more passive defenses blitzing at the league 39 s lowest rate the bengals hoped to improve their defense after firing anarumo but had a worse season statistically than they ever had under him cleveland browns can they create a qb friendly environment deshaun watson and shedeur sanders probably aren 39 t long term answers at quarterback but the browns have the makings of a strong environment for a young qb coach todd monken is an excellent play caller and rookie receivers kc concepcion first round pick and denzel boston second round pick have a chance to be a strong duo second year players running back quinshon judkins and tight end harold fannin showed promise last year no one is expecting much success for the browns this year but if their young playmakers can continue to develop in monken 39 s system they could set themselves up to finally become a quarterback friendly offense pittsburgh steelers can dc patrick graham finally modernize this defense the steelers have been behind the schematic eight ball for years graham has had a penchant for getting defenses to punch above their weight class but has had only one top 10 defense statistically 2023 raiders he 39 ll have the most talent he 39 s ever worked with in pittsburgh graham has been a chameleon schemer how he adapts his system to the steelers and how they acclimate to his scheme can lead to explosive results afc south houston texans can the run game be average c j stroud has never had an even average run game in houston they ranked 30th in rushing success rate last season 32nd in 2024 and 25th in 2023 they were intentional in making their offense more physical this year drafting interior lineman keylan rutledge in the first round and trading for running back david montgomery with how dominant the texans 39 defense is how well they run the ball will decide whether they 39 re true contenders indianapolis colts was committing to daniel jones the right decision jones signed a two year 88 million deal so the colts are tied to the qb long term they really didn 39 t have a choice after how good their offense looked with jones at the helm when he was healthy last season but there were signs of regression before his injury in jones 39 last four games before he was hurt against jacksonville in week 14 he averaged just 0 14 epa per play and turned the ball over 11 times he has looked good in training camp but it 39 s incredibly hard to return to full strength after an achilles tendon injury also jones has never played in every game in a season in his career there are many red flags indicating that jones 39 success at the beginning of last season was fool 39 s gold but he has a chance to prove it wasn 39 t jacksonville jaguars can trevor lawrence build consistency lawrence seemingly had a breakout season in 2022 but followed it with two seasons of inconsistency playing in liam coen 39 s offense lawrence looked like the player the jaguars thought he 39 d be when they drafted him no 1 last season lawrence reduced his off target pass rate 10 4 percent and turnover rate 2 2 percent to the lowest of his career he 39 ll need to continue cutting down on the negative plays to string together two good seasons in a row for the first time in his career tennessee titans can cam ward make the mundane plays over and over again playing for brian daboll josh allen slowly decreased his average time to throw and average air yards from 2018 to 2021 everyone knew allen could make the big throw downfield but it was his ability to improve on short to intermediate throws that made him a complete quarterback in allen 39 s second season the bills added cole beasley a slot receiver allen could trust to be in the right place and win quickly similarly the titans added wan 39 dale robinson this offseason to provide ward with the same type of outlet nfc west arizona cardinals how does carson beck fit into the future the cardinals aren 39 t exactly committed to beck as their quarterback of the future but investing the first pick of the third round to get him isn 39 t nothing beck will start the season as the third string quarterback the cardinals have enough offensive talent for some fireworks maybe it won 39 t result in many wins but it could be entertaining to watch jeremiyah love trey mcbride michael wilson and marvin harrison challenge secondaries next year 39 s quarterback class looks loaded and if the cardinals drafted one early would that mean they just wasted a high third round pick on a backup quarterback even though it would take a lot for beck to convince the cardinals not to draft a quarterback high shouldn 39 t they find out what they have in him sooner rather than later los angeles nbsp rams how quickly can this defense get healthy and on the field together super teams are fun but the kryptonite we 39 ve seen for them is a lack of cohesiveness and health the rams will have four new defensive starters aaron donald myles garrett trent mcduffie and jaylen watson after an overhaul donald just made the decision to officially come back a week before the season and garrett hasn 39 t practiced since aug 5 garrett is expected to play in week 1 but donald isn 39 t a lock to play we expect the duo to wreak havoc together but it may take longer than expected to get going additionally all pro receiver puka nacua has been dealing with a psoas injury that has kept him out for several weeks and he could face a suspension matthew stafford is 38 and the weakest unit on the rams could be their offensive line which isn 39 t a major weakness but it 39 s thin they can 39 t afford to let stafford get hit too many times the rams are immensely talented and while health is a concern for every team several seemingly minor issues in l a hopefully won 39 t compound or get worse going into the season san francisco 49ers can the defensive line get back to being disruptive one of kyle shanahan 39 s core tenets is to always have a disruptive defensive line the 49ers have kris kocurek one of the best defensive line coaches in the league and they invest a lot of resources into the line however they simply haven 39 t been good since 2023 the last time the 49ers made the super bowl in 2023 they ranked fifth in pass rush win rate last season they ranked 20th in the same metric this offseason they traded for defensive tackle osa odighizuwa but nick bosa just started practicing the week before the season and last year 39 s promising first round pick mykel williams is beginning the season on pup if they can get healthy there 39 s a chance the defensive line can be disruptive again but they won 39 t start the season near full strength seattle seahawks can brian fleury pick up where klint kubiak left off the seahawks offense was one of the biggest surprises last season and helped propel them to their second super bowl win the seahawks ranked eighth in explosive play rate last season with kubiak installing a shanahan offense predicated on getting big bodies on the field baiting the defense to match with base and taking shots downfield after kubiak became head coach in las vegas rather than promoting from within coach mike macdonald hired fleury who has an interesting background and has worked under shanahan in various roles since 2019 the idea is that while the seahawks offense was humming using a pure form of the shanahan offense fleury can bring an updated version as shanahan constantly tweaks and updates his system however the hire is still a bit of an experiment as fleury has never called plays nfc east dallas cowboys nbsp was the league wrong about caleb downs obviously the cowboys 39 defense needs to just improve to a baseline level under new coordinator christian parker but parker will lean on his rookie safety as a stabilizing force after being touted as a top five pick for most of the draft process a lack of measurables and flash plays on film dropped downs to no 11 downs got a complicated ohio state defense on the right page made checks and took away passing lanes by consistently being in the right place parker has moved downs all around the defense and will ask him to do things he didn 39 t do in college downs 39 leadership role will be valuable but the cowboys need him to make his share of flash plays as well new york giants can jaxson dart relearn how to play the position after playing almost his entire college career in shotgun dart played in an offense that ranked sixth in shotgun usage 76 5 percent as a rookie new offensive coordinator matt nagy will ask him to play under center a lot more than he has in the preseason the giants offense was only in shotgun on 46 6 percent of snaps indicating they 39 ll be under center more than in the gun dart will have to relearn footwork and timing in nagy 39 s offense also quarterback option plays are being phased out of the league because teams are just too good at defending them and it 39 s not worth putting the quarterback at risk without getting explosive plays in return there might be growing pains for dart but they 39 ll be necessary for career longevity philadelphia eagles how will the offensive line perform without jeff stoutland obviously jalen hurts 39 assimilation into sean mannion 39 s offense will be key but the running game will always be the crux of this offense and if they can be dominant again they 39 ll buy time for hurts to adjust the eagles 39 offensive line was severely affected by injuries last season with a healthy line they have the athleticism and physicality to be one of the best outside zone blocking lines in the league but installing a new system isn 39 t just copying and pasting a playbook constant tweaks and adjustments are needed especially when defenses start throwing curveballs new offensive line coach chris kuper has big shoes to fill as stoutland 39 s successor will his veteran line trust him to have the answers when things get hard washington commanders who will make up the foundation in the next team build the commanders missed their opportunity to build a contender during jayden daniels 39 rookie contract window daniels will be eligible for an extension next season and will likely reset the market if he 39 s healthy he can elevate this team as he did in his rookie season but let 39 s be real this isn 39 t a super bowl worthy roster this isn 39 t a lost season but the commanders should be identifying who they want to keep as building blocks for their next team build out and they will have to be more economical nfc north chicago bears are the bears right about their defensive tackle room the bears didn 39 t invest many resources in one of the worst defensive tackle groups in 2025 they added veteran defensive tackles neville gallimore and kentavius street in free agency and drafted jordan van den berg in the sixth round van den berg has been a pleasant surprise and defensive coordinator dennis allen called street the most productive defensive tackle in camp they felt good enough about their rotation to trade away gervon dexter the bears ranked 27th last season in defensive rushing success and 29th in opponents 39 yards before contact to avoid coin flip shootouts their run defense has to be better but from the outside looking in it doesn 39 t look like they 39 ve done enough detroit lions can penei sewell be an elite left tackle when the lions were offensive juggernauts it was centered on the dominance of their offensive line their offense lost consistency as the quality of the line dropped off a key to their season will be how sewell transitions to the left side after becoming an elite right tackle in the league sewell played left tackle in college so it 39 s not completely foreign for him but it 39 s not a given that he 39 ll be just as good as he was on the right the lions need difference makers on the line and can 39 t afford a drop off from sewell green bay packers can matthew golden be a strong no 2 receiver christian watson looked like a true no 1 receiver last season but golden 39 s production was disappointing 29 receptions 361 yards 0 tds after being the first receiver that the packers drafted in the first round since 2002 golden will get a huge uptick in targets with doubs signing with the patriots josh jacobs 39 future with the team is murky and his ability to break tackles has been integral to the running game coach matt lafleur might have to lean on the passing game a lot more than he has in the past and they 39 ll need golden to flourish minnesota vikings what will this offensive system look like theoretically the vikings 39 potential offense sounds amazing coach kevin o 39 connell 39 s aggressive passing game combined with a mike mcdaniel influenced run game with a sprinkle of kyler murray option offense seems like a fever dream if it all melds together assistant coach frank smith was mcdaniel 39 s offensive coordinator from 2022 25 in miami and his schematic tweaks should help improve a run game that ranks 19th in explosive rush rate since 2022 nfc south atlanta falcons can michael penix execute play action concepts penix ranks 77th in play action rate 17 6 percent among qualifying quarterbacks from 2024 25 the low rate wasn 39 t just an offensive coordinator preference when kirk cousins played former falcons offensive coordinator zac robinson increased his play action usage to 22 6 percent kevin stefanski and tommy rees 39 offense is built on play action and they won 39 t shy away from it penix will have to prove that he can turn his back to the defense whenever he gets his opportunity this season carolina panthers can coordinator ejiro evero finally put together a productive defense evero is respected around the league and has had serious consideration as a head coach candidate despite poor defensive production in carolina people in the league seem to understand that he 39 s had awful rosters to work with last year after adding talent the panthers finished 22nd in defensive dvoa ftn 39 s efficiency metric this year they signed rusher jaelan phillips and linebacker devin lloyd evero has the talent that he needs to build the best defense that the panthers have had in a long time new orleans saints what is tyler shough 39 s ceiling shough has proven to be a functional starter after getting picked in the second round some saints fans may scoff at that assessment but there aren 39 t many functional nfl starting qbs walking the earth can he be more than that as an older rookie 26 with 32 college starts and plenty of arm talent he was expected to have a certain floor but can he be more than a derek carr level quarterback tampa bay buccaneers what kind of play caller is zac robinson robinson was one of the most sought after play callers before getting hired in atlanta but his offense has been disappointing and a bit strange they used more pistol than any other offense and unlike most pistol offenses they weren 39 t in it to run option plays they ran outside zone variations which were effective in robinson 39 s two years with the falcons from 2024 25 they ranked third in rushing success rate but didn 39 t heavily utilize play action last in play action rate 9 8 percent some of this has to do with their quarterbacks cousins wasn 39 t mobile enough to execute play fakes in 2024 and penix wasn 39 t comfortable turning his back to do the defense with a well rounded offensive roster and baker mayfield robinson has a lot of freedom to shape his system differently than he did in atlanta this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Week 1 fantasy sleepers: RB David Montgomery, WR Marvin Harrison Jr. among high-upside lineup plays
news_mentions.description: Raza Umerani highlights 10 sleepers to consider for your fantasy football lineup in Week 1, including a pair of young receivers with eerily similar draft pedigrees and two running backs with high upside on Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: hear me and rejoice football is back no more burning the midnight oil mock drafting until your phone dies no more defending your zero rb draft strategy while your group chat tries to dissuade you no more internal conflicts about who to take with your first round pick no more you ve got your team now the real work begins leagues are hardly ever won on draft night and this year will be no different the waiver wire must be walked ever so tightly lest you find yourself at an ihop with a 24 hour timer that goes down 60 minutes with each pancake consumed week 1 always provides a precarious set of circumstances but we must try our best to ascertain the fortunes told in even the foggiest of crystal balls a season full of sleepers is upon us here s the first batch note all statistics come courtesy of next gen stats unless otherwise noted quarterbacks running backs wide receivers tight ends defenses

news_mentions.headline: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs would 'for sure' take himself No. 1 in fantasy football
news_mentions.description: Detroit Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs is coming off a career high in snaps played and touches, figures that appear to be on the rise in 2026.
news_mentions.body_text: detroit lions running back jahmyr gibbs was a popular no 1 overall pick in fantasy football heading into the 2026 campaign the rb agrees with the choice for sure he said smirking when asked if he d selected himself via the team s official website i m either going to make a lot of people happy or mad after splitting reps with david montgomery for the first three seasons in detroit gibbs is set to star in a solo role in 2026 with veteran isiah pacheco beginning the season on injured reserve the lions top backup options are 2023 undrafted free agent jacob saylors two career carries and 2024 fourth rounder sione vaki seven career carries i guess i m getting most of the carries gibbs said i feel good it s nothing i haven t done before it s going to be cool gibbs saw a snap boost last season hitting the 713 mark in 2025 via next gen stats that figure feels significantly lower than what he s in line for in 2026 the rb finished last year with a career high 320 scrimmage touches for 1 839 yards with 18 total touchdowns in a league with few workhorse running backs gibbs is a unicorn with the skill set to thrive

news_mentions.headline: NFC North training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bears, Lions, Packers, Vikings
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top NFC North training camp storylines to monitor for the Chicago Bears, Detroit Lions, Green Bay Packers and Minnesota Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers and minnesota vikings catch up on each nfc north team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below chicago bears detroit lions green bay packers minnesota vikings three key storylines 1 can caleb find consistency we could discuss the bears offense taking another leap forward in ben johnson s second season we could consider the burgeoning potential of luther burden alongside rome odunze or ponder who will win the primary wr3 duties we could chatter about how much higher tight end colston loveland could fly or how johnson will use his diverse te room none of that really strikes a chord without caleb williams taking his game to new heights the former no 1 pick showed what the highs can look like in year 1 under johnson the explosive jaw dropping plays were plentiful and the qb led a trove of comebacks now he must flatten out some of the lulls the drive stalling misfires and become a more potent every snap quarterback keep the extraordinary peaks and raise the floor and williams will be in the thick of the mvp discussion the madden nfl 27 cover athlete heads into year 3 with heightened expectations if he meets them there is no telling how far the bears can go 2 defensive uncertainty from front to back questions on defense will hover over training camp the bears did precious little to upgrade a wanting front four the club added a few rotational interior defenders but is counting significantly on bounce back campaigns from grady jarrett and gervon dexter montez sweat still doesn t have a proven pass rusher on the opposite side austin booker showed signs down the stretch last year but can he take his game to another level is there enough down the line will shemar turner be healthy following last october s acl tear the questions up front are echoed on the back end where the bears are replacing both starting safeties coby bryant and cam lewis are solid but can they produce as many turnovers as the previous crew the key is first round pick dillon thieneman will the rookie be ready to thrive in dennis allen s scheme by week 1 3 two questions on the offensive line ozzy trapilo s patellar tendon injury in the wild card round means the bears can t count on the left tackle for at least the beginning of the season veteran braxton jones is penciled into the starting lineup but he will have to win the battle with jedrick wills and theo benedet to earn the week 1 assignment the position is one to keep an eye on the rest of the o line profiles as one of the better units in the nfl but if the left side becomes leaky it could be a cascading problem also i m going to keep tabs on the center spot the bears replaced drew dalman who abruptly retired this offseason with garrett bradbury as the presumptive starter however second round rookie logan jones could push the veteran for the starting gig during camp back to top three key storylines 1 offensive line overhaul the lions offensive line collapsed last season swiftly going from asset to liability detroit attacked the unit flipping penei sewell to left tackle drafting blake miller to man the right edge signing center cade mays and adding veteran depth at each spot how the line shakes out will be the main storyline to track during camp is sewell s transition going smoothly is miller a plug and play rookie or does he need time to adjust the key will be young guards christian mahogany and tate ratledge who struggled with consistency in 2025 will the duo improve or could they get pushed out of the starting lineup if the lions don t get better blocking in 2026 the explosive potential will be squandered 2 this is gibbs backfield sonic is now the featured character in detroit the offseason trade of david montgomery calcified the reality that jahmyr gibbs bell cow era is full go gibbs began to take over the majority of the backfield touches last season and his reps should continue to grow the lions likely won t want the dual threat back to creep to the 300 carry threshold but barring injury he ll blast past his career high of 250 totes gibbs should also see his role in the passing game continue to rise after posting a career best 77 catches for 616 yards and five touchdowns in 2025 gibbs combination of shiftiness speed and ability to make hay between and outside the tackles makes him a dynamic threat the lions want to ensure that threat stays on the field as much as possible he profiles for a christian mccaffrey type workload and should be in the offensive player of the year discussion by the end of the season with the expected rise in reps gibbs extension is also one we ve been waiting to see this offseason the lions have gotten in front of extensions in recent years so everyone expects a top of the rb market contract for gibbs to come barreling down the pike 3 can detroit return to health detroit has significant injuries to track at the onset of camp tight end sam laporta is the name to watch on offense but the defense has greater concerns brian branch suffered a late season achilles tear and while the lions haven t put a hard timeline on the safety s recovery it will be a surprise if he s good to go to open the season the bigger question is whether given the type of injury he sustained branch will be his normal buzzing self at all this season then there is kerby joseph whose knee injury limited him to just six games last season the lions have given few tangible updates on the safety s status while taking a wait and see approach without certainty from either starter the lions secondary sits in a precarious spot couple that with the release of cb terrion arnold and detroit could be relying once again on filler and journeymen in the defensive backfield back to top three key storylines 1 who rushes the passer until micah returns after tearing up his knee last december micah parsons is set to start camp on the physically unable to perform list and in all likelihood he ll start the season on pup wiping out his first four games there is always the chance parsons gets back earlier but given how he spoke about his timetable last month i expect him and the club to play it safe sans the dynamic pass rusher for the opening gambit there are significant questions up front in green bay the offseason trade of rashan gary made sense for the club but his absence further highlights a shallow edge group the packers need former first round pick lukas van ness to finally find his footing how he looks early in camp could tell us if green bay needs to add another veteran fourth round rookie dani dennis sutton also could have some say in that plan until parsons returns this might be a mix and match crew van ness is the key to whether the pack can survive the early portion of the calendar 2 jacobs uncertainty looms large josh jacobs situation continues to hover over the franchise after he was arrested in may at this stage it s unclear how local authorities will handle the situation in turn we don t know whether the league will take disciplinary action jacobs was on the field with his team last month and if things remain unchanged he should be there for camp if any action is taken against jacobs it could have a significant impact on the on field product in green bay jacobs is the workhorse and engine of the ground attack if he s unavailable or gets injured during the season matt lafleur s offense could be in some trouble next up are former undrafted free agent chris brooks a third down back and marshawn lloyd who has been unable to stay healthy the packers believe lloyd finally has turned a corner but until we see it in action that s a projection we can t assume we need to see the third year back produce during camp and into the preseason while staying healthy in the process 3 pass catching puzzle solved the pass catching unit in green bay is also something i m intrigued by the packers watched romeo doubs leave in free agency and traded dontayvion wicks then they inked jayden reed and christian watson to extensions those two and 2025 first rounder matthew golden comprise the top receiving trio with a clearer rotation at wr i believe the three can each thrive golden is the one to watch after he finished an uneven rookie campaign with a productive effort four catches for 84 yards and a score in the packers wild card weekend loss at chicago there are some depth questions particularly given the crew s injury history so that battle among reserves will be worth tracking tucker kraft s health is another piece to keep an eye on despite tearing his acl last november the pivotal playmaker is aiming to be ready for week 1 could he return with a new contract as well back to top three key storylines 1 kyler vs j j competition or coronation vikings coach kevin o connell continues to insist he s running a legitimate quarterback competition he keeps having to say it because frankly not many believe that j j mccarthy has a shot to keep kyler murray out of the starting lineup perhaps we ll be stunned but every indicator suggests it s murray s job to lose the former no 1 overall pick enters with proven ability while mccarthy has struggled when on the field and had issues staying healthy murray could open up the offense and his propensity to force feed his top targets could be a harbinger of a justin jefferson bounce back this competition in whatever form that takes will be tracked daily come camp within that context i m interested in how murray fits into koc s system and whether his mobility adds an element we haven t seen much of in minnesota over the past few years 2 next men up on the edge the trade of jonathan greenard took a chunk out of the defense not only because greenard was a proven disruptor but also due to the fact that the vikings now aren t very flush at the position dallas turner whom the club is counting on to have a full breakout in year 3 and andrew van ginkel sit atop the edge rusher corps but bo richter chaz chambliss and tyler batty are the next three players up on the depth chart they ve combined for one career sack chambliss defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins has also taken some reps on the edge the vikings could look to add another veteran rusher during camp or early in the season we trust brian flores defense but a coach who generally relies on vets who understand his system will be asking a lot out of youngsters how rookies caleb banks domonique orange jakobe thomas and charles demmings make the transition will have a significant say in the vikings outcome this season 3 one last dance with hitman we expected to have a resolution one way or the other on harrison smith s future surprisingly the situation still lingers will he return for another go or will he officially retire the club has made it clear they d welcome a return and didn t add a veteran to take smith s place jakobe thomas a third round pick was the only significant addition the club made to the safety crew given how much flores relies on the versatility of his safeties a return by smith would have a significant impact if he decides to retire jay ward theo jackson and thomas will battle for reps keep an eye on thomas and charles demmings in camp and preseason each could play key roles in 2026 back to top

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: Chicago Bears training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Chicago Bears' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the chicago bears offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 19 rookies july 22 veterans location halas hall lake forest illinois fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at miami dolphins sunday aug 10 at 1 p m et nfl network week 2 vs buffalo bills sunday aug 17 at 8 p m fox week 3 at kansas city chiefs thursday aug 22 at 8 20 p m et 2025 schedule note the bears are one of just seven teams that are not scheduled to play on a thursday this season however they will play the eagles on black friday nfl research what you need to know 1 a new hope wafts through chicago like a dense fog rolling in off lake michigan the arrival of ben johnson created a palpable buzz around the bears that an offense perpetually stuck in the mud might finally take flight johnson proved in his three seasons calling plays in detroit that he can manufacture explosives on the ground and through the air it was more than just the gadget or trick plays johnson s intelligence and play sequencing are some of the best in the nfl like a good boxer who can set up a knockout punch johnson knows how to counter a defense the bears stealing johnson from a division rival is the most significant coup for quarterback caleb williams who experienced a rollercoaster rookie season it s been an incredible offseason for williams his new coach and offense are a massive improvement the offensive line was dramatically rebuilt and should be the most improved blocking group in the league the additions of tight end colston loveland and wide receiver luther burden provide dynamic playmaking to grow with the young signal caller everything is built for williams to thrive in 2025 hey maybe the bears will finally join modern football with a qb throwing for 4 000 yards for the first time in club history one question entering camp is the running back rotation chicago didn t add a back until kyle monangai in the seventh round will d 39 andre swift bounce back behind a better offensive line will roschon johnson play the david montgomery role in johnson s offense we know the new coach wants to lean on the ground game to springboard the passing attack but does he have the horses in chicago 2 the bears drafted three second rounders in 2025 normally that s not a notable fact in mid july however this season there is a holdup on second round picks signing their contracts as of publication 30 remain unsigned the delay stems from the top two second rounders receiving fully guaranteed contracts the first in nfl history to do so for the bears the standoff is significant with receiver luther burden offensive tackle ozzy trapilo and defensive tackle shemar turner all in line for prominent roles out of the gate editor s note turner agreed to his rookie contract on thursday after this story was published if the issue remains unresolved pushing into august we could see the rookies presence early in the season curtailed bears fans will remember roquan smith starting his rookie season on a pitch count after an elongated contract dispute missed time in camp is significant for first year players we haven t seen burden on the field since he suffered a soft tissue injury in rookie minicamp trapilo could be in a position to battle for the left tackle gig if braxton jones isn t healthy 3 the biggest camp battle in chicago could be the left tackle job braxton jones fractured his ankle in december and didn t participate this offseason jones was solid in 2024 allowing 26 pressures in 12 games the injury could open the door for ozzy trapilo to swipe the gig particularly if jones isn t healthy to open the season obviously if the second rounder remains unsigned and jones can t practice the lt gig becomes an even bigger question 2024 third round pick kiran amegadjie struggled mightily when tossed into the fire last season but should get a clean slate under ben johnson another competition to keep an eye on is at the corner position where tyrique stevenson will attempt to avoid being unseated by terell smith and rookie zah frazier for the starting gig opposite jaylon johnson and nickel back kyler gordon

news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 1: Ranking all 32 starters entering 2026 season
news_mentions.description: With the 2026 NFL season upon us, Nick Shook ranks each team's quarterback, from 1 to 32, heading into Week 1. Who ranks above reigning MVP Matthew Stafford? Is Caleb Williams ready to build on his breakout campaign?
news_mentions.body_text: the nfl is back with another season and so too is the qb index as a reminder this is a season long weekly ranking of quarterbacks that will be grouped into tiers these rankings are fluid and starters will be in and out of this list just as they are in their own lineups let s check in with where i see all 32 starting quarterbacks at the start of the 2026 nfl season tier 1 while used facetiously in the great joe flacco debate of the 2010s the term elite is reserved for the very best here we have three nfl mvps and a finalist in only his second season it s a group that commands instant recognition and immediate respect from every opposing defense they are all elite and each comes with great expectations josh allen welcomed veteran receiver dj moore to buffalo in the offseason and appears to be on track for a honeymoon year with moore which could elevate buffalo s offense and push allen to the front of the mvp pack once again matthew stafford just produced his best season at 37 years old and returns to lead a premier offense as part of a loaded super bowl favorite drake maye nearly won mvp last season and led his patriots to an unlikely super bowl appearance he returned to casually welcome in a j brown and romeo doubs to a corps that is now so strong new england had to trade away a former maye favorite in kayshon boutte and finally we have patrick mahomes one of the faces of the nfl over the last half decade who is in the middle of his greatest challenge of his career returning from an acl injury the chiefs and mahomes are optimistic but we won t truly know where he stands until he takes the field in week 1 for now his reputation earns him this spot tier 2 this is where the money is and will be made in 2026 it s about time people put some respect on dak prescott s name which should happen if he maintains his standard of play and benefits from an improved as of now on paper cowboys defense joe burrow has many goals but one matters more than the others stay healthy justin herbert can remind the world of his talents if his offensive line can stay healthy and the current progress report is positive lamar jackson has to accomplish the same while finding his place in another new offense which is directed by first time coordinator declan doyle sam darnold is coming off a super bowl triumph in which he played an important role but took a backseat to his team s incredible defense we ll all remember how excellent he was on the road to super bowl lx before long jared goff and the lions have plenty to prove after missing the playoffs last season although their offensive line concerns me and could be an issue if it doesn t collectively elevate its play in 2026 caleb williams was one of my favorite quarterbacks to watch in 2025 both because of his exceptional talent and his ability to deliver in the clutch all while fully embracing ben johnson s offense with a better understanding of the nfl game s speed after a rocky rookie season he landed on the madden nfl cover for a reason folks and will be central to chicago s goal of defending its nfc north title jordan love and coach matt lafleur both need to rinse the bad taste from 2025 from their mouths and fortunately love is plenty capable of doing so in entertaining fashion trevor lawrence hopped back on the radars of many and climbed these rankings by marrying perfectly with liam coen s offense using his legs more and producing the best version of himself in his pro career he s perhaps the most fascinating subject of this whole group can he and coen do it again and build upon the successes they enjoyed in the second half of 2025 tier 3 injuries unfortunately hampered a significant portion of this group baker mayfield played through multiple ailments and saw his performance suffer jayden daniels tried his best to do the same and ultimately missed 10 games daniel jones scintillating start was derailed by injury brock purdy was sidelined for nearly half of the season due to injury and bo nix missed his chance to power the broncos to the super bowl due to his ankle injury with all of this considered perhaps this is the redemption tier each of these quarterbacks has points to prove and even those who didn t encounter health challenges have important goals on their season checklists will c j stroud wash his hands of his disastrous playoff exit and prove he s still the face of the texans future can jalen hurts return to excellence under new oc sean mannion after the dreadful experience that was the 2025 season can geno smith show the football world that he wasn t the problem in las vegas and can still sling it with some of the best the performances of this group will undoubtedly alter the qb index landscape in 2026 for better or worse tier 4 we ve arrived at the making the leap tier where tyler shough jaxson dart and cam ward enter year 2 with plenty of promise coupled with pressure to deliver shough enters atop the group because of the fashion in which he produced to finish the 2025 season opening the eyes of many to the quarterback s potential as a partner with coach kellen moore dart electrified new york city last season showing promise and an undying competitive fire that propelled him to a 2 759 scrimmage yard rookie season and also subjected him to frequent visits to the blue medical tent that s where dart will need to improve most while fitting into new oc matt nagy s offense if he can do that giants fans are expecting him to solidify his place as the team s future under center ward s promising first season has titans fans hoping his first campaign under new oc brian daboll produces significant progress but right now it s nothing more than an aspiration bryce young needs to prove he s carolina s future after a tumultuous season that saw the panthers reach the playoffs but with an 8 9 record and finally kyler murray arrives in minnesota as kevin o connell s chosen solution for the franchise s quarterback woes but he too needs to prove he s worthy of the opportunity after fizzling out of arizona if all goes well each quarterback has a chance to climb as of now though the focus is on producing tangible improvement tier 5 this is the grizzled veteran trio aaron rodgers kirk cousins and jacoby brissett have each seen plenty in their nfl careers and the first two are likely entrenched in their places this is rodgers final season and will probably be cousins final starting job unless he thrives in his limited time and attracts interest elsewhere in 2027 the outlier is brissett an experienced and skilled quarterback who also isn t interested in making financial sacrifices in the name of opportunity he found a good spot in arizona negotiated a fully guaranteed one year deal and will begin his 11th nfl season with just enough security and leverage to prove he s worthy of a starting job he ll climb these rankings if he can capitalize on the assortment of talent surrounding him trey mcbride marvin harrison michael wilson and rookie jeremiyah love but he can t waste too much time with intriguing rookie carson beck sitting on the bench tier 6 like the pioneers we are only taking our first steps into our great westward journey exploration awaits and it comes with the admission that we don t know much how will malik willis in his first opportunity to own a starting job in his career fare with a limited supporting cast a first time head coach and an offensive coordinator aiming to repair his play calling reputation can tua tagovailoa find enough consistency to hold onto the job beyond week 1 and how long will deshaun watson last as the browns starter my guess is two weeks for those keeping track generally we re venturing into the unknown which offers the promise of great wonder and surprise or disaster
